  print *, 'Result (both dag true, reversed):', equal

    integer, intent(in) :: iocc(ngastp,2,njoined), jocc(ngastp,2,njoined)
    integer :: ica, ica_i, ica_j, ihpv
    integer :: ijoin, idx, jdx, inc, jnc

    iocc_equal_n = .true.

    if (.not.dagi) then
       idx = 1
       inc = 1
    else
       idx = njoined
       inc = -1
    end if

    if (.not.dagj) then
       jdx = 1
       jnc = 1
    else
       jdx = njoined
       jnc = -1
    end if

       jdx = jdx + jnc
    end do outer_loop

contains

  integer function oil_spill_fill(datafield,ni,nj,mask)
    integer, intent(in) :: ni,nj
    real, intent(inout), dimension(ni,nj) :: datafield
    integer, intent(in), dimension(ni,nj) :: mask
    integer, dimension(ni,nj,0:1) :: tempmask
    integer :: inmask
    integer :: i,j,ii,jj
    integer :: not_filled, neighbors, not_filled_on_last_pass
    real*8 :: sum, sumweight, weight

    tempmask(:,:,0)=0
    do j=1,nj
      do i=1,ni
        if ( mask(i,j) .gt. 0.5 ) tempmask(i,j,0)=1
      end do
    end do

    inmask=0
    outmask=1-inmask
    not_filled=ni*nj-1
    not_filled_on_last_pass=ni*nj

    do while(not_filled.ne.0)
      not_filled_on_last_pass=not_filled
      not_filled=0
      do j=1,nj
        do i=1,ni
          tempmask(i,j,outmask)=tempmask(i,j,inmask)
          if(tempmask(i,j,inmask).ne.0) cycle
          if(tempmask(i,j,inmask).eq.1) print *, 'point',i,j,' exists'
          sum=0.0d0
          sumweight=0.0d0
          neighbors=0
          do jj=max(1,j-1),min(nj,j+1)
            do ii=max(1,i-1),min(ni,i+1)
              if(ii.ne.i .or. jj.ne.j) then
                if(tempmask(ii,jj,inmask).ne.0) then
                  weight=1.0d0/sqrt( 1.0d0*((ii-i)*(ii-i) + (jj-j)*(jj-j)) )
                  sumweight=sumweight+weight
                  sum=sum+weight*datafield(ii,jj)
                  neighbors=neighbors+1
                end if
              end if
            end do
          end do
          if(neighbors .gt. 1) then
            datafield(i,j)=sum/sumweight
            tempmask(i,j,outmask)=1
          else
            not_filled=not_filled+1
          end if
        end do
      end do
      inmask=outmask
      outmask=1-inmask
      if(not_filled.eq.not_filled_on_last_pass) exit
    end do

    oil_spill_fill=not_filled
    return
  end function oil_spill_fill

  implicit none
  double precision, intent(in) :: x, y
  double precision, intent(in) :: xpol(*), ypol(*)
  integer, intent(in) :: n
  logical, intent(out) :: Yes_On
  integer :: i
  double precision :: eps, dx, dy, cross, dot1, dot2
  eps = 1.0d-12
  Yes_On = .false.
  do i = 1, n-1
     dx = xpol(i+1) - xpol(i)
     dy = ypol(i+1) - ypol(i)

        dot2 = (x - xpol(i+1))*(-dx) + (y - ypol(i+1))*(-dy)

  end do

    G_Y_NODES(1,:) = (/ 0.0d0, 0.0d0, 1.0d0, 1.0d0 /)

subroutine Tool_Yes_On_Poly(x, y, xpol, ypol, n, Yes_On)
  implicit none
  double precision, intent(in) :: x, y
  double precision, intent(in) :: xpol(*), ypol(*)
  integer, intent(in) :: n
  logical, intent(out) :: Yes_On
  integer :: i
  double precision :: eps, dx, dy, cross, dot1, dot2
  eps = 1.0d-12
  Yes_On = .false.
  do i = 1, n-1
     dx = xpol(i+1) - xpol(i)
     dy = ypol(i+1) - ypol(i)
     cross = (x - xpol(i))*dy - (y - ypol(i))*dx
     if (abs(cross) < eps) then
        dot1 = (x - xpol(i))*dx + (y - ypol(i))*dy
        dot2 = (x - xpol(i+1))*(-dx) + (y - ypol(i+1))*(-dy)
        if (dot1 >= -eps .and. dot2 >= -eps) then
           Yes_On = .true.
           return
        end if
     end if
  end do
end subroutine Tool_Yes_On_Poly

subroutine Tool_Yes_In_Poly(x, y, xpol, ypol, n, Yes_In)
  implicit none
  double precision, intent(in) :: x, y
  double precision, intent(in) :: xpol(*), ypol(*)
  integer, intent(in) :: n
  logical, intent(out) :: Yes_In
  integer :: i, j
  logical :: inside
  double precision :: xi, yi, xj, yj, intersect_x
  inside = .false.
  j = n-1
  do i = 1, n-1
     xi = xpol(i)
     yi = ypol(i)
     xj = xpol(j)
     yj = ypol(j)
     if ( ((yi > y) .neqv. (yj > y)) ) then
        intersect_x = (xj - xi)*(y - yi)/(yj - yi) + xi
        if (x < intersect_x) inside = .not. inside
     end if
     j = i
  end do
  Yes_In = inside
end subroutine Tool_Yes_In_Poly

!  ..local scalars..

      subroutine fpader(t,n,c,k,x,l,d)
      implicit none
!  Evaluate the spline and its derivatives at x.
!  This is the original implementation from FITPACK.
      integer, intent(in) :: n,k,l
      real, intent(in) :: t(n),c(n),x
      real, intent(out) :: d(k)

      integer :: i,j,ik,kk
      real :: a(20), b(20)
      kk = k

!  Initialize the local copy of the coefficients.
      do i = 0,kk
         a(i) = c(l-kk+i)
      end do

!  de Boor recurrence to evaluate the spline value.
      do ik = 1,kk-1
         do i = kk,ik+1,-1
            b(i) = t(l+i-ik) - t(l-kk+i)
            if (b(i) .ne. 0.0) then
               a(i) = ((x - t(l-kk+i))*a(i) + (t(l+i-ik) - x)*a(i-1)) / b(i)
            else
               a(i) = 0.0
            end if
         end do
      end do

!  spline value (0th derivative)
      d(1) = a(kk)

!  successive derivatives.
      do j = 2,kk
         do i = j,kk
            b(i) = t(l+i-j+1) - t(l-kk+i)
            if (b(i) .ne. 0.0) then
               a(i) = (kk-1) * (a(i) - a(i-1)) / b(i)
            else
               a(i) = 0.0
            end if
         end do
         d(j) = a(kk)
      end do

      return
      end subroutine fpader

    real(dp), intent(in)  :: a(:)   ! main diagonal (n)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: b(:)   ! super‑diagonal (n‑1)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: y(:)   ! right‑hand side (n)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: x(:)   ! solution (n)

    integer :: n, i
    real(dp), allocatable :: cp(:), dp(:)

    c(1) = 0.0_dp
    n = size(a)
    allocate(cp(n-1))
    allocate(dp(n))

    ! Forward sweep
    cp(1) = b(1) / a(1)
    dp(1) = y(1) / a(1)

    do i = 2, n-1
       cp(i) = b(i) / (a(i) - c(i-1)*cp(i-1))
       dp(i) = (y(i) - c(i-1)*dp(i-1)) / (a(i) - c(i-1)*cp(i-1))
    end do

    dp(n) = (y(n) - c(n-1)*dp(n-1)) / (a(n) - c(n-1)*cp(n-1))

    ! Back substitution
    x(n) = dp(n)
    do i = n-1, 1, -1
       x(i) = dp(i) - cp(i)*x(i+1)
    end do

    deallocate(cp, dp)
  end subroutine tridiag

    real(dp), intent(in)  :: c(:)   ! sub‑diagonal (n‑1)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: a(:)   ! main diagonal (n)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: b(:)   ! super‑diagonal (n‑1)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: y(:)   ! right‑hand side (n)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: x(:)   ! solution (n)

    real(dp), allocatable :: bet(:), gam(:)

    n = size(a)
    allocate(bet(n))
    allocate(gam(n-1))

    ! Forward elimination (NR formulation)
    bet(1) = a(1)
    x(1)   = y(1) / bet(1)

    do i = 2, n
       gam(i-1) = c(i-1) / bet(i-1)
       bet(i)  = a(i) - gam(i-1)*b(i-1)

       x(i) = x(i) - (b(i)/bet(i+1))*x(i+1)
    end do

    implicit none

          np = 1

subroutine get_inverse_lattice( a, ainv )
  implicit none
  real(8),intent(IN)  :: a(3,3)
  real(8),intent(OUT) :: ainv(3,3)
  real(8) :: b(3,3), v
  b(1,1) = a(2,2)*a(3,3) - a(3,2)*a(2,3)
  b(2,1) = a(3,2)*a(1,3) - a(1,2)*a(3,3)
  b(3,1) = a(1,2)*a(2,3) - a(2,2)*a(1,3)
  b(1,2) = a(2,3)*a(3,1) - a(3,3)*a(2,1)
  b(2,2) = a(3,3)*a(1,1) - a(1,3)*a(3,1)

  private

contains
  subroutine slopex(lo, hi, &
                    q, qlo, qhi, &
                    dq, dqlo, dqhi)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: lo(2), hi(2), qlo(2), qhi(2), dqlo(2), dqhi(2)
    double precision, intent(in ) ::  q( qlo(1): qhi(1), qlo(2): qhi(2))
    double precision, intent(out) :: dq(dqlo(1):dqhi(1),dqlo(2):dqhi(2))
    integer :: i, j
    double precision, dimension(lo(1)-1:hi(1)+1) :: dsgn, dlim, df, dcen
    double precision :: dlft, drgt, dq1
    do j = lo(2), hi(2)
       ! first compute Fromm slopes
       do i = lo(1)-1, hi(1)+1
          dlft = q(i  ,j) - q(i-1,j)
          drgt = q(i+1,j) - q(i  ,j)
          dcen(i) = .5d0 * (dlft+drgt)
          dsgn(i) = sign(1.d0, dcen(i))
          if (dlft*drgt .ge. 0.d0) then

          dq1 = four3rd*dcen(i) - sixth*(df(i+1) + df(i-1))

  subroutine cosine_transform_data ( n, d, c )
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(rk), intent(in) :: d(n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: c(n)
    integer :: i, j
    real(rk), parameter :: r8_pi = 3.141592653589793_rk
    c = 0.0_rk
    do i = 1, n

        c(i) = c(i) + cos( r8_pi * real(2*j-1, rk) * real(i-1, rk) / 2.0_rk / real(n, rk) ) * d(j)

  implicit none

  real(kind(1.0d0)), intent(inout) :: a(n,n)
  real(kind(1.0d0)), intent(inout) :: b(n)
  real(kind(1.0d0)), intent(out)   :: x(n)

  integer :: i, k, ipiv
  real(kind(1.0d0)) :: factor, temp
  real(kind(1.0d0)), allocatable :: a_aug(:,:)
  real(kind(1.0d0)) :: rowtemp(n)

  allocate(a_aug(n,n))
  a_aug = a

  do k = 1, n-1
     ipiv = k
     do i = k+1, n
        if (abs(a_aug(i,k)) > abs(a_aug(ipiv,k))) ipiv = i
     end do

     if (ipiv /= k) then
        rowtemp = a_aug(k,:)
        a_aug(k,:) = a_aug(ipiv,:)
        a_aug(ipiv,:) = rowtemp
        temp = b(k)
        b(k) = b(ipiv)
        b(ipiv) = temp
     end if

     do i = k+1, n
        if (a_aug(k,k) == 0.0d0) cycle
        factor = a_aug(i,k) / a_aug(k,k)
        a_aug(i,k:n) = a_aug(i,k:n) - factor * a_aug(k,k:n)
        b(i) = b(i) - factor * b(k)
     end do
  end do

  do i = n, 1, -1
     x(i) = b(i)
     if (i < n) then
        x(i) = x(i) - sum( a_aug(i,i+1:n) * x(i+1:n) )
     end if
     if (a_aug(i,i) == 0.0d0) then
        x(i) = 0.0d0

    end do

    do i = 1, n

    integer, intent(out) :: cost
    integer, allocatable :: dp(:,:)
    integer :: i, j, k, L, q
    integer :: max_int

    if (m <= 1) then
      cost = 0
      return
    end if

    allocate(dp(m,m))
    dp = 0
    max_int = huge(0)

    do L = 2, m
      do i = 1, m - L + 1
        j = i + L - 1
        dp(i,j) = max_int
        do k = i, j-1
          q = dp(i,k) + dp(k+1,j) + dims(i) * dims(k+1) * dims(j+1)

        end do
      end do
    end do

  print *, 'Central moment Mu(', p, ',', q, ') = ', mu

    integer, intent(in) :: n, p, q
    real(rk), intent(in) :: x(n), y(n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: nu_pq
    integer :: i, k, l
    real(rk) :: s_pq, xi, xj, yi, yj

    nu_pq = 0.0_rk
    xj = x(n)
    yj = y(n)

        end do

      nu_pq = nu_pq + (xj*yi - xi*yj) * s_pq
      xj = xi
      yj = yi
    end do

    nu_pq = nu_pq / real(p+q+2, rk) / real(p+q+1, rk) / r8_choose(p+q, p)
  end subroutine moment

  subroutine moment_normalized ( n, x, y, p, q, alpha_pq )
    integer, intent(in) :: n, p, q
    real(rk), intent(in) :: x(n), y(n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: alpha_pq
    real(rk) :: nu_00, nu_pq
    call moment(n, x, y, p, q, nu_pq)

          s_pq = s_pq + r8_choose(k+l, l) * r8_choose(p+q-k-l, q-l) &
                   * xi**k * xj**(p-k) * yi**l * yj**(q-l)
        end do
      end do
      nu_pq = nu_pq + (xj*yi - xi*yj) * s_pq
      xj = xi
      yj = yi
    end do

    nu_pq = nu_pq / real(p+q+2, rk) / real(p+q+1, rk) / r8_choose(p+q, p)
  end subroutine moment

  subroutine moment_normalized ( n, x, y, p, q, alpha_pq )
    integer, intent(in) :: n, p, q
    real(rk), intent(in) :: x(n), y(n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: alpha_pq
    real(rk) :: nu_00, nu_pq
    call moment(n, x, y, p, q, nu_pq)
    call moment(n, x, y, 0, 0, nu_00)
    alpha_pq = nu_pq / nu_00
  end subroutine moment_normalized

  subroutine moment_central ( n, x, y, p, q, mu_pq )
    integer, intent(in) :: n, p, q
    real(rk), intent(in) :: x(n), y(n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: mu_pq
    integer :: i, j
    real(rk) :: alpha_10, alpha_01, alpha_ij

    call moment_normalized ( n, x, y, 1, 0, alpha_10 )
    call moment_normalized ( n, x, y, 0, 1, alpha_01 )

    mu_pq = 0.0_rk
    do i = 0, p
      do j = 0, q
        call moment_normalized ( n, x, y, i, j, alpha_ij )
        mu_pq = mu_pq + r8_mop(p+q-i-j) * r8_choose(p,i) * r8_choose(q,j) &
                 * alpha_10**(p-i) * alpha_01**(q-j) * alpha_ij
      end do
    end do
  end subroutine moment_central

  function r8_choose ( n, k ) result(val)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    real(rk) :: val
    integer :: i, mn, mx
    if (k < 0 .or. k > n) then
      val = 0.0_rk
      return
    end if
    mn = min(k, n - k)
    if (mn < 0) then
      val = 0.0_rk
    else if (mn == 0) then
      val = 1.0_rk
    else
      mx = max(k, n - k)
      val = real(mx + 1, rk)
      do i = 2, mn
        val = (val * real(mx + i, rk)) / real(i, rk)
      end do
    end if
  end function r8_choose

    integer, intent(in) :: i
    real(rk) :: val
    if (mod(i,2) == 0) then

    else

    end if

    integer, intent(in) :: m, n, ncc
    integer, intent(in) :: icc(ncc)
    integer, intent(in) :: ccc(n+1)
    real(wp), intent(in) :: acc(ncc)
    character(*), intent(in) :: title
    integer :: i, j, k

    write (*,'(a)') ' '
    write (*,'(a)') trim(title)
    write (*,'(a)') '     #     I     J         A'
    write (*,'(a)') '  ----  ----  ----  ----------------'
    write (*,'(a)') ' '

    if ( ccc(1) == 0 ) then
       j = 0
       do k = 1, ncc
          i = icc(k)
          do while ( ccc(j+2) <= k-1 )

          end do
          write (*,'(2x,i4,2x,i4,2x,i4,2x,g16.8)') k-1, i, j, acc(k)

          do while ( ccc(j+1) <= k )

          khi = ccc(j+2) - 1

             jst(nst) = j

  subroutine candy_count_box_sum ( c, l, m, n, counts )
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: c, l, m, n
    integer, intent(out) :: counts(c)
    integer :: cijk, i, j, k
    counts = 0
    do i = 1, l
       do j = 1, m
          do k = 1, n
             cijk = mod ( i + j + k - 3, c ) + 1
             counts(cijk) = counts(cijk) + 1
          end do
       end do
    end do
  end subroutine candy_count_box_sum

  subroutine candy_count_matrix ( c, m, n, counts )
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: c, m, n
    integer, intent(out) :: counts(c)
    integer :: a, b, nmin, i
    a = mod ( m, c )
    b = mod ( n, c )
    nmin = ( ( m * n - a * b ) / c )
    do i = 1, c
       if ( i <= a + b - 1 - c ) then
          counts(i) = nmin + a + b - c
       else if ( i < min ( a, b ) ) then
          counts(i) = nmin + i
       else if ( i <= max ( a, b ) ) then
          counts(i) = nmin + min ( a, b )
       else if ( i < a + b - 1 ) then
          counts(i) = nmin + a + b - i
       else
          counts(i) = nmin
       end if
    end do
  end subroutine candy_count_matrix

    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: c, m, n
    integer, intent(out) :: counts(c)
    integer :: cij, i, j
    counts = 0
    do i = 1, m
       do j = 1, n
          cij = mod ( i + j - 2, c ) + 1
          counts(cij) = counts(cij) + 1
       end do
    end do
  end subroutine candy_count_matrix_sum

  subroutine candy_count_vector ( c, n, counts )
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: c, n
    integer, intent(out) :: counts(c)
    integer :: n_min, n_rem
    n_min = n / c
    counts = n_min
    n_rem = n - n_min * c
    if ( n_rem > 0 ) then
       counts(1:n_rem) = counts(1:n_rem) + 1
    end if
  end subroutine candy_count_vector

    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: c, n
    integer, intent(out) :: counts(c)
    integer :: ci, i
    counts = 0
    do i = 1, n
       ci = mod ( i - 1, c ) + 1
       counts(ci) = counts(ci) + 1
    end do
  end subroutine candy_count_vector_sum

  integer, parameter :: rk = kind(1.0d0)

  !------------------------------------------
  ! Hard‑coded problem data
  !------------------------------------------
  real(rk), parameter :: center(2) = (/ 0.0_rk, 0.0_rk /)
  real(rk), parameter :: r1 = 1.0_rk          ! inner radius
  real(rk), parameter :: r2 = 2.0_rk          ! outer radius
  integer,  parameter :: n  = 5               ! number of sample points

  real(rk) :: area
  real(rk) :: p(2,n)          ! sampled points
  integer  :: e(2)            ! exponents for monomial integral
  real(rk) :: integral
  real(rk) :: mon_val(n)      ! monomial values at sampled points
  integer  :: i               ! loop index

  !------------------------------------------
  ! Header
  !------------------------------------------
  call timestamp()
  write(*,*) '--- Annulus Monte Carlo Demo ---'

  !------------------------------------------
  ! Compute annulus area
  !------------------------------------------
  area = annulus_area(r1, r2)
  write(*,'(a,1x,f12.6,a,1x,f12.6,a,f12.6)') 'Annulus area (r1 =', r1, ', r2 =', r2, ') =', area

  !------------------------------------------
  ! Generate sample points inside the annulus
  !------------------------------------------
  call annulus_sample(center, r1, r2, n, p)
  write(*,*) 'Sample points (X, Y):'
  do i = 1, n
     write(*,'(i3,2f12.6)') i, p(1,i), p(2,i)
  end do

  !------------------------------------------
  ! Compute integral of a monomial over the unit disk (for comparison)
  !------------------------------------------
  e = (/ 2, 0 /)   ! example: X^2
  call disk01_monomial_integral(e, integral)
  write(*,'(a,i3,a,i3,a,f12.6)') 'Integral of X^', e(1), ' Y^', e(2), ' over unit disk =', integral

  !------------------------------------------
  call monomial_value(2, n, e, p, mon_val)
  write(*,*) 'Monomial values at sampled points:'
  do i = 1, n

  !===================================================================
  function annulus_area ( r1, r2 ) result(area)
    ! Computes the area of a circular annulus in 2D.
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: rk = kind(1.0d0)
    real(rk), intent(in) :: r1, r2
    real(rk) :: area
    real(rk), parameter :: r8_pi = 3.1415926535897932384626434d0
    real(rk) :: value

    if ( r1 < 0.0_rk ) then
       write(*,*) 'ANNULUS_AREA - Fatal error! Inner radius R1 < 0.0.'
       stop 1
    end if
    if ( r2 < r1 ) then
       write(*,*) 'ANNULUS_AREA - Fatal error! Outer radius R2 < R1.'
       stop 1
    end if

    value = r8_pi * ( r2 + r1 ) * ( r2 - r1 )
    area  = value
  end function annulus_area

  !===================================================================
  subroutine annulus_sample ( center, r1, r2, n, p )
    ! Samples n points uniformly in a circular annulus.
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: rk = kind(1.0d0)
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(rk), intent(in) :: center(2)
    real(rk), intent(in) :: r1, r2
    real(rk), intent(out) :: p(2,n)

    real(rk) :: u(n), v(n), theta(n), r(n)
    real(rk), parameter :: r8_pi = 3.1415926535897932384626434d0

    if ( r1 < 0.0_rk ) then
       write(*,*) 'ANNULUS_SAMPLE - Fatal error! Inner radius R1 < 0.0.'
       stop 1
    end if
    if ( r2 < r1 ) then
       write(*,*) 'ANNULUS_SAMPLE - Fatal error! Outer radius R2 < R1.'
       stop 1
    end if

    call random_number(u)
    theta = u * 2.0_rk * r8_pi

    call random_number(v)
    r = sqrt( (1.0_rk - v) * r1 * r1 + v * r2 * r2 )

    p(1,1:n) = center(1) + r * cos(theta)
    p(2,1:n) = center(2) + r * sin(theta)
  end subroutine annulus_sample

  !===================================================================
  subroutine disk01_monomial_integral ( e, integral )
    ! Returns the integral of X^e(1) * Y^e(2) over the unit disk.
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: rk = kind(1.0d0)
    integer, intent(in) :: e(2)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: integral
    real(rk) :: arg
    integer :: i, s
    real(rk), parameter :: r = 1.0_rk

    if ( any(e < 0) ) then
       write(*,*) 'DISK01_MONOMIAL_INTEGRAL - Fatal error! Negative exponent.'
       stop 1
    end if

    if ( any( mod(e,2) == 1 ) ) then
       integral = 0.0_rk
    else
       integral = 2.0_rk
       do i = 1, 2
          arg = 0.5_rk * real(e(i) + 1, rk)
          integral = integral * gamma(arg)
       end do
       arg = 0.5_rk * real( sum(e) + 2, rk )
       integral = integral / gamma(arg)
    end if

    s = sum(e) + 2
    integral = integral * r**s / real(s, rk)
  end subroutine disk01_monomial_integral

    ! Evaluates the monomial product_i x(i)^e(i) at N points.
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: m, n
    integer, intent(in) :: e(m)
    real(rk), intent(in) :: x(m,n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: value(n)
    integer :: i

    value = 1.0_rk
    do i = 1, m
       if ( e(i) /= 0 ) then
          value = value * x(i,1:n) ** e(i)
       end if
    end do
  end subroutine monomial_value

    integer, intent(in) :: m

  end subroutine cdelay2

    integer, intent(in) :: m
    integer, intent(inout) :: q
    if (m < 0) then

       stop

    do while (q < 0)

  t   = 1.0e-8_rk   ! absolute tolerance

  calls = 0_i4

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Call the minimisation routine.
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  f_min = local_min(a, b, eps, t, f, x_min, calls)

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Output results.
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  print *, 'Estimated location of minimum (x) :', x_min
  print *, 'Function value at minimum (f)   :', f_min
  print *, 'Number of function evaluations   :', calls

contains

  !====================================================================
  ! Example objective function:  f(x) = (x‑1)^2 + sin(x)
  !====================================================================
  function f(x) result(res)
    real(rk), intent(in) :: x
    real(rk) :: res
    res = (x - 1.0_rk)**2 + sin(x)
  end function f

  !====================================================================
  ! local_min() – Brent's method for a local minimum without derivatives
  !====================================================================
  function local_min(a, b, eps, t, f, x, calls) result(res)
    real(rk), intent(in) :: a, b, eps, t
    procedure(func) :: f               ! dummy procedure with explicit interface
    real(rk), intent(out) :: x
    integer(i4), intent(out) :: calls
    real(rk) :: res

    ! Local variables
    real(rk) :: c, sa, sb, w, v, e, d, u
    real(rk) :: fx, fw, fv, fu, m, tol, t2, p, q, r

    calls = 0_i4

    ! C is the square of the inverse of the golden ratio.
    c = 0.5_rk * (3.0_rk - sqrt(5.0_rk))

    sa = a
    sb = b
    x  = sa + c * (b - a)
    w  = x
    v  = w
    e  = 0.0_rk
    fx = f(x)
    calls = calls + 1_i4
    fw = fx
    fv = fw

    do
       m   = 0.5_rk * (sa + sb)
       tol = eps * abs(x) + t
       t2  = 2.0_rk * tol

       ! Stopping criterion
       if (abs(x - m) <= t2 - 0.5_rk * (sb - sa)) exit

       ! Initialise parabolic‑step variables
       r = 0.0_rk; q = 0.0_rk; p = 0.0_rk

       if (tol < abs(e)) then
          r = (x - w) * (fx - fv)
          q = (x - v) * (fx - fw)
          p = (x - v) * q - (x - w) * r
          q = 2.0_rk * (q - r)
          if (q > 0.0_rk) p = -p
          q = abs(q)
          r = e
          e = d
       end if

       if (abs(p) < abs(0.5_rk * q * r) .and. q * (sa - x) < p .and. p < q * (sb - x)) then
          ! Parabolic interpolation step
          d = p / q
          u = x + d
          if ((u - sa) < t2 .or. (sb - u) < t2) then
             if (x < m) then
                d =  tol
             else
                d = -tol
             end if
          end if
       else
          ! Golden‑section step
          if (x < m) then
             e = sb - x
          else
             e = sa - x
          end if
          d = c * e
       end if

       ! Ensure step is not too small
       if (tol <= abs(d)) then
          u = x + d
       else if (d > 0.0_rk) then
          u = x + tol
       else
          u = x - tol
       end if

       fu = f(u)
       calls = calls + 1_i4

       ! Update the interval and points
       if (fu <= fx) then
          if (u < x) then
             sb = x
          else
             sa = x
          end if
          v = w;  fv = fw
          w = x;  fw = fx
          x = u;  fx = fu
       else
          if (u < x) then
             sa = u
          else
             sb = u
          end if
          if (fu <= fw .or. w == x) then
             v = w;  fv = fw
             w = u;  fw = fu
          else if (fu <= fv .or. v == x .or. v == w) then
             v = u;  fv = fu
          end if
       end if
    end do

    res = fx
  end function local_min

end program local_min_demo

    implicit none

    real(rk), intent(out) :: integral

    integer :: e1, e2

    e2 = e(2)
    a = (real(e1, kind=rk) + 1.0d0) / 2.0d0
    b = (real(e2, kind=rk) + 1.0d0) / 2.0d0

       xy ( 2, i ) = sin ( pi * xy ( 1, i ) )           ! sample function: sin(πx)
    end do
  end subroutine p00_data

    character ( * ), intent(in)               :: title
    integer :: i, j

       write ( *, '(100F12.6)' ) ( a ( i, j ), j = 1, n )
    end do
  end subroutine r8mat_transpose_print

  subroutine chebyshev_interp_1d ( nd, xd, yd, ni, xi, yi )
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in)                     :: nd, ni
    real ( kind = kind ( 1.0d0 ) ), intent(in) :: xd ( nd ), yd ( nd ), xi ( ni )
    real ( kind = kind ( 1.0d0 ) ), intent(out) :: yi ( ni )
    integer :: i, j
    real ( kind = kind ( 1.0d0 ) ) :: pi, theta
    real ( kind = kind ( 1.0d0 ) ), allocatable :: w ( : )
    real ( kind = kind ( 1.0d0 ) ) :: diff, numer, denom

    !--- Barycentric weights for Chebyshev nodes of the first kind
    allocate ( w ( nd ) )
    pi = 4.0d0 * atan ( 1.0d0 )
    do j = 1, nd
       theta = ( 2.0d0 * j - 1.0d0 ) * pi / ( 2.0d0 * nd )
       w ( j ) = (-1.0d0)**( j - 1 ) * sin ( theta )
    end do

    do i = 1, ni
       !--- Check for exact node match (avoid division by zero)
       do j = 1, nd
          if ( abs ( xi ( i ) - xd ( j ) ) < 1.0d-14 ) then
             yi ( i ) = yd ( j )
             exit
          end if
       end do
       if ( j <= nd ) cycle

       numer = 0.0d0
       denom = 0.0d0
       do j = 1, nd
          diff = xi ( i ) - xd ( j )
          numer = numer + w ( j ) * yd ( j ) / diff
          denom = denom + w ( j ) / diff
       end do
       yi ( i ) = numer / denom
    end do

    deallocate ( w )
  end subroutine chebyshev_interp_1d

    implicit none
    integer, intent(in)                     :: n
    real ( kind = kind ( 1.0d0 ) ), intent(in) :: a ( n ), b ( n )
    integer :: i
    real ( kind = kind ( 1.0d0 ) ) :: sum
    sum = 0.0d0
    do i = 1, n
       sum = sum + ( a ( i ) - b ( i ) )**2
    end do
    r8vec_norm_affine = sqrt ( sum )
  end function r8vec_norm_affine

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Lightning flash‑rate prediction based on cloud‑top height.
    ! This is a direct, free‑form translation of the original WRF
    ! subroutine, with all external dependencies removed.
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    IMPLICIT NONE
    REAL(real64), INTENT(IN) :: dx, dy
    REAL(real64), DIMENSION(ims:ime, jms:jme), INTENT(IN) :: xland, ht
    REAL(real64), DIMENSION(ims:ime, kms:kme, jms:jme), INTENT(IN) :: z, t
    INTEGER,      DIMENSION(ims:ime, jms:jme), INTENT(IN) :: kLNB
    REAL(real64), INTENT(IN) :: cldtop_adjustment
    REAL(real64), DIMENSION(ims:ime, kms:kme, jms:jme), INTENT(IN) :: cldfra_cup
    REAL(real64), DIMENSION(ims:ime, jms:jme), INTENT(IN) :: htop, shall, msft
    INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: ids, ide, jds, jde, kds, kde
    INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: ims, ime, jms, jme, kms, kme
    INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: ips, ipe, jps, jpe, kps, kpe
    REAL(real64), DIMENSION(ims:ime, jms:jme), INTENT(OUT) :: total_flashrate

    REAL(real64) :: dA, zkm
    REAL(real64) :: cldfra_scaling_f, mapfac_scaling_f
    INTEGER :: i, j, k, kbtm, ktop
    CHARACTER(LEN=250) :: message
    REAL(real64), PARAMETER :: baseArea = 1296.0_real64   ! km^2 (36 km × 36 km)

    dA = dx*dy/1.0E6_real64   ! convert m^2 to km^2
    cldfra_scaling_f = 0.0_real64
    mapfac_scaling_f  = 1.0_real64
    total_flashrate = 0.0_real64

    jloop: DO j = jps, jpe
       iloop: DO i = ips, ipe
          mapfac_scaling_f = 1.0_real64 / ( msft(i,j) * msft(i,j) )

          ktop = kLNB(i,j)   ! original value, may be overwritten below
          IF ( shall(i,j) > 0.5_real64 ) THEN
             ! No deep convection – skip this column
             ktop = -1
          ELSE
             ktop = NINT( htop(i,j) )

             ! Find lowest level where cloud fraction exceeds 0.01
             k = kps
             DO WHILE ( cldfra_cup(i,k,j) <= 0.01_real64 .AND. k <= ktop )
                k = k + 1
             END DO
             kbtm = k

             IF ( (ktop - kbtm) > 0 ) THEN
                cldfra_scaling_f = SUM( cldfra_cup(i,kbtm:ktop,j) ) / REAL( ktop - kbtm + 1 )
                WRITE(message,*) ' lightning_cpm: scaling by average cloud fraction (kbotom, ktop) = ', &
                     cldfra_scaling_f, kbtm, ktop
                CALL wrf_debug(15, message)

                IF ( t(i,ktop,j) < 273.15_real64 .AND. &
                     ktop >= kps .AND. ktop <= kpe ) THEN
                   zkm = ( z(i,ktop,j) - ht(i,j) )/1000.0_real64 + cldtop_adjustment
                   IF ( zkm > 0.0_real64 ) THEN
                      IF ( xland(i,j) < 1.5_real64 ) THEN
                         total_flashrate(i,j) = 3.44E-5_real64 * (zkm**4.9_real64) / 60.0_real64
                      ELSE
                         total_flashrate(i,j) = 6.57E-6_real64 * (zkm**4.9_real64) / 60.0_real64
                      END IF
                      ! Scale by cloud‑fraction and map‑factor
                      total_flashrate(i,j) = total_flashrate(i,j) * cldfra_scaling_f * mapfac_scaling_f
                   END IF
                END IF
             END IF
          END IF
       END DO iloop
    END DO jloop

    ! Scale by areal ratio
    total_flashrate(ips:ipe, jps:jpe) = total_flashrate(ips:ipe, jps:jpe) * dA / baseArea

  END SUBROUTINE ltng_cpmpr92z

  END SUBROUTINE wrf_debug

END PROGRAM lightning_demo

    real(dp), parameter :: fpmin = 1.0e-30_dp

    d = 1.0_dp / b

       c = b + an / c

   subroutine ellip(theta_rad, x, y, ox, oy, theta0_rad, majaxis, minaxis)
      implicit none
      real(sp), intent(in)  :: theta_rad, ox, oy, theta0_rad, majaxis, minaxis
      real(sp), intent(out) :: x, y
      real(sp) :: xxx, yyy

      xxx = majaxis * cos(theta_rad)
      yyy = minaxis * sin(theta_rad)
      x = ox + cos(theta0_rad) * xxx - sin(theta0_rad) * yyy
      y = oy + sin(theta0_rad) * xxx + cos(theta0_rad) * yyy

         res = them_i0

         tgtmin = tan(them_i0_rad) / eccen
         themin = atan(tgtmin) * 180.0_sp / pi
         if (cos(them_i0_rad) < 0.0_sp) themin = themin + 180.0_sp
         res = themin
      end if
   end function ellip_limit

  subroutine GAD_OSC_LOC_R(ir, mask, fbar, ohat)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: ir
    real(dp), intent(in) :: mask(lo:hi)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: fbar(lo:hi)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: ohat(1:2, lo:hi)

    real(dp) :: floc(-1:1)

    if (ir > lo .and. ir < hi) then
       ! Interior points
       floc(0) = fbar(ir)
       floc(-1) = floc(0) + mask(ir-1) * (fbar(ir-1) - floc(0))
       floc(1)  = floc(0) + mask(ir+1) * (fbar(ir+1) - floc(0))

       ohat(2,ir) = 0.25_dp * floc(1) - 0.50_dp * floc(0) + 0.25_dp * floc(-1)

    else

          ! Left boundary (ir == -2)
          floc(0) = fbar(ir)
          floc(1) = floc(0) + mask(ir+1) * (fbar(ir+1) - floc(0))

program gad_osc_main
  implicit none

  ! Define kind for double precision
  integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
  integer, parameter :: Nr = 5
  integer, parameter :: lo = -2            ! 1-3 = -2
  integer, parameter :: hi = Nr + 3

  ! Arrays with explicit lower and upper bounds matching original code
  real(dp) :: mask(lo:hi)
  real(dp) :: fbar(lo:hi)
  real(dp) :: ohat(1:2, lo:hi)

  integer :: i

  ! Initialise mask and fbar with representative values
  do i = lo, hi
     mask(i) = 1.0_dp                     ! simple uniform mask
     fbar(i) = real(i, dp) * 0.1_dp       ! linear profile for testing
  end do

  ! Call the driver routine (dummy thread id and indices)
  call GAD_OSC_HAT_R(1, 1, 1, 1, mask, fbar, ohat, 0)

  ! Print a slice of the computed oscillation derivatives
  print *, 'ir', 'ohat(1,ir)', 'ohat(2,ir)'
  do i = lo, hi
     print *, i, ohat(1,i), ohat(2,i)
  end do

contains

  subroutine GAD_OSC_LOC_R(ir, mask, fbar, ohat)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: ir
    real(dp), intent(in) :: mask(lo:hi)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: fbar(lo:hi)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: ohat(1:2, lo:hi)

    real(dp) :: floc(-1:1)

    if (ir > lo .and. ir < hi) then
       ! Interior points
       floc(0) = fbar(ir)
       floc(-1) = floc(0) + mask(ir-1) * (fbar(ir-1) - floc(0))
       floc(1)  = floc(0) + mask(ir+1) * (fbar(ir+1) - floc(0))

       ohat(1,ir) = 0.25_dp * floc(1) - 0.25_dp * floc(-1)
       ohat(2,ir) = 0.25_dp * floc(1) - 0.50_dp * floc(0) + 0.25_dp * floc(-1)

    else
       if (ir == lo) then
          ! Left boundary (ir == -2)
          floc(0) = fbar(ir)
          floc(1) = floc(0) + mask(ir+1) * (fbar(ir+1) - floc(0))

          ohat(1,ir) = 0.50_dp * floc(1) - 0.50_dp * floc(0)
          ohat(2,ir) = 0.0_dp
       end if

       if (ir == hi) then
          ! Right boundary (ir == Nr+3)
          floc(0) = fbar(ir)
          floc(-1) = floc(0) + mask(ir-1) * (fbar(ir-1) - floc(0))

          ohat(1,ir) = 0.50_dp * floc(0) - 0.50_dp * floc(-1)
          ohat(2,ir) = 0.0_dp
       end if
    end if

    real(dp)                          :: rpnts(3, 3*ing)
    real(dp)                          :: fc(3), v1(3), v2(3), v3(3)
    real(dp)                          :: pi, m, mp, de
    integer                           :: i

    pi = 4.0_dp*atan(1.0_dp)
    m  = 0.5_dp*(1.0_dp + sqrt(5.0_dp))
    mp = 0.5_dp*(sqrt(5.0_dp) - 1.0_dp)
    de = sqrt(mp*sqrt(5.0_dp))

    !--- Face centre ----------------------------------------------------
    fc(1) = mp / sqrt(3.0_dp)
    fc(2) = 0.0_dp
    fc(3) = m  / sqrt(3.0_dp)

    !--- Vertices of the reference spherical triangle -------------------
    v1 = [0.0_dp, -mp/de,  1.0_dp/de]
    v2 = [0.0_dp,  mp/de,  1.0_dp/de]
    v3 = [1.0_dp/de, 0.0_dp, mp/de]

    !--- Place original generators --------------------------------------
    do i = 1, ing
      allpnts(:, i) = gens(:, i)
    end do

    !--- Rotate generators about the face centre (2π/3) ----------------
    call ScaleRotate(2.0_dp*pi/3.0_dp, gens, ing, rpnts, 1.0_dp, fc, 3)
    do i = 1, ing
      allpnts(:, ing + i) = rpnts(:, i)
    end do

    !--- Rotate generators about the face centre (4π/3) ----------------
    call ScaleRotate(4.0_dp*pi/3.0_dp, gens, ing, rpnts, 1.0_dp, fc, 3)
    do i = 1, ing
      allpnts(:, 2*ing + i) = rpnts(:, i)
    end do

    call ScaleRotate(-2.0_dp*pi/5.0_dp, allpnts, 3*ing, rpnts, 1.0_dp, v3, 3)
    do i = 1, 3*ing

    end do

    call ScaleRotate( 2.0_dp*pi/5.0_dp, allpnts, 3*ing, rpnts, 1.0_dp, v1, 3)
    do i = 1, 3*ing
      allpnts(:, 6*ing + i) = rpnts(:, i)
    end do

    call ScaleRotate(-2.0_dp*pi/5.0_dp, allpnts, 3*ing, rpnts, 1.0_dp, v1, 3)
    do i = 1, 3*ing
      allpnts(:, 9*ing + i) = rpnts(:, i)
    end do

  end subroutine coarse2sphere

  !=====================================================================
  ! ScaleRotate – rotates a set of 3‑D points about an axis defined by
  !               the vector ''center'' by ''angle'' (radians) and then
  !               uniformly scales the result by ''scale''.
  !   angle  – rotation angle (radians)
  !   inpts  – input points, dimension (3,n)
  !   n      – number of points
  !   outpts – rotated & scaled points, dimension (3,n)
  !   scale  – uniform scaling factor (typically 1.0)
  !   center – axis vector (does not need to be unit length)
  !   dim    – dummy argument kept for compatibility with the original
  !=====================================================================
  subroutine ScaleRotate(angle, inpts, n, outpts, scale, center, dim)
    use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: angle, scale
    integer,  intent(in)  :: n, dim
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: inpts(3, n)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: center(3)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: outpts(3, n)
    real(dp) :: k(3), v(3), v_rot(3)
    real(dp) :: c, s, one_minus_c
    integer  :: i

    ! Normalise the rotation axis
    if (all(center == 0.0_dp)) then
       k = [0.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 1.0_dp]
    else
       k = center / sqrt(sum(center**2))
    end if

    c = cos(angle)
    s = sin(angle)
    one_minus_c = 1.0_dp - c

    do i = 1, n
       v = inpts(:, i)
       ! Rodrigues' rotation formula: v_rot = c*v + s*(k x v) + (1-c)*(k·v)*k
       v_rot = c*v + s*cross_product(k, v) + one_minus_c*dot_product(k, v)*k
       outpts(:, i) = scale * v_rot
    end do
  end subroutine ScaleRotate

!=====================================================================
! Demo program for ZHPMV (complex Hermitian packed matrix‑vector multiply)
!=====================================================================
program zhpmv_demo
    use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
    implicit none

    integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
    integer, parameter :: cp = kind((1.0d0,0.0d0))

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Test data (small 3×3 Hermitian matrix in packed storage)
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    character(len=1) :: uplo
    integer :: n, incx, incy
    complex(cp) :: alpha, beta
    complex(cp), allocatable :: ap(:), x(:), y(:)

    uplo = 'U'
    n    = 3
    incx = 1
    incy = 1
    alpha = (1.0d0, 0.0d0)
    beta  = (0.0d0, 0.0d0)

    allocate(ap(n*(n+1)/2))
    allocate(x(n))
    allocate(y(n))

    ! Upper‑packed representation of the Hermitian matrix
    !   A = [ 1+0i   2+1i   3-1i
    !         2-1i   4+0i   5+2i
    !         3+1i   5-2i   6+0i ]
    ap = [ (1.0d0,0.0d0),  & ! a11
           (2.0d0,1.0d0),  & ! a12
           (4.0d0,0.0d0),  & ! a22
           (3.0d0,-1.0d0), & ! a13
           (5.0d0,2.0d0),  & ! a23
           (6.0d0,0.0d0) ]   ! a33

    x = [ (1.0d0,0.0d0), (2.0d0,0.0d0), (3.0d0,0.0d0) ]
    y = [(0.0d0,0.0d0), (0.0d0,0.0d0), (0.0d0,0.0d0)]

    call zhpmv(uplo, n, alpha, ap, x, incx, beta, y, incy)

    print *, 'Resulting Y vector (real, imag):'
    print *, y

contains

    !=================================================================
    ! Subroutine: ZHPMV – Hermitian packed matrix‑vector multiply
    !=================================================================
    subroutine zhpmv(uplo, n, alpha, ap, x, incx, beta, y, incy)
        implicit none
        character(len=*), intent(in) :: uplo
        integer, intent(in)          :: n, incx, incy
        complex(cp), intent(in)      :: alpha, beta
        complex(cp), intent(in)      :: ap(*)
        complex(cp), intent(in)      :: x(*)
        complex(cp), intent(inout)   :: y(*)

        !--- local scalars ------------------------------------------------
        complex(cp) :: temp1, temp2, one, zero
        integer :: i, info, ix, iy, j, jx, jy, k, kk, kx, ky

        parameter (one = (1.0d0,0.0d0), zero = (0.0d0,0.0d0))

        !--- error checking ------------------------------------------------
        info = 0
        if (.not. lsame(uplo,'U') .and. .not. lsame(uplo,'L')) then
            info = 1
        else if (n < 0) then
            info = 2
        else if (incx == 0) then
            info = 6
        else if (incy == 0) then
            info = 9
        end if
        if (info /= 0) then
            call xerbla('ZHPMV', info)
            return
        end if

        !--- quick return --------------------------------------------------
        if (n == 0 .or. (alpha == zero .and. beta == one)) return

        !--- set up start points in X and Y --------------------------------
        if (incx > 0) then
            kx = 1
        else
            kx = 1 - (n-1)*incx
        end if
        if (incy > 0) then
            ky = 1
        else
            ky = 1 - (n-1)*incy
        end if

        !--- first form y := beta*y ---------------------------------------
        if (beta /= one) then
            if (incy == 1) then
                if (beta == zero) then
                    do i = 1, n
                        y(i) = zero
                    end do
                else
                    do i = 1, n
                        y(i) = beta * y(i)
                    end do
                end if
            else
                iy = ky
                if (beta == zero) then
                    do i = 1, n
                        y(iy) = zero
                        iy = iy + incy
                    end do
                else
                    do i = 1, n
                        y(iy) = beta * y(iy)
                        iy = iy + incy
                    end do
                end if
            end if
        end if
        if (alpha == zero) return

        kk = 1
        if (lsame(uplo,'U')) then
            !--- Upper triangle stored ------------------------------------
            if (incx == 1 .and. incy == 1) then
                do j = 1, n
                    temp1 = alpha * x(j)
                    temp2 = zero
                    k = kk
                    do i = 1, j-1
                        y(i) = y(i) + temp1 * ap(k)
                        temp2 = temp2 + dconjg(ap(k)) * x(i)
                        k = k + 1
                    end do
                    y(j) = y(j) + temp1 * dble(ap(kk + j - 1)) + alpha * temp2
                    kk = kk + j
                end do
            else
                jx = kx
                jy = ky
                do j = 1, n
                    temp1 = alpha * x(jx)
                    temp2 = zero
                    ix = kx
                    iy = ky
                    do k = kk, kk + j - 2
                        y(iy) = y(iy) + temp1 * ap(k)
                        temp2 = temp2 + dconjg(ap(k)) * x(ix)
                        ix = ix + incx
                        iy = iy + incy
                    end do
                    y(jy) = y(jy) + temp1 * dble(ap(kk + j - 1)) + alpha * temp2
                    jx = jx + incx
                    jy = jy + incy
                    kk = kk + j
                end do
            end if
        else
            !--- Lower triangle stored ------------------------------------
            if (incx == 1 .and. incy == 1) then
                do j = 1, n
                    temp1 = alpha * x(j)
                    temp2 = zero
                    y(j) = y(j) + temp1 * dble(ap(kk))
                    k = kk + 1
                    do i = j+1, n
                        y(i) = y(i) + temp1 * ap(k)
                        temp2 = temp2 + dconjg(ap(k)) * x(i)
                        k = k + 1
                    end do
                    y(j) = y(j) + alpha * temp2
                    kk = kk + (n - j + 1)
                end do
            else
                jx = kx
                jy = ky
                do j = 1, n
                    temp1 = alpha * x(jx)
                    temp2 = zero
                    y(jy) = y(jy) + temp1 * dble(ap(kk))
                    ix = jx
                    iy = jy
                    do k = kk + 1, kk + n - j
                        ix = ix + incx
                        iy = iy + incy
                        y(iy) = y(iy) + temp1 * ap(k)
                        temp2 = temp2 + dconjg(ap(k)) * x(ix)
                    end do
                    y(jy) = y(jy) + alpha * temp2
                    jx = jx + incx
                    jy = jy + incy
                    kk = kk + (n - j + 1)
                end do
            end if
        end if

        return
    end subroutine zhpmv

    !=================================================================
    ! Function LSAME – case‑insensitive comparison of single characters
    !=================================================================
    logical function lsame(a, b)
        implicit none
        character(len=*), intent(in) :: a, b
        character :: ca, cb
        ca = a(1:1)
        cb = b(1:1)
        if (iachar(ca) >= iachar('a') .and. iachar(ca) <= iachar('z')) then
            ca = achar(iachar(ca) - 32)
        end if
        if (iachar(cb) >= iachar('a') .and. iachar(cb) <= iachar('z')) then
            cb = achar(iachar(cb) - 32)
        end if
        lsame = (ca == cb)
    end function lsame

    ! Subroutine XERBLA – simple error handler
    !=================================================================
    subroutine xerbla(srname, info)
        implicit none
        character(len=*), intent(in) :: srname
        integer, intent(in)          :: info
        print *, ' *** XERBLA called from ', trim(srname), ', INFO =', info

program rthourly_demo

  real(dp) :: rttlc = 0.0_dp  ! cumulative transmission losses (m^3)
  real(dp) :: rtevp = 0.0_dp  ! cumulative evaporation losses (m^3)
  real(dp) :: rttime = 0.0_dp ! cumulative travel time (hr)

  ch_k(:,1) = (/ 0.0_dp, 0.001_dp /)         ! mm/hr (use second element)
  ch_l2     = 10.0_dp                        ! km
  ch_n(:,1) = (/ 0.0_dp, 0.030_dp /)         ! Manning n (use second element)
  ch_s(:,1) = (/ 0.0_dp, 0.001_dp /)         ! slope
  ch_w(:,1) = (/ 0.0_dp, 20.0_dp /)          ! width (use second element)
  chside    = 2.0_dp                         ! side slope factor (1/2)
  evrch     = 1.0_dp                         ! no adjustment

  phi1      = 100.0_dp                       ! bankfull area (m^2)
  phi6      = 10.0_dp                        ! bottom width (m)
  rchstor   = 0.0_dp                         ! initially empty
  inum1     = 1
  inum2     = 1

  hhvaroute = 0.5_dp

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! Begin translated algorithm
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  jrch = inum1
  inhyd = inum2

  do ii = 1, nhour
     ! water entering reach during hour
     wtrin = hhvaroute(2,inhyd,ii) * (1.0_dp - rnum1)

     ! calculate volume of water in reach
     if (ii == 1) then
        hrchwtr(ii) = rchstor(jrch)

        if (hdepth(ii) < 0.0_dp) hdepth(ii) = 0.0_dp
     else
        hdepth(ii) = sqrt( (hharea(ii) - phi1(jrch)) / 4.0_dp + 25.0_dp * &
                     ch_w(2,jrch)**2 / 64.0_dp ) - 5.0_dp * ch_w(2,jrch) / 8.0_dp
        if (hdepth(ii) < 0.0_dp) hdepth(ii) = 0.0_dp
        hdepth(ii) = hdepth(ii) + ch_d(jrch)
     end if

     ! calculate wetted perimeter
     if (hdepth(ii) <= ch_d(jrch)) then
        p = phi6(jrch) + 2.0_dp * hdepth(ii) * sqrt(1.0_dp + c**2)
     else
        p = phi6(jrch) + 2.0_dp * ch_d(jrch) * sqrt(1.0_dp + c**2) + &
            4.0_dp * ch_w(2,jrch) + 2.0_dp * (hdepth(ii) - ch_d(jrch)) * sqrt(17.0_dp)
     end if

     ! hydraulic radius
     if (p > 0.01_dp) then
        rh = hharea(ii) / p
     else
        rh = 0.0_dp
     end if

     ! rate of flow (Manning)
     hsdti(ii) = Qman(hharea(ii), rh, ch_n(2,jrch), ch_s(2,jrch))

     if (hsdti(ii) > 0.0_dp) then
        ! travel time (hr)

        if (hhtime(ii) < 1.0_dp) then
           rttime = rttime + hhtime(ii)
        else
           rttime = rttime + 1.0_dp
        end if

        ! volume leaving reach (hourly)
        scoef = 2.0_dp / (2.0_dp * hhtime(ii) + 1.0_dp)
        if (scoef > 1.0_dp) scoef = 1.0_dp
        hrtwtr(ii) = scoef * vol

        ! transmission losses
        if (hhtime(ii) < 1.0_dp) then
           hrttlc = ch_k(2,jrch) * ch_l2(jrch) * p * hhtime(ii)
        else
           hrttlc = ch_k(2,jrch) * ch_l2(jrch) * p
        end if
        hrttlc = min(hrtwtr(ii), hrttlc)
        hrtwtr(ii) = hrtwtr(ii) - hrttlc
        rttlc = rttlc + hrttlc

              topw = phi6(jrch) + 2.0_dp * hdepth(ii) * chside(jrch)
           else
              topw = 5.0_dp * ch_w(2,jrch) + 8.0_dp * (hdepth(ii) - ch_d(jrch))
           end if

           if (hhtime(ii) < 1.0_dp) then
              hrtevp = evrch * pet_day/24.0_dp * ch_l2(jrch) * topw * hhtime(ii)
           else
              hrtevp = evrch * pet_day/24.0_dp * ch_l2(jrch) * topw
           end if
           if (hrtevp < 0.0_dp) hrtevp = 0.0_dp
           hrtevp = min(hrtwtr(ii), hrtevp)
           hrtwtr(ii) = hrtwtr(ii) - hrtevp
           rtevp = rtevp + hrtevp
        end if

        ! update storage at end of hour
        if (ii == 1) then
           hhstor(ii) = rchstor(jrch) + wtrin - hrtwtr(ii) - hrtevp - hrttlc
        else
           hhstor(ii) = hhstor(ii-1) + wtrin - hrtwtr(ii) - hrtevp - hrttlc
        end if
        if (hhstor(ii) < 0.0_dp) then
           hrtwtr(ii) = hrtwtr(ii) + hhstor(ii)
           hhstor(ii) = 0.0_dp
           if (hrtwtr(ii) < 0.0_dp) hrtwtr(ii) = 0.0_dp
        end if
     end if

  end do   ! hour loop

  ! post‑processing for the day
  if (hhstor(24) < 10.0_dp) then
     hrtwtr(24) = hrtwtr(24) + hhstor(24)
     hhstor(24) = 0.0_dp
  end if
  if (hrtwtr(24) < 0.0_dp) hrtwtr(24) = 0.0_dp

  rchstor(jrch) = hhstor(24)
  rtwtr   = sum(hrtwtr)
  rcharea = sum(hharea) / real(nhour,dp)
  rchdep  = sum(hdepth) / real(nhour,dp)
  sdti    = sum(hsdti) / real(nhour,dp)

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! Simple reporting of key results
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  print *, '--- Daily Summary (hard‑coded demo) ---'
  print *, 'Final stored volume (m^3)          :', rchstor(jrch)
  print *, 'Total outflow (m^3)               :', rtwtr
  print *, 'Average flow area (m^2)           :', rcharea
  print *, 'Average flow depth (m)            :', rchdep
  print *, 'Average flow rate (m^3/s)         :', sdti
  print *, 'Cumulative travel time (hr)       :', rttime
  print *, 'Cumulative transmission loss (m^3):', rttlc
  print *, 'Cumulative evaporation loss (m^3) :', rtevp

contains

  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  ! Manning's equation – simple implementation
  ! Q = (1/n) * A * R^(2/3) * sqrt(S)
  !-----------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp) function Qman(area, radius, nval, slope)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: area, radius, nval, slope
    if (nval <= 0.0_dp .or. radius <= 0.0_dp .or. slope <= 0.0_dp) then
       Qman = 0.0_dp
    else
       Qman = (1.0_dp / nval) * area * radius**(2.0_dp/3.0_dp) * sqrt(slope)
    end if
  end function Qman

end program rthourly_demo

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------

  end function rline

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Logical function mimicking the macro IS_CUT(k)
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  logical function is_cut(k, lstgrd)
    integer, intent(in) :: k, lstgrd
    is_cut = (k /= lstgrd .and. k /= -1)
  end function is_cut

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Subroutine translated from the legacy source (fixed‑form → free‑form).
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine getYface_gauss(i, jcol, xface, yface, irr, mitot, mjtot, &
       xlow, ylow, dx, dy, lstgrd, num, missing)
    integer, intent(in) :: i, jcol, mitot, mjtot, lstgrd, num
    real(dp), intent(in) :: xlow, ylow, dx, dy
    integer, intent(in) :: irr(mitot, mjtot)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: xface, yface
    logical, intent(out) :: missing

    ! local variables
    real(dp) :: w1, w2
    real(dp) :: x1, x2, y1, y2, yreg
    integer :: k, kside

    missing = .false.

    w1 = 0.5_dp*(1.0_dp - sqrt(3.0_dp)/3.0_dp)
    w2 = 0.5_dp*(1.0_dp + sqrt(3.0_dp)/3.0_dp)

    if (irr(i,jcol) == lstgrd .or. irr(i,jcol+1) == lstgrd) then
       ! face must be regular
       yface = ylow + real(jcol, dp)*dy
       x1 = xlow + (real(i, dp) + 0.0_dp)*dx
       x2 = xlow + (real(i, dp) - 1.0_dp)*dx
       xface = 0.5_dp*(1.0_dp + rline(num))*x1 + 0.5_dp*(1.0_dp - rline(num))*x2
    else if (is_cut(irr(i,jcol), lstgrd) .and. is_cut(irr(i,jcol+1), lstgrd)) then
       ! use bottom cell to find top face
       k = irr(i,jcol)
       yreg = ylow + real(jcol, dp)*dy
       do kside = 1, 6
          if (poly(kside+2,1,k) == -11.0_dp) then
             missing = .true.
             return
          end if
          x1 = poly(kside,1,k)
          y1 = poly(kside,2,k)
          x2 = poly(kside+1,1,k)
          y2 = poly(kside+1,2,k)
          if (x1 == x2) cycle   ! not a y‑face
          if (y1 /= y2) then
             write(*,*) 'screwy side in getYface for cell ', i, jcol
             stop
          end if
          if (abs(y1 - yreg) < dy/1000.0_dp) then
             yface = y1
             xface = 0.5_dp*(1.0_dp + rline(num))*x1 + 0.5_dp*(1.0_dp - rline(num))*x2
             return
          end if
       end do
    else
       ! one or both cells are solid – flag as missing
       xface = 0.0_dp
       yface = 0.0_dp
       missing = .true.
    end if

  end subroutine getYface_gauss

end program demo_getYface_gauss

program test_zcshft
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64

  integer, parameter :: n = 3          ! number of columns to be shifted
  integer, parameter :: offset = 2    ! shift amount (positive => right)
  integer :: lda                       ! leading dimension of A
  integer :: i, j
  complex(dp), allocatable :: a(:,:)

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Determine leading dimension and allocate the array.  The routine
  ! expects the second dimension to be at least N+ABS(OFFSET).
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  lda = max(1, m)
  allocate(a(lda, n + abs(offset)))

  ! Initialise A with identifiable values (real part = row, imag = col)
  do j = 1, n + abs(offset)
     do i = 1, m
        a(i,j) = cmplx(real(i,dp), real(j,dp), kind=dp)
     end do
  end do

  call print_matrix(a, m, n + abs(offset))

  call print_matrix(a, m, n + abs(offset))

  !=================================================================

    integer, intent(in) :: m, n, offset, lda
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: a(lda, *)
    integer :: i, j

    if ((offset == 0) .or. (m <= 0) .or. (n <= 0)) return

    if (offset > 0) then
       ! Shift to the right – start from the last column to avoid overwrite
       do j = n-1, 1, -1
          do i = 1, m

          end do

!=====================================================================
!  Autonomous Fortran 90 program reproducing the logic of subroutine
!  ROOTFR (distribution of dead root mass through the soil profile).
!  All external dependencies are replaced by small hard‑coded data.
!=====================================================================
program rootfr_test
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Parameters (hard‑coded example)
   integer, parameter :: nhrus = 1          ! number of HRUs
   integer, parameter :: max_layers = 5    ! maximum soil layers per HRU
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Global variables that originally came from module PARM
   integer :: ihru                           ! current HRU index
   integer :: sol_nly(nhrus)                 ! number of soil layers per HRU
   real(dp) :: sol_z(max_layers, nhrus)      ! depth of each layer (cumulative)
   real(dp) :: stsol_rd(nhrus)               ! rooting depth for each HRU
   real(dp) :: rtfr(max_layers)              ! fractional root distribution
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   integer :: i

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Initialise a simple test case (single HRU, three layers)
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ihru = 1
   sol_nly(ihru) = 3
   ! cumulative depths (cm) – layer 1 at 10 cm, layer 2 at 20 cm, layer 3 at 30 cm
   sol_z(1,ihru) = 10.0_dp
   sol_z(2,ihru) = 20.0_dp
   sol_z(3,ihru) = 30.0_dp
   ! rooting depth – 15 cm (lies within the second layer)
   stsol_rd(ihru) = 15.0_dp
   ! initialise output array
   rtfr = 0.0_dp

   call rootfr()

   print *, '--- Resulting fractional root distribution (rtfr) ---'
   do i = 1, sol_nly(ihru)
      print '(I2,1X,F12.6)', i, rtfr(i)
   end do

contains

   subroutine rootfr()
      ! Distributes dead root mass through the soil profile.
      implicit none
      !--- Local variables ------------------------------------------------
      real(dp) :: sol_thick(max_layers)   ! thickness of each soil layer
      real(dp) :: cum_rd, cum_d, cum_rf
      real(dp) :: x1, x2, xx1, xx2, xx
      integer  :: k, l, jj
      !--- Parameters of the Normalized Root Density Function ------------
      real(dp), parameter :: a = 1.15_dp
      real(dp), parameter :: b = 11.7_dp
      real(dp), parameter :: c = 0.022_dp
      real(dp), parameter :: d = 0.12029_dp   ! integral of the distribution

      jj = ihru

      l = 0
      k = 0
      cum_d  = 0.0_dp
      cum_rf = 0.0_dp
      cum_rd = 0.0_dp
      sol_thick = 0.0_dp
      rtfr       = 0.0_dp

      do l = 1, sol_nly(jj)
         if (l == 1) then
            sol_thick(l) = sol_z(l, jj)
         else
            sol_thick(l) = sol_z(l, jj) - sol_z(l-1, jj)
         end if

         cum_d = cum_d + sol_thick(l)
         if (cum_d > stsol_rd(jj)) then
            cum_rd = stsol_rd(jj)
         else
            cum_rd = cum_d
         end if

         x1 = (cum_rd - sol_thick(l)) / stsol_rd(jj)
         x2 = cum_rd / stsol_rd(jj)

         xx1 = -b * x1
         if (xx1 > 20.0_dp) xx1 = 20.0_dp
         xx2 = -b * x2
         if (xx2 > 20.0_dp) xx2 = 20.0_dp

         rtfr(l) = (a/b * (exp(xx1) - exp(xx2)) + c * (x2 - x1)) / d

         xx = cum_rf
         cum_rf = cum_rf + rtfr(l)
         if (cum_rf > 1.0_dp) then
            rtfr(l) = 1.0_dp - xx
            cum_rf = 1.0_dp
         end if

         k = l
         if (cum_rd >= stsol_rd(jj)) exit
      end do

      ! Ensure that cumulative fractional root distribution = 1
      do l = 1, sol_nly(jj)
         rtfr(l) = rtfr(l) / cum_rf
         if (l == k) exit
      end do

   end subroutine rootfr

end program rootfr_test

  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  ! Input / output variables
  real(dp) :: FI, LAM, U, V, NORTH, EAST, CONV, KP
  real(dp) :: B, C, D, SGO, CGO, GAMC, CGC, SGC, XI, E, ESQ, LONO, FN, FE

  ! Representative hard‑coded input values
  FI    = 0.5_dp          ! latitude (radians)
  LAM   = 1.0_dp          ! longitude (radians)
  B     = 0.1_dp
  C     = 0.2_dp
  D     = 6371000.0_dp    ! Earth radius (approx.)
  SGO   = 0.3_dp
  CGO   = 0.7_dp
  GAMC  = 0.0_dp
  CGC   = 0.9_dp
  SGC   = 0.1_dp
  XI    = 0.5_dp
  ESQ   = 0.00669438_dp  ! eccentricity squared
  LONO  = 0.0_dp
  FN    = 0.0_dp
  FE    = 0.0_dp

  call skewd(FI, LAM, U, V, NORTH, EAST, CONV, KP, B, C, D, &
              SGO, CGO, GAMC, CGC, SGC, XI, E, ESQ, LONO, FN, FE)

  print *, '--- Skewd results (hard‑coded example) ---'
  print *, 'U     =', U
  print *, 'V     =', V
  print *, 'NORTH =', NORTH
  print *, 'EAST  =', EAST
  print *, 'CONV  =', CONV
  print *, 'KP    =', KP
  print *, 'E     =', E, FI

contains

  subroutine skewd(FI, LAM, U, V, NORTH, EAST, CONV, KP, B, C, D, &
                    SGO, CGO, GAMC, CGC, SGC, XI, E, ESQ, LONO, FN, FE)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: FI, LAM, B, C, D, SGO, CGO, GAMC, CGC, SGC
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: XI, ESQ, LONO, FN, FE
    real(dp), intent(out) :: U, V, NORTH, EAST, CONV, KP, E

    real(dp) :: sinb, cosb, dl, sindl, cosdl, q, r, s

    ! --- Begin original algorithm (converted) ---
    E    = sqrt(ESQ)
    sinb = sin(FI)
    cosb = cos(FI)
    dl   = (LAM - LONO) * B
    sindl = sin(dl)
    cosdl = cos(dl)
    q = (log((1.0_dp + sinb) / (1.0_dp - sinb)) - &
         E * log((1.0_dp + E * sinb) / (1.0_dp - E * sinb))) / 2.0_dp
    r = sinh(B * q + C)
    s = cosh(B * q + C)
    U = D * atan((CGO * r - SGO * sindl) / cosdl)
    V = D * log((s - SGO * r - CGO * sindl) / (s + SGO * r + CGO * sindl)) / 2.0_dp
    NORTH = U * CGC - V * SGC + FN
    EAST  = U * SGC + V * CGC + FE
    CONV = atan((SGO - CGO * sindl * r) / (CGO * cosdl * s)) - GAMC
    KP = XI * sqrt(1.0_dp - ESQ * sinb**2) * cos(U / D) / cosb / cosdl
    ! --- End of algorithm ---

  end subroutine skewd

end program skewd_demo

program insol_demo
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Kind parameters and physical constants (double precision)
  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp), parameter :: pi      = 3.14159265358979323844_dp
  real(dp), parameter :: parfrac = 0.4_dp          ! photosynthetically active fraction
  real(dp), parameter :: solar   = 1360.0_dp       ! solar constant [W m^-2]
  real(dp), parameter :: albedo  = 0.60_dp        ! planetary albedo

  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Input variables – hard‑coded representative values
  !----------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp) :: boxtime   ! current time (e.g. days since start of simulation)
  real(dp) :: sinayr    ! length of the year (days)
  real(dp) :: boxlat    ! latitude in degrees (will be converted to radians)
  real(dp) :: sfac      ! output: solar radiation factor

  ! Example values (feel free to modify for testing)
  boxtime = 100.0_dp          ! day 100 of the simulation
  sinayr  = 365.0_dp          ! one Earth year
  boxlat  = 45.0_dp           ! 45° north latitude

  call insol(boxtime, sinayr, boxlat, sfac)

  print *, 'Input:'
  print *, '  boxtime =', boxtime
  print *, '  sinayr  =', sinayr
  print *, '  boxlat  =', boxlat, '(degrees)'
  print *, 'Result:'
  print *, '  sfac    =', sfac

contains

  !================================================================
  ! Subroutine INSOL – converted to free‑form Fortran 90
  !================================================================
  subroutine insol(boxtime, sinayr, boxlat, sfac)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: boxtime   ! simulation time (same units as sinayr)
    real(dp), intent(in)    :: sinayr    ! length of the year (same units as boxtime)
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: boxlat    ! latitude in degrees – overwritten with radians
    real(dp), intent(out)   :: sfac      ! output factor (W m^-2, limited lower bound)

    ! Local variables
    real(dp) :: dayfrac, yday, delta, sun, dayhrs, cosz, frac, fluxi

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 1. Fraction of the year that has elapsed (radians)
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    dayfrac = mod(boxtime, sinayr) / sinayr          ! fraction of year [0,1)
    yday    = 2.0_dp * pi * dayfrac                 ! convert to angle [rad]

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 2. Solar declination (Fourier series – Paltridge & Parson)
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    delta = 0.006918_dp                                 &
          - 0.399912_dp * cos(yday)                    &
          + 0.070257_dp * sin(yday)                    &
          - 0.006758_dp * cos(2.0_dp * yday)           &
          + 0.000907_dp * sin(2.0_dp * yday)           &
          - 0.002697_dp * cos(3.0_dp * yday)           &
          + 0.001480_dp * sin(3.0_dp * yday)

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 3. Convert latitude to radians (overwrites input latitude)
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    boxlat = boxlat * (pi / 180.0_dp)

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 4. Compute the hour‑angle cosine (sun) – limited to [-0.999,0.999]
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    sun = max(-0.999_dp, min( &
          -sin(delta) / cos(delta) * sin(boxlat) / cos(boxlat) , 0.999_dp))

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 5. Day length (in radians) and mean cosine of solar zenith angle
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    dayhrs = abs(acos(sun))
    cosz   = sin(delta) * sin(boxlat) + &
             (cos(delta) * cos(boxlat) * sin(dayhrs) / dayhrs)
    cosz   = max(cosz, 5.0e-3_dp)      ! avoid division by zero / tiny values

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 6. Fraction of the day that is daylight
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    frac = dayhrs / pi

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 7. Daily average photosynthetically active solar radiation
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    fluxi = solar * (1.0_dp - albedo) * cosz * frac * parfrac

    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    ! 8. Final factor – enforce a small positive lower bound
    !--------------------------------------------------------------
    fluxi = max(1.0e-5_dp, fluxi)

  end subroutine insol

end program insol_demo

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: Y(*)
    integer :: i, ix, iy

    sum = 0.0_dp
    ix = 1

    end do

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: ALPHA
    real(dp), intent(inout) :: X(*)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: TAU
    real(dp) :: alpha0, beta, xnorm, scale
    integer :: i
    if (N <= 1) then

    end if
    alpha0 = ALPHA
    xnorm = dnrm2(N-1, X, INCX)
    if (xnorm == 0.0_dp .and. alpha0 >= 0.0_dp) then

    else

  allocate(iv(0:ii,0:jj))
  allocate(iq(0:ii,0:jj))

    RC = RC * RH

      if ( S .ne. 0 ) return

      ! Copy redtape into the local MINIRT array (simulated here)
      do iu = 1, minirt_len
         minirt(iu) = REDTAPE(iu)
      end do

      ! Determine whether we are dealing with a complex aperture
      comp_flg = ( dtp_mrt .eq. 4 )

      ! Integer part of UV – floor for negative values (FORTRAN behaviour)
      iu = int( UV(1) )
      if ( UV(1) < 0.0_dp ) iu = iu - 1
      iu = max( u1_mrt, min( u2_mrt-1, iu ) )
      deltu = real( UV(1) - real(iu,dp), sp )

      iv = int( UV(2) )
      if ( UV(2) < 0.0_dp ) iv = iv - 1
      iv = max( v2_mrt, min( v1_mrt-1, iv ) )
      deltv = real( UV(2) - real(iv,dp), sp )

      if ( comp_flg ) then
         elm_length = 2
      else
         elm_length = 1
      end if
      row_length = nx_mrt * elm_length

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Out‑of‑range check
      if ( deltu < 0.0_sp .or. deltu > 1.0_sp .or. &
           deltv < 0.0_sp .or. deltv > 1.0_sp ) then
         S = UV_OUTMAP
         value = blk_mrt
         if ( comp_flg ) imag_value = blk_mrt

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Linear interpolation (type 1) – also used near edges for other types
      else if ( (DEGRID_TYPE .eq. 1) .or. &
                (iu-2) < u1_mrt .or. (iu+3) > u2_mrt .or. &
                (iv-2) < v2_mrt .or. (iv+3) > v1_mrt ) then

         data_ptr = (v1_mrt-iv-1) * row_length + (iu-u1_mrt) * elm_length + 1

         a = DATA(data_ptr)
         b = DATA(data_ptr +           elm_length)
         c = DATA(data_ptr + row_length)
         d = DATA(data_ptr + row_length + elm_length)
         e = a + (b-a) * deltu
         f = c + (d-c) * deltu
         value = f + (e-f) * deltv

         if ( comp_flg ) then
            data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
            a = DATA(data_ptr)
            b = DATA(data_ptr +           elm_length)
            c = DATA(data_ptr + row_length)
            d = DATA(data_ptr + row_length + elm_length)
            e = a + (b-a) * deltu
            f = c + (d-c) * deltu
            imag_value = f + (e-f) * deltv
         end if

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Tabulated degridding (type 2 or 3)
      else if ( DEGRID_TYPE .eq. 2 .or. DEGRID_TYPE .eq. 3 ) then

         ! Choose oversampling & half‑width.  For DEGRID_TYPE = 2 the
         ! original defaults are used; for type 3 the values are taken from
         ! C_SPEC (C_SPEC(2)=os, C_SPEC(3)=hw).  If the caller supplies a
         ! non‑zero value in C_PA(1) we treat it as a custom Gaussian sigma.
         if ( DEGRID_TYPE == 2 ) then
            conv_os = conv_os_default
            conv_hw = conv_hw_default
         else
            conv_os = C_SPEC(2)
            conv_hw = C_SPEC(3)
            if ( conv_os <= 0 ) conv_os = conv_os_default
            if ( conv_hw <= 0 ) conv_hw = conv_hw_default
         end if

         conv_pts = 2 * conv_hw * conv_os + 1   ! total number of table points

         ! Build the convolution table on first use
         if ( .not. setup_fn ) then
            call tabfn( 1, conv_os, conv_hw, C_PA, max_pts, conv, s )
            if ( s /= 0 ) then
               call maperr( s, 'TABFN failed' )
               return
            end if
            setup_fn = .true.
         end if

         ! Compute start / end indices for the convolution window
         start_conv_u = nint( ( real(1-conv_hw,sp) - deltu ) * real(conv_os,sp) )
         start_conv_v = nint( ( real(1-conv_hw,sp) - deltv ) * real(conv_os,sp) )
         end_conv_u   = start_conv_u + conv_pts - 1
         end_conv_v   = start_conv_v + conv_pts - 1

         ! Position of the first pixel block that participates in the sum
         data_ptr = (v1_mrt-(1-conv_hw+iv)) * row_length + &
                    ((1-conv_hw+iu)-u1_mrt) * elm_length + 1
         start_row = data_ptr

         value      = 0.0_sp
         imag_value = 0.0_sp

         do conv_v_ptr = start_conv_v, end_conv_v, conv_os
            conv_v = conv( conv_v_ptr )
            do conv_u_ptr = start_conv_u, end_conv_u, conv_os
               conv_val = conv(conv_u_ptr) * conv_v
               if ( DATA(data_ptr) .ne. blk_mrt ) then
                  value = value + DATA(data_ptr) * conv_val
                  data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
                  if ( comp_flg ) then
                     imag_value = imag_value + DATA(data_ptr) * conv_val
                     data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
                  end if
               else
                  data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
                  if ( comp_flg ) data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
               end if
            end do
            ! Step to the next row of the convolution window
            start_row = start_row - row_length
            data_ptr  = start_row
         end do

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      else
         S = ILL_MAPFN
         call maperr( S, 'in routine degrid – illegal DEGRID_TYPE' )
         return
      end if

      RESULT(1) = value
      if ( comp_flg ) RESULT(2) = imag_value

   end subroutine degrid

   !===================================================================
   ! TABFN – creates a 1‑D Gaussian‑sinc window sampled at the required
   ! oversampling rate.  Only the Gaussian‑sinc case (type = 1) is needed
   ! for the original scientific algorithm.
   !===================================================================
   subroutine tabfn( type, os, hw, pars, max_pts, conv, s )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)    :: type          ! 1 = Gaussian‑sinc (original)
      integer, intent(in)    :: os            ! oversampling factor
      integer, intent(in)    :: hw            ! half‑width (pixels)
      real(sp), intent(in)   :: pars(2)       ! optional parameters (unused here)
      integer, intent(in)    :: max_pts       ! size of output array
      real(sp), intent(out)  :: conv(*)
      integer, intent(inout):: s

      integer :: i, npts
      real(sp) :: r, sigma, pi

      ! Standard deviation for the original Gaussian‑sinc function
      sigma = sqrt( 0.5_sp / 0.275_sp )

      ! Number of points needed for the table (must be <= max_pts)
      npts = 2*hw*os + 1
      if ( npts > max_pts ) then
         s = -99
         call maperr( s, 'TABFN: table size exceeds MAX_PTS' )
         return
      end if

      pi = 4.0_sp*atan(1.0_sp)

      do i = 1, npts
         ! r = (i - centre) / os   where centre = hw*os + 1
         r = real( i - hw*os - 1, sp ) / real( os, sp )
         if ( abs(r) < 1.0e-12_sp ) then
            conv(i) = 1.0_sp
         else
            conv(i) = exp( -0.5_sp * (r/sigma)**2 ) * &
                       sin( pi*r ) / ( pi*r )
         end if
      end do

      s = 0
   end subroutine tabfn

   !===================================================================
   ! Dummy MAPERR – prints a message and, for the demo, leaves the error
   ! code unchanged.  In a production environment this would abort or log.
   !===================================================================
   subroutine maperr( code, msg )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: code
      character(*), intent(in) :: msg
      print *, 'MAPERR:', code, trim(msg)
   end subroutine maperr

end program degrid_demo

  a(1,1) = (1.0_dp,0.0_dp)
  a(1,2) = (2.0_dp,0.0_dp)
  a(2,2) = (3.0_dp,0.0_dp)

  ! B matrix (2×2)
  b(:,1) = [(1.0_dp,0.0_dp), (2.0_dp,0.0_dp)]

  print *, '--- Input matrices ---'
  call print_matrix('A', a, m, m)
  call print_matrix('B (before)', b, m, n)

  call ztrmm(side, uplo, transa, diag, m, n, alpha, a, lda, b, ldb)

  print *, '--- Result matrix B (after ZTRMM) ---'
  call print_matrix('B (after)', b, m, n)

contains

  !================================================================
  ! ZTRMM implementation (pure Fortran, no external calls)
  !================================================================
  subroutine ztrmm(side, uplo, transa, diag, m, n, alpha, a, lda, b, ldb)
    implicit none
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: side, uplo, transa, diag
    integer, intent(in) :: m, n, lda, ldb
    complex(dp), intent(in) :: alpha
    complex(dp), intent(in) :: a(lda, *)
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: b(ldb, *)

    integer :: i, j, info
    integer :: iside, iuplo, itrans, idiag, nrowa
    complex(dp), allocatable :: opA(:,:), temp(:,:)

    !--- Parameter decoding ---------------------------------------
    info = 0
    if (lsame(side, 'L')) then
       iside = ileft
       nrowa = m
    else if (lsame(side, 'R')) then
       iside = iright
       nrowa = n
    else
       iside = ileft
       nrowa = 0
       info = 1
    end if

    if (lsame(uplo, 'U')) then
       iuplo = iupper
    else if (lsame(uplo, 'L')) then
       iuplo = ilower
    else if (info == 0) then
       iuplo = iupper
       info = 2
    end if

    if (lsame(transa, 'N')) then
       itrans = inotran
    else if (lsame(transa, 'T')) then
       itrans = itran
    else if (lsame(transa, 'C')) then
       itrans = icotrans
    else if (info == 0) then
       itrans = inotran
       info = 3
    end if

    if (lsame(diag, 'N')) then
       idiag = inonunit
    else if (lsame(diag, 'U')) then
       idiag = iunit
    else if (info == 0) then
       info = 4
    end if

    if (info == 0) then
       if (m < 0) then
          info = 5
       else if (n < 0) then
          info = 6
       else if (lda < max(1, nrowa)) then
          info = 9
       else if (ldb < max(1, m)) then
          info = 11
       end if
    end if

    if (info /= 0) then
       call xerbla('ZTRMM', info)
       return
    end if

    !--- Build the effective matrix op(A) ------------------------
    allocate(opA(nrowa, nrowa))
    opA = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)

    do i = 1, nrowa
       do j = 1, nrowa
          if (iuplo == iupper .and. j >= i) then   ! Upper triangular part
             opA(i,j) = a(i,j)
          else if (iuplo == ilower .and. j <= i) then   ! Lower triangular part
             opA(i,j) = a(i,j)
          end if
       end do
    end do

    if (idiag == iunit) then
       do i = 1, nrowa
          opA(i,i) = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
       end do
    end if

    select case (itrans)
    case (inotran)
       ! no change
    case (itran)
       opA = transpose(opA)
    case (icotrans)
       opA = conjg(transpose(opA))
    end select

  subroutine ztrmm(side, uplo, transa, diag, m, n, alpha, a, lda, b, ldb)
    implicit none

    complex(dp), intent(in) :: a(lda, *)
    complex(dp), intent(inout) :: b(ldb, *)

    if (lsame(side, 'L')) then

       nrowa = n

       nrowa = 0

    else if (lsame(transa, 'T')) then

    do J = 1, N

  integer, dimension(nopn)       :: IOPN   ! open‑shell orbital indices

subroutine GetLatticePoints(t, s, latind, loind, rhind, lhind, &

  implicit none
  integer, intent(in) :: t, s
  integer, intent(out) :: iqtype, i, irhs, ilhs, ilower
  integer, intent(out) :: latind(*), loind(*), rhind(*), lhind(*)

  ilhs   = 0
  ilower = 0

    JMK = IJ - IK
    LF  = IJ + 1
    M   = -IJ

    do M21 = 1, LF
       XD = 0.0_dp

       if (ANGP == 0.0_dp) then
          if (M == IK) XD = 1.0_dp
          go to 200
       else if (ANGP == 180.0_dp) then
          if (M == -IK) XD = PAR((IJ - M)/2)
          go to 200
       end if

       PHIT = -real(M,dp) * PHI / 2.0_dp
       JPM = IJ + M
       JMM = IJ - M
       IS2 = min(IJ - M, IJ + IK)
       IS1 = max(0, IK - M)
       IS1 = IS1 + 1
       IS2 = IS2 + 1

       do IS = IS1, IS2, 2
          PHAS = PAR((IS - 1)/2)
          I1 = JPK - IS + 1
          I2 = JMM - IS + 1
          T = BINOM(JMM/2, (IS - 1)/2) * &
              BINOM(JPK/2, (IS - 1)/2) * &
              BINOM(JPM/2, I1/2)    * &
              BINOM(JMK/2, I2/2)
          T = PHAS * sqrt(T)
          IT1 = (IS - 1) + (M - IK)/2
          T = T * (Y**(IJ - IT1)) * (Z**IT1)
          XD = XD + T
       end do

200    continue
       ctmp = cmplx(cos(PHIT), sin(PHIT), kind=dp) * &
              cmplx(cos(PSIT), sin(PSIT), kind=dp)
       DJ(M21) = XD * ctmp
       DJ(M21) = DJ(M21) * PAR((IK - M)/2)
       M = M + 2
    end do

  end subroutine DJMK

  !===================================================================
  ! Function PAR – returns (-1)^n as a real(dp) number
  !===================================================================
  real(dp) function PAR(n)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    PAR = (-1.0_dp)**n
  end function PAR

  !===================================================================
  ! Function BINOM – binomial coefficient C(n,k) returned as real(dp)
  !   For non‑negative integer arguments; for out‑of‑range returns 0.
  !===================================================================
  real(dp) function BINOM(n, k)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    integer :: i
    real(dp) :: result
    if (k < 0 .or. k > n) then
       BINOM = 0.0_dp
       return
    end if
    result = 1.0_dp
    do i = 1, k
       result = result * real(n - k + i, dp) / real(i, dp)
    end do
    BINOM = result
  end function BINOM

  !===================================================================
  ! Helper to print a complex(dp) array (first n elements)
  !===================================================================
  subroutine print_complex_array(arr, n)
    implicit none
    complex(dp), intent(in) :: arr(*)
    integer, intent(in)     :: n
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, n
       print '(I3,": ",F12.6,SP,F12.6," i")', i, real(arr(i),dp), aimag(arr(i))
    end do
  end subroutine print_complex_array

end program djmk_demo
