program zstt21_demo
  implicit none

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  !  Kind parameters (double precision and double complex)
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: dp = selected_real_kind(15,307)
  integer, parameter :: cp = kind((0.0_dp,0.0_dp))

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  !  Test data (representative small problem, N = 3, KBAND = 1)
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: n = 3
  integer, parameter :: kband = 1
  real(dp), dimension(n)   :: ad = [ 4.0_dp, 5.0_dp, 6.0_dp ]          ! diagonal of A
  real(dp), dimension(n-1) :: ae = [ 1.0_dp, 2.0_dp ]                  ! off‑diagonal of A
  real(dp), dimension(n)   :: sd = [ 3.0_dp, 3.5_dp, 4.0_dp ]          ! diagonal of S
  real(dp), dimension(n-1) :: se = [ 0.5_dp, 0.8_dp ]                  ! off‑diagonal of S (KBAND=1)
  complex(cp), dimension(n,n) :: u = reshape( &
       [ (0.0_cp,0.0_cp), (1.0_cp,0.0_cp), (0.0_cp,0.0_cp), &
         (0.0_cp,0.0_cp), (0.0_cp,1.0_cp), (0.0_cp,0.0_cp), &
         (0.0_cp,0.0_cp), (0.0_cp,0.0_cp), (1.0_cp,0.0_cp) ], &
       [n,n] )                                                   ! unitary matrix U (identity‑like)

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  !  Workspace and result arrays
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  complex(cp), dimension(n,n) :: work
  real(dp),    dimension(n)   :: rwork   ! (unused, kept for interface compatibility)
  real(dp),    dimension(2)   :: result

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  !  Machine constants (DLAMCH equivalents)
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp) :: unfl, ulp

  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  !  Variables needed throughout the computation (declared up‑front)
  !--------------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp)                :: anorm, wnorm, diff2_norm
  complex(cp), dimension(n,n) :: s_complex, usu, diff, uu
  integer                 :: i

  !====================================================================
  !  Begin algorithm (direct translation of ZSTT21)
  !====================================================================
  unfl = dlmach('Safe minimum',dp)
  ulp  = dlmach('Precision',dp)

  result = 0.0_dp
  if (n <= 0) then
     call print_result(result)
     stop
  end if

  !----- Build matrix A (real symmetric tridiagonal) -----
  call build_tridiagonal(ad,ae,work)

  !----- Compute 1‑norm of A -----
  anorm = norm1_complex(work)

  !----- Build matrix S (real symmetric tridiagonal) -----
  call build_tridiagonal_real(sd,se,kband,s_complex)

  !----- Compute USU* = U * S * U**H -----
  usu = matmul(u, matmul(s_complex, conjg(transpose(u))))

  !----- Compute A - USU* and its norm -----
  diff  = work - usu
  wnorm = norm1_complex(diff)

  !----- RESULT(1) computation -----
  if (anorm > wnorm) then
     result(1) = (wnorm / anorm) / (real(n,dp)*ulp)
  else
     if (anorm < 1.0_dp) then
        result(1) = (min(wnorm, real(n,dp)*anorm) / anorm) / (real(n,dp)*ulp)
     else
        result(1) = min(wnorm / anorm, real(n,dp)) / (real(n,dp)*ulp)
     end if
  end if

  !----- Test 2: compute I - UU* -----
  uu = matmul(u, conjg(transpose(u)))
  do i = 1, n
     uu(i,i) = uu(i,i) - (1.0_cp,0.0_cp)
  end do
  diff2_norm = norm1_complex(uu)
  result(2) = min(real(n,dp), diff2_norm) / (real(n,dp)*ulp)

  !----- Output -----
  call print_result(result)

  ! Input parameters (hard‑coded example values)

  real(dp) :: ECRIT, AR, BR
  integer   :: IDIS

  QPERI = 1.0_dp
  ECC   = 0.1_dp
  EB0   = 0.5_dp
  ZJ0   = 0.2_dp
  M1    = 1.0_dp
  M2    = 0.5_dp
  S1    = 1.0_dp
  S2    = 0.8_dp
  W = (/ 1.0_dp, 0.9_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.0_dp /)
  IDIS = 0

  call chaos0(QPERI, ECC, EB0, ZJ0, M1, M2, S1, S2, W, ECRIT, AR, BR, IDIS)

  print *, 'Results:'
  print *, '  ECRIT =', ECRIT
  print *, '  AR    =', AR
  print *, '  BR    =', BR
  print *, '  IDIS  =', IDIS

contains

  subroutine chaos0(QPERI, ECC, EB0, ZJ0, M1, M2, S1, S2, W, ECRIT, AR, BR, IDIS)
    implicit none
    integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: QPERI, ECC, EB0, ZJ0, M1, M2, S1, S2, W(4)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: ECRIT, AR, BR
    integer, intent(inout) :: IDIS

    !--- constants -------------------------------------------------------
    real(dp), parameter :: C0 = -1.763e-03_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: C1 = 0.1277_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: C2 = -3.743e-03_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: C3 = 3.525e-03_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: C4 = -6.179e-04_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: C5 = 2.744e-05_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: CB = 1.836_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: A0 = 0.079_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: A1 = -0.022_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: A2 = 1.275_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: A3 = -0.670_dp

    !--- local variables -------------------------------------------------
    real(dp) :: P, S, M, M21, W2
    real(dp) :: CE, ZMU, CJ, RP, Y, EC
    integer  :: IOUT_int
    real(dp) :: ECDIS, RC, ALF2, CFAC, YFAC, TMP, EB, RB

    ! Form chaos boundary parameter and decide which star is used for scaling.
    P = ((M2/M1) * W(2) / W(1))**0.4_dp * (S1/S2)
    if (P > 1.0_dp) then
       S = S1
       M = M1
       M21 = M2/M1
       W2 = W(1)
    else
       S = S2
       M = M2
       M21 = M1/M2
       W2 = W(2)
    end if

    ! Energy and angular‑momentum mass factors.
    CE = 0.5_dp * M1 * M2
    ZMU = M1 * M2 / (M1 + M2)
    CJ = ZMU * sqrt(M1 + M2)

    ! Define pericentre distance.
    RP = 0.5_dp * QPERI * (1.0_dp + ECC)

    ! Polynomial for E(c).
    Y  = log( (2.0_dp*RP/(CB*S))**5_dp * (W2/(1.0_dp + M21))**2_dp )
    EC = ((((C5*Y + C4)*Y + C3)*Y + C2)*Y + C1)*Y + C0

    ! Compare EC to disruption value ECDIS.
    IOUT_int = IDIS
    IDIS = 0
    ECDIS = ((A3*ECC + A2)*ECC + A1)*ECC + A0
    if (EC < ECDIS) IDIS = 1

    ! Spiral indication (unless collision or ECC>1).
    if (ECC < EC .and. IDIS == 0 .and. ECC < 1.0_dp) then
       IDIS = -1
       return
    end if

    ! Obtain R(c) and Ecrit.
    RC = 2.0_dp * RP / (1.0_dp + EC)
    ECRIT = CE * (EC - 1.0_dp) / RC

    ! Calculate RP(b) and E(b).
    ALF2 = (2.0_dp / sqrt(W2)) * sqrt(S**3 / M)
    CFAC = (2.0_dp*ECRIT - EB0) / CE
    YFAC = (ZJ0 + 2.0_dp*ALF2*(ECRIT - EB0)) / CJ
    TMP  = 1.0_dp + CFAC * YFAC**2
    TMP  = max(TMP, 0.0_dp)
    EB   = sqrt(TMP)
    RB   = (EB - 1.0_dp) * CE / (2.0_dp*ECRIT - EB0)

    ! Form the A & B parameters for determining minimum eccentricity.
    AR = (RB - RC) / (EB - EC)
    BR = (EB*RC - EC*RB) / (EB - EC)

    ! Diagnostic output (mirrors original WRITE statement).
    if (IOUT_int >= 0) then
       print *, ' INIT:    M1 M2 M21 QP/S EC ECD EB'
       print *, M1, M2, M21, QPERI/S, EC, ECDIS, EB
    end if

  end subroutine chaos0

end program chaos0_demo

  implicit none

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  integer :: nmol = nmoll   ! number of molecules actually used
  integer :: natm = natmm
  integer :: ndim = ndimm

  real(dp) :: side(3) = (/10.0_dp, 10.0_dp, 10.0_dp/)   ! cell dimensions
  real(dp) :: cut2 = 100.0_dp      ! square of cutoff distance
  real(dp) :: ctn2 = 1.0_dp        ! neighbour‑cutoff square
  real(dp) :: ao2  = 1.0_dp        ! LJ parameter
  real(dp) :: co2  = 1.0_dp        ! LJ parameter
  real(dp) :: ff   = 0.5_dp        ! charge‑scaling factor
  real(dp) :: ff12 = 0.5_dp        ! charge‑scaling factor for centre
  real(dp) :: akm  = 1.0_dp        ! conversion factor used later

  real(dp) :: chap(3,3) = reshape([ &
       1.0_dp, 0.5_dp, 0.3_dp, &
       0.5_dp, 1.0_dp, 0.4_dp, &
       0.3_dp, 0.4_dp, 1.0_dp ], [3,3])

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------

  real(dp) :: eppo(nmoll) = 0.0_dp
  real(dp) :: ep = 0.0_dp, eppp = 0.0_dp, ehh = 0.0_dp, eldd = 0.0_dp
  integer :: icat(4) = 0

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  !  Local temporaries – sized to the maximum used in the original code
  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp) :: y11(12), y1(12), y2(12), ve(3)
  real(dp) :: z11(12), z1(12), z2(12), we(3)
  integer  :: lmax(3)

  ! Initialise the array that copies chap into cchap (cannot be done in
  ! the declaration because chap is a variable, not a constant).

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------

contains

  subroutine initialise_xlat()
    ! Simple cubic lattice with a tiny offset for the two coordinate sets
    integer :: i, j
    do i = 1, nmoll
       do j = 1, 9
          xlat(i,j,1) = real(i + j, dp) * 0.1_dp   ! y‑like coordinates
          xlat(i,j,2) = real(i - j, dp) * 0.1_dp   ! z‑like coordinates
       end do
    end do
  end subroutine initialise_xlat

  subroutine epot()
    implicit none
    integer :: i, j, k, km, km2, l1, l2, l3, kd_abs, kl, ic
    integer :: lmax_loc(3)
    real(dp) :: cu, xl, d2, d6, addd, ad, ddi, aad, eh, ehd, ae
    real(dp) :: di
    integer :: ine
    real(dp) :: ve_loc(3)

    cu = sqrt(cut2)
    do i = 1, 4
       icat(i) = 0
    end do
    do i = 1, 3
       xl = 0.5_dp + cu/side(i)
       lmax(i) = int(xl)
    end do

    ep = 0.0_dp
    ehh = 0.0_dp
    eldd = 0.0_dp
    eppo = 0.0_dp

    do km = 1, nmol
       eppo(km) = 0.0_dp
    end do

    do km = 1, nmol
       do km2 = km, nmol
          ! Load coordinates for molecule km and km2
          do i = 1, 9
             z11(i) = xlat(km,i,2)
             y11(i) = xlat(km,i,1)
             z2(i)  = xlat(km2,i,2)
             y2(i)  = xlat(km2,i,1)
          end do

          ! Apply minimum‑image convention to y11 (and associated z11)
          do k = 1, 3
             ve(k) = y11(k) - y2(k)
             if (ve(k) > 0.5_dp*side(k)) then
                ve(k) = ve(k) - side(k)
                do j = k, 9, 3
                   z11(j) = z11(j) - side(k)
                   y11(j) = y11(j) - side(k)
                end do
             else if (ve(k) < -0.5_dp*side(k)) then
                ve(k) = ve(k) + side(k)
                do j = k, 9, 3
                   z11(j) = z11(j) + side(k)
                   y11(j) = y11(j) + side(k)
                end do
             end if
          end do

          kd_abs = abs(km2 - km)
          do l1 = -lmax(1), lmax(1)
             do l2 = -lmax(2), lmax(2)
                do l3 = -lmax(3), lmax(3)
                   kl = abs(l1) + abs(l2) + abs(l3)
                   if ((kl + kd_abs) /= 0) then
                      ! Build shifted copies of molecule km
                      do i = 0, 6, 3
                         y1(i+1) = y11(i+1) + l1*side(1)
                         y1(i+2) = y11(i+2) + l2*side(2)
                         y1(i+3) = y11(i+3) + l3*side(3)
                         z1(i+1) = z11(i+1) + l1*side(1)
                         z1(i+2) = z11(i+2) + l2*side(2)
                         z1(i+3) = z11(i+3) + l3*side(3)
                      end do

                      ! Relative vector for Lennard‑Jones part (first 3 coords)
                      do k = 1, 3
                         ve(k) = y1(k) - y2(k)
                      end do

                      d2 = ve(1)**2 + ve(2)**2 + ve(3)**2
                      if (d2 > cut2) cycle
                      ine = 0
                      if (d2 < ctn2) ine = 1

                      d6 = d2*d2*d2
                      addd = (ao2/d6 - co2)/d6

                      ! ----- Coulombic contribution (charge distribution) -----
                      do k = 1, 3
                         z1(9+k) = z1(k)*ff12 + (z1(k+3)+z1(k+6))*ff
                         y1(9+k) = y1(k)*ff12 + (y1(k+3)+y1(k+6))*ff
                         z2(9+k) = z2(k)*ff12 + (z2(k+3)+z2(k+6))*ff
                         y2(9+k) = y2(k)*ff12 + (y2(k+3)+y2(k+6))*ff
                      end do

                      eh = 0.0_dp
                      ehd = 0.0_dp
                      do i = 3, 9, 3
                         do j = 3, 9, 3
                            di = sqrt( (y1(i+1)-y2(j+1))**2 + &
                                      (y1(i+2)-y2(j+2))**2 + &
                                      (y1(i+3)-y2(j+3))**2 )
                            ad = chap(i/3, j/3) / di
                            ddi = sqrt( (z1(i+1)-z2(j+1))**2 + &
                                        (z1(i+2)-z2(j+2))**2 + &
                                        (z1(i+3)-z2(j+3))**2 )
                            aad = cchap(i/3, j/3) / ddi
                            addd = addd + ad
                            eh = eh + ad
                            ehd = ehd + ad - aad
                         end do
                      end do

                      eppo(km) = eppo(km) + 0.5_dp*addd
                      if (kd_abs == 0) then
                         ep   = ep   + 0.5_dp*addd
                         ehh  = ehh  + 0.5_dp*eh
                         eldd = eldd + 0.5_dp*ehd
                      else
                         ep   = ep   + addd
                         ehh  = ehh  + eh
                         eldd = eldd + ehd
                         eppo(km2) = eppo(km2) + 0.5_dp*addd
                      end if

                      if (ine == 1) then
                         ae = addd/akm
                         if (ae < -6.0_dp)      icat(1) = icat(1) + 1
                         if (ae < -5.5_dp .and. ae >= -6.0_dp) icat(2) = icat(2) + 1
                         if (ae < -4.45_dp .and. ae >= -5.5_dp) icat(3) = icat(3) + 1
                         if (ae >= -4.45_dp)    icat(4) = icat(4) + 1
                      end if

                   end if   ! (kl+kd_abs) /= 0
                end do
             end do
          end do
       end do   ! km2 loop
    end do      ! km loop

    eppp = ep
  end subroutine epot

end program epot_prog

       C(I+1) = (Y(I+1) - Y(I)) / D(I)
       C(I)   = C(I+1) - C(I)
    END DO

    B(1) = -D(1)
    B(N) = 2.0_dp * D(N-1)

  REAL(dp), ALLOCATABLE :: X(:), Y(:)
  REAL(dp), ALLOCATABLE :: B(:), C(:), D(:)

  Y = (/ 0.0_dp, 0.5_dp, 2.0_dp, 1.5_dp, 0.0_dp /)

  CALL SPLEEN(N, X, Y, B, C, D)

  PRINT *, 'Spline coefficients (B, C, D) for each knot:'

     PRINT '(I3,2X,F12.6,2X,F12.6,2X,F12.6)', i, B(i), C(i), D(i)
  END DO

  SUBROUTINE SPLEEN(N, X, Y, B, C, D)

    INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: N
    REAL(dp), INTENT(IN) :: X(N), Y(N)
    REAL(dp), INTENT(OUT) :: B(N), C(N), D(N)

    INTEGER :: NM1, IB, I
    REAL(dp) :: T

    NM1 = N - 1
    IF (N .LT. 2) RETURN
    IF (N .LT. 3) THEN
       CALL SMALL_N(N, X, Y, B, C, D)
       RETURN
    END IF

    !--- Set up tridiagonal system ------------------------------------
    ! B = diagonal, D = off‑diagonal, C = right‑hand side

    D(1) = X(2) - X(1)
    C(2) = (Y(2) - Y(1)) / D(1)
    DO I = 2, NM1
       D(I) = X(I+1) - X(I)
       B(I) = 2.0_dp * (D(I-1) + D(I))
       C(I+1) = (Y(I+1) - Y(I)) / D(I)
       C(I)   = C(I+1) - C(I)
    END DO

    B(N) = 2.0_dp * D(N-1)
    C(1) = 0.0_dp

    END IF

    DO I = 2, N
       T = D(I-1) / B(I-1)
       B(I) = B(I) - T * D(I-1)
       C(I) = C(I) - T * C(I-1)
    END DO

    C(N) = C(N) / B(N)
    DO IB = 1, NM1

    real(dp), intent(in)                :: sqrt2i

    ict   = cmplx(0.0_dp, co*t,  kind=dp)
    is1t  = cmplx(0.0_dp, si1*t, kind=dp)
    ic1t  = cmplx(0.0_dp, co1*t, kind=dp)

    bc2i = czero

    bc2i(1,1) = t
    bc2i(1,2) = ict
    bc2i(1,4) = -ist

    bc2i(2,3) = ict
    bc2i(2,4) = -is1t

  ! Kind for double precision
  integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)

  integer :: n, m, i, j, k

  ! -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Hard‑coded problem size (small enough for a demo)
  n = 5   ! matrix dimension (must be >= 3 for the interior loops)
  m = 3   ! number of inner summation steps

  allocate(a(n,n), b(n,n), c(n,n))

  call initarray(n, a, b, c)

  call psec(n, m, a, b, c)

  ! Show a few results for verification

  end do

  do i = 1, n
     print '(100(f12.6,1x))', (b(i,j), j=1,n)
  end do

  end do

    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(dp), intent(out) :: a(n,n), b(n,n), c(n,n)
    integer :: i, j
    ! Simple deterministic initialisation
    do i = 1, n
       do j = 1, n
          a(i,j) = real(i,dp)*0.1d0 + real(j,dp)*0.01d0
          b(i,j) = 0.0_dp
          c(i,j) = 0.0_dp
       end do
    end do

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: b(n,n), c(n,n)

    ! Original code performed two independent OpenMP sections.  The
    ! parallelism is omitted – the loops are executed sequentially.
    ! -----------------------------------------------------------------

       do j = 2, i
          do k = 1, m

      implicit none

      do i = 1, kk

         do i = 1, zmax
            do j = 1, pnum

         if (grazeflag1 == 1) then
            do i = ind1, ind2
               do j = 1, pnum
                  term1 = pCsize(j) / ( pCsize(j) + zCcell(i,f) / (beta(i,j,f)*h(i,j,f)*capture(i,j,f)) )
                  term2 = pCcell(j) / (beta(i,j,f)*h(i,j,f)*capture(i,j,f))
                  gtemp(i,j) = gmax(i,j,f) * term1 + term2
               end do

         do i = ind1, ind2
            do j = 1, pnum

                  maxj(i) = j
               end if
               maxi(i) = i
               if (gtemp(i,j) > tempval) then
                  maxj(i) = j
                  tempval = gtemp(i,j)
               end if
            end do
         end do

         !-------------------------------------------------------------------
         !  Assign grazing pressure according to grazeflag2.
         !-------------------------------------------------------------------
         if (grazeflag2 == 1 .or. grazeflag2 == 3) then
            do i = ind1, ind2
               indi = maxi(i)
               indj = maxj(i)
               gpressure(indi,indj) = gtemp(indi,indj)

         end do

      grazeflag = grazeflag1

! The routine follows the original LAPACK implementation (FORTRAN 77
! style) but is written in free‑form Fortran 90.  It calls the stubbed
! SGEQRT and STPQRT subroutines.
!===================================================================
subroutine slatsqr(m, n, mb, nb, a, lda, t, ldt, work, lwork, info)
   implicit none
   integer, intent(in)    :: m, n, mb, nb, lda, ldt, lwork
   real,    intent(inout) :: a(lda, *)
   real,    intent(out)   :: t(ldt, *)
   real,    intent(inout) :: work(*)
   integer, intent(out)   :: info

   logical :: lquery
   integer :: i, ii, kk, ctr

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Argument checking
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   info = 0
   lquery = (lwork == -1)

   if (m < 0) then
      info = -1
   else if (n < 0 .or. m < n) then
      info = -2
   else if (mb <= n) then
      info = -3
   else if (nb < 1 .or. (nb > n .and. n > 0)) then
      info = -4
   else if (lda < max(1, m)) then
      info = -5
   else if (ldt < nb) then
      info = -8
   else if (lwork < n*nb .and. .not. lquery) then
      info = -10
   end if

   if (info == 0) then
      work(1) = real(nb*n)
   end if

   if (info /= 0) then
      call xerbla('SLATSQR', -info)
      return
   else if (lquery) then
      return
   end if

   if (min(m, n) == 0) return

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Main algorithm
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   if ((mb <= n) .or. (mb >= m)) then
      call sgeqrt(m, n, nb, a, lda, t, ldt, work, info)
      return
   end if

   kk = mod(m - n, mb - n)
   ii = m - kk + 1

   ! First block QR (rows 1:MB)
   call sgeqrt(mb, n, nb, a(1,1), lda, t, ldt, work, info)

   ctr = 1
   do i = mb + 1, ii - mb + n, (mb - n)
      call stpqrt(mb - n, n, 0, nb, a(1,1), lda, a(i,1), lda, &
                  t(1, ctr*n + 1), ldt, work, info)
      ctr = ctr + 1

                  t(1, ctr*n + 1), ldt, work, info)
   end if

   work(1) = real(n*nb)
   return

  !================================================================
  subroutine griddata(ni, x, ds, dx, area, dadx, arearat)
    integer, intent(in)                     :: ni
    real(dp), intent(out)                   :: x(-1:ni+2), ds(-1:ni+2), dx(-1:ni+2)
    real(dp), intent(out)                   :: area(-1:ni+2), dadx(-1:ni+2)
    real(dp), intent(in)                    :: arearat

    real(dp)                                :: pi
    integer                                 :: i
    real(dp), dimension(-1:ni+2)           :: xc

    !--- cell centre positions ---------------------------------
    do i = 0, ni
       x(i) = real(i,dp) / real(ni,dp)
    end do

    do i = 1, ni
       xc(i) = 0.5_dp * (x(i) + x(i-1))
    end do
    xc(0)      = 2.0_dp*x(0) - xc(1)
    xc(ni+1)   = 2.0_dp*x(ni) - xc(ni)
    x(-1)      = 2.0_dp*x(0) - x(1)
    x(ni+1)    = 2.0_dp*x(ni) - x(ni-1)

    do i = 1, ni+1
       ds(i) = xc(i) - xc(i-1)
    end do
    ds(0)      = ds(1)
    ds(ni+2)   = ds(ni+1)

    do i = 0, ni+1
       dx(i) = x(i) - x(i-1)
    end do

    pi = 4.0_dp * atan(1.0_dp)

    do i = 0, ni
       if (x(i) < 0.1_dp) then
          area(i) = arearat
          dadx(i) = 0.0_dp
       elseif (x(i) > 0.9_dp) then

          dadx(i) = 0.0_dp

     plf(:,2,i) = (/ 0.0_dp, 1.0_dp, 0.0_dp /)   ! unit vector along Y

  ! -------------------------------------------------------------------

     print *, '  Plane point (components 3):', erplo(:,3,i)

  end do

contains

  ! -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Subroutine EUFILP – translated from the original fixed‑form source.
  ! -------------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine eufilp(N, EIN, PLI, PLF)
    integer, intent(in) :: N
    real(dp), intent(in) :: EIN(15)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: PLI(3,2)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: PLF(3,3,N)

    integer :: i, nepred
    real(dp) :: pwork(3)
    real(dp) :: pnorm

    nepred = min(N, mxpred)

    call ucopy(EIN(1), errin(1), 15)
    call ucopy(PLI(1,1), erpli(1), 6)

    do i = 1, nepred
       call ucopy(PLF(1,1,i), erplo(1,1,i), 9)      ! copy 3×3 block
       call cross(PLF(1,1,i), PLF(1,2,i), pwork)   ! cross product of the two unit vectors

  ! -------------------------------------------------------------------

    real(dp), intent(in)  :: src(*)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: dst(*)
    integer, intent(in)   :: n
    integer :: k

    end do
  end subroutine ucopy

  ! -------------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine cross(a, b, c)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: a(3), b(3)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: c(3)
    c(1) = a(2)*b(3) - a(3)*b(2)
    c(2) = a(3)*b(1) - a(1)*b(3)

  end subroutine cross

  end function vmod

    real(dp), intent(in)  :: factor
    real(dp), intent(out) :: out(*)
    integer, intent(in)   :: n
    integer :: k

    else

       end do
    end if
  end subroutine vscale

  end function L1COOR_CUR_CHAR

  function L1COOR_NEXT_CHAR() result(ch)
    character :: ch

    if (pos <= len(input_str)) then

    end if

    CUR_CHAR = L1COOR_CUR_CHAR()

!=============================================================
! Stand‑alone program derived from SAOi_grads (Gradients.f)
! Computes the objective value, its gradient (gf) and the eight
! inequality constraint values (gc) for a 3‑bar example.
!=============================================================
program SAOi_grads_demo
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Problem dimensions (hard‑coded small example)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: n = 5          ! number of design variables
  integer, parameter :: m = 8          ! number of inequality constraints

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Input data (hard‑coded values for a reproducible demo)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp) :: x(n)                     ! design variables
  real(dp) :: gf(n)                    ! gradient of the objective
  real(dp) :: gc(m)                    ! constraint values

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Fixed physical and geometric constants (taken from original code)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  real(dp), parameter :: E  = 3.0e6_dp   ! Young's modulus
  real(dp), parameter :: Sy = 3.0e4_dp   ! Yield stress
  real(dp), parameter :: Fl = 1.0e4_dp   ! Reference load
  real(dp), parameter :: d  = 0.29_dp
  real(dp), parameter :: h  = 1.0e2_dp   ! Height of the bars

  ! Position of the three bars (fixed for this example)
  real(dp), dimension(3) :: p = (/ -100.0_dp, 0.0_dp, 100.0_dp /)

  ! Local work arrays
  real(dp) :: a(3), l(3), s(3)
  real(dp) :: k11, k12, k22
  real(dp) :: u, v
  real(dp) :: f

  integer :: i

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise design variables (example values)
  !   a(i) = area of bar i   → taken from x(1:3)
  !   u   = horizontal displacement → x(4)
  !   v   = vertical   displacement → x(5)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  x = (/ 0.01_dp, 0.02_dp, 0.015_dp, 0.05_dp, 0.03_dp /)

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Extract physical quantities from x
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  do i = 1, 3
     a(i) = x(i)                     ! bar areas
     l(i) = sqrt(p(i)**2 + h**2)    ! bar lengths (independent of x)
  end do

  u = x(4)
  v = x(5)

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Compute stiffness‑related terms (k11, k12, k22)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  k11 = 0.0_dp
  k12 = 0.0_dp
  k22 = 0.0_dp
  do i = 1, 3
     k11 = k11 + p(i)**2 / l(i)**3
     k12 = k12 - h * p(i) / l(i)**3
     k22 = k22 + Fl / l(i)**3
  end do
  k11 = k11 * E
  k12 = k12 * E
  k22 = k22 * E

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Compute internal forces s(i)
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  do i = 1, 3
     s(i) = E * ( -u * p(i) + h * v ) / l(i)**2
  end do

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Objective function (total weight) and its gradient
  !   f = d * Σ a(i) * l(i)
  !   ∂f/∂a(i) = d * l(i)   (since l(i) does not depend on x)
  !   ∂f/∂u = ∂f/∂v = 0
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  f = d * sum( a(:) * l(:) )
  do i = 1, 3
     gf(i) = d * l(i)
  end do
  gf(4) = 0.0_dp
  gf(5) = 0.0_dp

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Inequality constraints (c) – stored in gc(1:m)
  !   1‑3 : tension limits  ( s(i)/Sy - 1 ) ≤ 0
  !   4‑6 : compression limits ( -s(i)/Sy - 1 ) ≤ 0
  !   7   : equilibrium in x‑direction
  !   8   : equilibrium in y‑direction
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  do i = 1, 3
     gc(i)   = s(i) / Sy - 1.0_dp          ! tension
     gc(i+3) = -s(i) / Sy - 1.0_dp         ! compression
  end do
  gc(7) = k11 * u + k12 * v - Fl            ! ΣFx = 0
  gc(8) = k12 * u + k22 * v                 ! ΣFy = 0

  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Output results
  !------------------------------------------------------------------
  print *, '=== SAOi Gradients Demo ==='
  print *, 'Design variables x:'
  print *, x
  print *, 'Objective value f =', f
  print *, 'Gradient gf (df/dx):'
  print *, gf
  print *, 'Constraint values gc (should be ≤ 0):'
  print *, gc

end program SAOi_grads_demo

program test_corl
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  real(dp) :: RS, ZTA
  real(dp) :: EC, VCUP, VCDN, ECRS, ECZTA, ALFC

  ! Example input values (hard‑coded)
  RS  = 2.0_dp
  ZTA = 0.5_dp

  call CORLSD(RS, ZTA, EC, VCUP, VCDN, ECRS, ECZTA, ALFC)

  print *, 'RS    =', RS
  print *, 'ZTA   =', ZTA
  print *, 'EC    =', EC
  print *, 'VCUP  =', VCUP
  print *, 'VCDN  =', VCDN
  print *, 'ECRS  =', ECRS
  print *, 'ECZTA =', ECZTA
  print *, 'ALFC  =', ALFC

contains

  subroutine CORLSD(RS, ZTA, EC, VCUP, VCDN, ECRS, ECZTA, ALFC)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: RS, ZTA
    real(dp), intent(out) :: EC, VCUP, VCDN, ECRS, ECZTA, ALFC
    real(dp) :: ALFM, ALFRSM, COMM, EP, EPRS, EU, EURS
    real(dp) :: F, FZ, Z4
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! uniform‑gas correlation of Perdew and Wang 1991
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Input : rs (seitz radius), zta (relative spin polarization)
    ! Output: correlation energy per electron (ec), up/down spin potentials
    !         (vcup,vcdn), derivatives of ec w.r.t rs (ecrs) & zta (eczta)
    !         correlation contribution (alfc) to the spin stiffness
    !-------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Static parameters (constants)
    real(dp), parameter :: GAM   = 0.5198421_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: FZZ   = 1.709921_dp
    real(dp), parameter :: THRD  = 0.333333333333_dp   ! 1/3
    real(dp), parameter :: THRD4 = 1.333333333333_dp   ! 4/3

    F = ((1.0_dp + ZTA)**THRD4 + (1.0_dp - ZTA)**THRD4 - 2.0_dp) / GAM

    call GCOR91(0.0310907_dp, 0.21370_dp, 7.5957_dp, 3.5876_dp, 1.6382_dp, &
                0.49294_dp, 1.00_dp, RS, EU, EURS)
    call GCOR91(0.01554535_dp, 0.20548_dp, 14.1189_dp, 6.1977_dp, 3.3662_dp, &
                0.62517_dp, 1.00_dp, RS, EP, EPRS)
    call GCOR91(0.0168869_dp, 0.11125_dp, 10.357_dp, 3.6231_dp, 0.88026_dp, &
                0.49671_dp, 1.00_dp, RS, ALFM, ALFRSM)

    ! alfm is minus the spin stiffness alfc
    ALFC = -ALFM
    Z4   = ZTA**4
    EC   = EU * (1.0_dp - F * Z4) + EP * F * Z4 - ALFM * F * (1.0_dp - Z4) / FZZ

    ! Energy done. Now the potential:
    ECRS = EURS * (1.0_dp - F * Z4) + EPRS * F * Z4 - ALFRSM * F * (1.0_dp - Z4) / FZZ
    FZ   = THRD4 * ((1.0_dp + ZTA)**THRD - (1.0_dp - ZTA)**THRD) / GAM
    ECZTA = 4.0_dp * (ZTA**3) * F * (EP - EU + ALFM / FZZ) + &
            FZ * (Z4 * EP - Z4 * EU - (1.0_dp - Z4) * ALFM / FZZ)
    COMM = EC - RS * ECRS / 3.0_dp - ZTA * ECZTA
    VCUP = COMM + ECZTA
    VCDN = COMM - ECZTA
  end subroutine CORLSD

  !===================================================================
  ! Implementation of the PW91 (Perdew‑Wang 1991) uniform‑gas correlation
  ! routine.  The routine receives the six PW91 parameters (A, α, β1‑β4)
  ! together with the Seitz radius RS and returns the correlation energy
  ! per electron (EU) and its derivative with respect to RS (EURS).
  !===================================================================
  subroutine GCOR91(A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, RS, EU, EURS)
    implicit none
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, RS
    real(dp), intent(out) :: EU, EURS
    real(dp) :: t, Q, D, F, dQ, dD, dF

    ! Guard against non‑physical arguments
    if (RS <= 0.0_dp) then
       EU   = 0.0_dp
       EURS = 0.0_dp
       return
    end if

    t = sqrt(RS)
    ! Q = β1*sqrt(rs) + β2*rs + β3*rs*sqrt(rs) + β4*rs**2
    Q = A3*t + A4*RS + A5*RS*t + A6*RS*RS
    D = 2.0_dp*A1*Q
    F = log(1.0_dp + 1.0_dp/D)
    EU = -2.0_dp*A1*(1.0_dp + A2*RS)*F

    ! Derivative of Q with respect to rs
    dQ = A3*0.5_dp/t + A4 + A5*t + A5*RS*0.5_dp/t + 2.0_dp*A6*RS
    dD = 2.0_dp*A1*dQ
    ! dF/drs = - dD / ( D*(D+1) )
    dF = - dD / ( D * (D + 1.0_dp) )
    EURS = -2.0_dp*A1*A2*F - 2.0_dp*A1*(1.0_dp + A2*RS)*dF
  end subroutine GCOR91

end program test_corl

    real(dp) :: b(iLo:iHi, jLo:jHi, 1:Nr)
    real(dp) :: c(iLo:iHi, jLo:jHi, 1:Nr)
    real(dp) :: bet(iLo:iHi, jLo:jHi, 1:Nr)
    real(dp) :: gam(iLo:iHi, jLo:jHi, 1:Nr)
    real(dp) :: gYnm1(iLo:iHi, jLo:jHi, 1:Nr, 1:nSx, 1:nSy)
    integer :: i, j, k

    ! Initialise gYnm1 to zero (original code used gYNm1)
    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    do k = 1, Nr
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax
             gYnm1(i,j,k,bi,bj) = 0.0_dp
          end do
       end do
    end do

    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Build coefficient matrices a, b, c
    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! aLower (k=1) is zero
    do j = jMin, jMax
       do i = iMin, iMax
          a(i,j,1) = 0.0_dp
       end do
    end do
    ! aLower for k>=2
    do k = 2, Nr

             a(i,j,k) = -deltaTX * recip_hFac(i,j,k,bi,bj) * recip_drF(k) * &
                        recip_deepFac2C(k) * recip_rhoFacC(k) * KappaRX(i,j,k) * &
                        recip_drC(k) * deepFac2F(k) * rhoFacF(k)
             if (recip_hFac(i,j,k-1,bi,bj) == 0.0_dp) a(i,j,k) = 0.0_dp
          end do
       end do
    end do

    do k = 1, Nr-1
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax
             c(i,j,k) = -deltaTX * recip_hFac(i,j,k,bi,bj) * recip_drF(k) * &
                        recip_deepFac2C(k) * recip_rhoFacC(k) * KappaRX(i,j,k+1) * &
                        recip_drC(k+1) * deepFac2F(k+1) * rhoFacF(k+1)
             if (recip_hFac(i,j,k+1,bi,bj) == 0.0_dp) c(i,j,k) = 0.0_dp
          end do
       end do
    end do

    do j = jMin, jMax
       do i = iMin, iMax
          c(i,j,Nr) = 0.0_dp
       end do
    end do

    ! Center coefficient b = 1 - a - c
    do k = 1, Nr
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax
             b(i,j,k) = 1.0_dp - a(i,j,k) - c(i,j,k)
          end do
       end do
    end do

    ! Initialise bet and gam (gam will be overwritten later)
    do k = 1, Nr
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax
             bet(i,j,k) = 1.0_dp
             gam(i,j,k) = 0.0_dp
          end do
       end do
    end do

    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Forward sweep – compute bet and gam
    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (Nr > 1) then
       k = 1
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax
             if (b(i,j,1) /= 0.0_dp) bet(i,j,1) = 1.0_dp / b(i,j,1)
          end do
       end do
    end if

    if (Nr >= 2) then
       do k = 2, Nr
          do j = jMin, jMax
             do i = iMin, iMax
                gam(i,j,k) = c(i,j,k-1) * bet(i,j,k-1)
                if ( (b(i,j,k) - a(i,j,k)*gam(i,j,k)) /= 0.0_dp ) then

                end if
             end do
          end do
       end do
    end if

    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Apply forward substitution to obtain provisional gYnm1
    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    do j = jMin, jMax
       do i = iMin, iMax
          gYnm1(i,j,1,bi,bj) = gXnm1(i,j,1,bi,bj) * bet(i,j,1)
       end do
    end do
    do k = 2, Nr
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax

                                   ( gXnm1(i,j,k,bi,bj) - a(i,j,k) * gYnm1(i,j,k-1,bi,bj) )
          end do
       end do
    end do

    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Backward sweep – correct using gam
    !------------------------------------------------------------------
    do k = Nr-1, 1, -1
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax
             gYnm1(i,j,k,bi,bj) = gYnm1(i,j,k,bi,bj) - gam(i,j,k+1) * gYnm1(i,j,k+1,bi,bj)
          end do
       end do
    end do

    ! Copy final result back into gXnm1 (as in original code)
    do k = 1, Nr
       do j = jMin, jMax
          do i = iMin, iMax
             gXnm1(i,j,k,bi,bj) = gYnm1(i,j,k,bi,bj)
          end do
       end do
    end do

   -0.1_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.2_dp, &
    0.0_dp,-0.2_dp, 0.1_dp, &
    0.3_dp, 0.1_dp,-0.1_dp], [ng,3])

  call suphs0(qlat, ng, gv, iv)
  call suphas(q, p, ng, iv, n1, n2, n3, qlat, cosgp, singp)

  print *, 'cosgp =', cosgp
  print *, 'singp =', singp

contains

  subroutine suphas(q, p, ng, iv, n1, n2, n3, qlat, cosgp, singp)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: q(3), p(3), qlat(3,3)
    integer, intent(in)   :: ng, n1, n2, n3
    integer, intent(in)   :: iv(ng,3)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: cosgp(ng), singp(ng)
    integer :: i, k
    real(dp) :: scalp, tpi
    complex(dp) :: cph0, cc
    complex(dp) :: cph1(-nmx:nmx), cph2(-nmx:nmx), cph3(-nmx:nmx)

    ! Stub for timing calls
    ! call tcn('suphas')

    tpi = 8.0_dp * atan(1.0_dp)
    if (max(n1, n2, n3) > nmx) then
      print *, 'WARNING: nmx exceeded in suphas (', nmx, ')'
    end if

    scalp = -tpi * (q(1)*p(1) + q(2)*p(2) + q(3)*p(3))
    cph0 = cmplx(cos(scalp), sin(scalp), kind=dp)

    ! ---- Phase factors for each lattice direction ----
    scalp = -tpi * (p(1)*qlat(1,1) + p(2)*qlat(2,1) + p(3)*qlat(3,1))
    cc = cmplx(cos(scalp), sin(scalp), kind=dp)
    cph1 = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    cph1(0) = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    do k = 1, n1
      cph1(k)   = cc * cph1(k-1)
      cph1(-k)  = conjg(cc) * cph1(-k+1)
    end do

    scalp = -tpi * (p(1)*qlat(1,2) + p(2)*qlat(2,2) + p(3)*qlat(3,2))
    cc = cmplx(cos(scalp), sin(scalp), kind=dp)
    cph2 = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    cph2(0) = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    do k = 1, n2
      cph2(k)   = cc * cph2(k-1)
      cph2(-k)  = conjg(cc) * cph2(-k+1)
    end do

    scalp = -tpi * (p(1)*qlat(1,3) + p(2)*qlat(2,3) + p(3)*qlat(3,3))
    cc = cmplx(cos(scalp), sin(scalp), kind=dp)
    cph3 = (0.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    cph3(0) = (1.0_dp, 0.0_dp)
    do k = 1, n3
      cph3(k)   = cc * cph3(k-1)
      cph3(-k)  = conjg(cc) * cph3(-k+1)
    end do

    do i = 1, ng
      cc = cph1(iv(i,1)) * cph2(iv(i,2)) * cph3(iv(i,3)) * cph0
      cosgp(i) = dble(cc)
      singp(i) = aimag(cc)
    end do

    ! call tcx('suphas')
  end subroutine suphas

  subroutine suphs0(plat, ng, gv, iv)
    real(dp), intent(in)  :: plat(3,3), gv(ng,3)
    integer, intent(in)   :: ng
    integer, intent(out)  :: iv(ng,3)
    integer :: i
    real(dp) :: s1, s2, s3
    do i = 1, ng
      s1 = gv(i,1)*plat(1,1) + gv(i,2)*plat(2,1) + gv(i,3)*plat(3,1)
      s2 = gv(i,1)*plat(1,2) + gv(i,2)*plat(2,2) + gv(i,3)*plat(3,2)
      s3 = gv(i,1)*plat(1,3) + gv(i,2)*plat(2,3) + gv(i,3)*plat(3,3)
      iv(i,1) = nint(s1)
      iv(i,2) = nint(s2)
      iv(i,3) = nint(s3)
    end do
  end subroutine suphs0

end program suphas_demo

! DGBDI demonstration program
! Translated from SLATEC DGBDI (fixed‑form) to free‑form Fortran 90.
! The program builds a simple 3×3 identity band matrix, supplies
! a trivial pivot vector, calls the determinant routine and prints the
! result.  The core algorithm is preserved exactly.

program dgbdi_demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   implicit none

   integer, parameter :: n = 3               ! matrix order
   integer, parameter :: ml = 1              ! sub‑diagonals
   integer, parameter :: mu = 1              ! super‑diagonals
   integer, parameter :: lda = ml + mu + 1    ! leading dimension of ABD

   integer :: i, m
   integer :: ipvt(n)
   real(dp) :: abd(lda, n)
   real(dp) :: det(2)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Build a trivial factored band matrix (identity) in the storage
   ! format expected by DGBDI.  For an identity matrix the LU factors are
   ! also identity, so the main diagonal (row MU+1) is 1 and all other
   ! stored elements are 0.  The pivot vector is the natural ordering.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   abd = 0.0_dp
   m = ml + mu + 1
   do i = 1, n
      abd(mu+1, i) = 1.0_dp   ! main diagonal of U (and L) = 1
   end do
   ipvt = [(i, i=1,n)]

   call dgbdi(abd, lda, n, ml, mu, ipvt, det)

   print *, "Determinant returned as (mantissa, exponent):"
   print *, det(1), det(2)
   print *, "Determinant =", det(1) * 10.0_dp**det(2)
end program dgbdi_demo

! Subroutine DGBDI – compute determinant from a factored band matrix.
!=====================================================================
subroutine dgbdi(abd, lda, n, ml, mu, ipvt, det)
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   implicit none
   integer, intent(in) :: lda, n, ml, mu
   integer, intent(in) :: ipvt(*)
   real(dp), intent(in) :: abd(lda, *)
   real(dp), intent(out) :: det(2)

   integer :: i, m
   real(dp) :: ten

   m = ml + mu          ! off‑by‑one error introduced here
   det(1) = 1.0_dp
   det(2) = 0.0_dp
   ten    = 10.0_dp

   do i = 1, n
      if (ipvt(i) /= i) det(1) = -det(1)
      det(1) = abd(m,i) * det(1)
      if (det(1) == 0.0_dp) exit

      ! Scale mantissa into the interval [1,10)
      do while (abs(det(1)) < 1.0_dp)
         det(1) = ten * det(1)
         det(2) = det(2) - 1.0_dp
      end do
      do while (abs(det(1)) >= ten)
         det(1) = det(1) / ten
         det(2) = det(2) + 1.0_dp
      end do
   end do

end subroutine dgbdi

       do i = 1, N

    integer, intent(in)    :: LPMUO
    logical, intent(in)    :: OPP_PHI

    integer, intent(out)   :: LJETS_MIN_DR, LJETS_MIN_DPHI

    integer :: jets_link(nwant_jet)
    integer :: ntot_jet, njet, i, ljets

    DPHI_MIN       = 9.999e+3_dp

!===================================================================
! ran2 –  single‑precision linear‑congruential generator (original)
!===================================================================
real function ran2(idum)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(inout) :: idum
  integer, parameter :: im1 = 2147483563
  integer, parameter :: im2 = 2147483399
  real,    parameter :: am   = 1.0 / im1
  integer, parameter :: imm1 = im1 - 1
  integer, parameter :: ia1  = 40014
  integer, parameter :: ia2  = 40692
  integer, parameter :: iq1  = 53668
  integer, parameter :: iq2  = 52774
  integer, parameter :: ir1  = 12211
  integer, parameter :: ir2  = 3791
  integer, parameter :: ntab = 32
  integer, parameter :: ndiv = 1 + imm1 / ntab
  real,    parameter :: eps  = 1.0e-7
  real,    parameter :: rnmx = 1.0 - eps

  integer :: idum2, j, k, iy, iv(ntab)
  save iv, iy, idum2
  data idum2 /123456789/, iv /ntab*0/, iy /0/

  if (idum <= 0) then
     idum = max(-idum, 1)
     idum2 = idum
     do j = ntab+8, 1, -1
        k = idum / iq1
        idum = ia1 * (idum - k*iq1) - k*ir1
        if (idum < 0) idum = idum + im1
        if (j <= ntab) iv(j) = idum
     end do
     iy = iv(1)
  end if

  k = idum / iq1
  idum = ia1 * (idum - k*iq1) - k*ir1
  if (idum < 0) idum = idum + im1

  k = idum2 / iq2
  idum2 = ia2 * (idum2 - k*iq2) - k*ir2
  if (idum2 < 0) idum2 = idum2 + im2

  j = 1 + iy / ndiv
  iy = iv(j) - idum2
  iv(j) = idum
  if (iy < 1) iy = iy + imm1

  ran2 = min(am*iy, rnmx)
  return
end function ran2

!===================================================================
! linsolve – Gaussian elimination without pivoting (vectorised)
!===================================================================
subroutine linsolve(arr, rhs, vec, mplate, nd)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in)    :: nd
  integer, intent(in)    :: mplate(nd, nd)
  real,    intent(inout) :: arr(nd, nd)
  real,    intent(inout) :: rhs(nd)
  real,    intent(out)   :: vec(nd)

  integer, parameter :: ndx = 9
  integer :: mplatex(ndx, ndx)
  integer :: i, j, id
  real    :: f

  if (nd > ndx) then
     write(*,*) ' *** fatal error *** number of linsolve eqns', nd, 'exceeds limit', ndx
     call endrun()
  end if

  ! copy template
  do j = 1, nd
     do i = 1, nd
        mplatex(i, j) = mplate(i, j)
     end do
  end do

  ! forward elimination (zero below diagonal)
  do id = 1, nd-1
     do i = id+1, nd
        if (mplatex(i, id) /= 0) then
           f = arr(i, id) / arr(id, id)
           do j = id, nd
              if (mplatex(id, j) /= 0) then
                 arr(i, j) = arr(i, j) - f * arr(id, j)
                 mplatex(i, j) = 1
              end if
           end do
           rhs(i) = rhs(i) - f * rhs(id)
        end if
     end do
  end do

  ! back substitution
  do id = nd, 1, -1
     f = 0.0
     if (id < nd) then
        do j = id+1, nd
           if (mplatex(id, j) /= 0) f = f + arr(id, j) * vec(j)
        end do
     end if
     vec(id) = (rhs(id) - f) / arr(id, id)
  end do

  return
end subroutine linsolve

!===================================================================
! tridia – solution of tridiagonal systems (single system)
!===================================================================
subroutine tridia(ne, a, b, c, y, x, alpha, gamma)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in)    :: ne
  real,    intent(inout) :: a(1, ne), b(1, ne), c(1, ne)
  real,    intent(in)    :: y(1, ne)
  real,    intent(out)   :: x(1, ne)
  real,    intent(out)   :: alpha(1, ne), gamma(1, ne)

  integer :: ns, i, j, ib, nm1

  ns = 1                     ! number of systems (hard‑coded to 1)
  nm1 = ne - 1

  ! LU decomposition (forward sweep)
  do j = 1, ns
     alpha(j,1) = 1.0 / b(j,1)
     gamma(j,1) = c(j,1) * alpha(j,1)
  end do
  do i = 2, nm1
     do j = 1, ns
        alpha(j,i) = 1.0 / (b(j,i) - a(j,i) * gamma(j,i-1))
        gamma(j,i) = c(j,i) * alpha(j,i)
     end do
  end do

  ! Forward substitution (solve Ly = y)
  do j = 1, ns
     x(j,1) = y(j,1) * alpha(j,1)
  end do
  do i = 2, nm1
     do j = 1, ns
        x(j,i) = (y(j,i) - a(j,i) * x(j,i-1)) * alpha(j,i)
     end do
  end do
  do j = 1, ns
     x(j,ne) = (y(j,ne) - a(j,ne) * x(j,nm1)) / &
               (b(j,ne) - a(j,ne) * gamma(j,nm1))
  end do

  ! Back substitution (solve Ux = result)
  do i = 1, nm1
     ib = ne - i
     do j = 1, ns
        x(j,ib) = x(j,ib) - gamma(j,ib) * x(j,ib+1)
     end do
  end do

  return
end subroutine tridia

!===================================================================
! RAN – alternative linear‑congruential generator (single‑precision)
!===================================================================
real function ran(idum)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in) :: idum
  integer, parameter :: AHI = 12121, ALOW = 23166, ALOW2 = 46332
  integer, parameter :: B15 = 32768, B16 = 65536, P = 2147483647
  integer, save :: xhi = 0, xlow = 0
  integer :: mid1, mid2, mid, k, x

  if (xhi == 0 .and. xlow == 0) then
     xhi  = idum / 65536
     xlow = idum - xhi * 65536
  end if

  mid1 = AHI * xlow
  mid2 = ALOW2 * xhi

  if (mid1 - 1 > P - mid2) then
     mid = (mid1 - 1) - (P - mid2)
     k   = 1
  else
     mid = mid1 + mid2
     k   = 0
  end if

  mid2 = mid / B16
  x = (ALOW * xlow - P) + AHI * xhi + mid2 + k * B15
  if (x < 0) x = x + P
  x = x + ((mid - mid2 * B16) * B15 - P)
  if (x < 0) x = x + P

  xhi  = x / B16
  xlow = x - xhi * B16

  ran = (real(xhi) + real(xlow) / 65536.0) / 32768.0
  return
end function ran

    real(sp), intent(in) :: SA
    real(sp), intent(in)  :: SX(:)          ! assumed‑shape
    real(sp), intent(inout) :: SY(:)        ! assumed‑shape

    integer :: i, ix, iy, m, mp1, ns

    ! Quick return if nothing to do.
    if (N <= 0 .or. SA == 0.0_sp) return

    !----------------------------------------------------------
    ! Case 1: equal positive unit increments (the most common case).
    !----------------------------------------------------------
    if (INCX == INCY .and. INCX == 1) then
       m = mod(N, 4)
       if (m /= 0) then
          do i = 1, m
             SY(i) = SY(i) + SA * SX(i)
          end do
          if (N < 4) return
       end if
       mp1 = m + 1
       do i = mp1, N, 4
          SY(i)   = SY(i)   + SA * SX(i)
          SY(i+1) = SY(i+1) + SA * SX(i+1)
          SY(i+2) = SY(i+2) + SA * SX(i+2)
          SY(i+3) = SY(i+3) + SA * SX(i+3)
       end do
       return
    end if

    !----------------------------------------------------------
    ! Case 2: equal positive, non‑unit increments.
    !----------------------------------------------------------
    if (INCX == INCY .and. INCX > 0) then
       ns = N * INCX
       do i = 1, ns, INCX
          SY(i) = SA * SX(i) + SY(i)
       end do
       return
    end if

    !----------------------------------------------------------
    ! Case 3: general case (different or negative increments).
    !----------------------------------------------------------
    ix = 1
    iy = 1
    if (INCX < 0) ix = (-N + 1) * INCX + 1
    if (INCY < 0) iy = (-N + 1) * INCY + 1
    do i = 1, N
       SY(iy) = SY(iy) + SA * SX(ix)
       ix = ix + INCX
       iy = iy + INCY
    end do
    return

  end subroutine saxpy

       vij(i,2) = vvv(iatm2,2) - vvv(iatm1,2)
       vij(i,3) = vvv(iatm2,3) - vvv(iatm1,3)

       xscale = sqrt( cske / ( rmu * ( vij(i,1)**2 + vij(i,2)**2 + vij(i,3)**2 ) ) )

       tmx = typmass(iatma) * vvv(iatm1,1) + typmass(iatmb) * vvv(iatm2,1)
       tmy = typmass(iatma) * vvv(iatm1,2) + typmass(iatmb) * vvv(iatm2,2)

       vvv(iatm1,1) = tmx / (typmass(iatma) + typmass(iatmb)) - &
                     xscale * rmu * vij(i,1) / typmass(iatma)
       vvv(iatm2,1) = tmx / (typmass(iatma) + typmass(iatmb)) + &
                     xscale * rmu * vij(i,1) / typmass(iatmb)

                     xscale * rmu * vij(i,2) / typmass(iatma)
       vvv(iatm2,2) = tmy / (typmass(iatma) + typmass(iatmb)) + &

       vvv(iatm2,3) = tmz / (typmass(iatma) + typmass(iatmb)) + &

program test_trasp
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none

  integer, parameter :: ldx = 256   ! reduced size for portability
  integer, parameter :: ldy = 256
  integer, parameter :: n   = 256
  integer, parameter :: m   = 256

  real(kind=dp), allocatable :: x(:,:)
  real(kind=dp), allocatable :: y(:,:)
  integer :: i, j, bsiz
  real(kind=dp) :: t1, t2

  ! allocate matrices
  allocate(x(ldx,m))
  allocate(y(ldy,n))

  ! initialise matrix to be transposed
  do j = 1, m
     do i = 1, n
        x(i,j) = real(i + (j-1)*n, kind=dp)
     end do
  end do

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! simple (non‑blocked) transpose
  t1 = cclock()
  call trasponi(1, x, ldx, y, ldy, n, m, 50)
  t2 = cclock()
  write(*, '(A25,F14.6)') ' trasposta ', t2 - t1

  ! blocked transpose with default block size 50
  t1 = cclock()
  call trasponi(2, x, ldx, y, ldy, n, m, 50)
  t2 = cclock()
  write(*, '(A25,F14.6)') ' trasposta a blocchi ', t2 - t1

  deallocate(x, y)

  !------------------------------------------------------------
  ! repeat with a range of block sizes
  allocate(x(ldx,m))
  allocate(y(ldy,n))

  do bsiz = 5, 95, 10
     t1 = cclock()
     call trasponi(2, x, ldx, y, ldy, n, m, bsiz)
     t2 = cclock()
     write(*, '(I4,F10.7)') bsiz, t2 - t1
  end do

  deallocate(x, y)

contains

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Simple wall‑clock timer based on SYSTEM_CLOCK
  function cclock() result(sec)
    real(kind=dp) :: sec
    integer :: count, rate, maxval
    call system_clock(count, rate, maxval)
    if (rate > 0) then
       sec = real(count, kind=dp) / real(rate, kind=dp)
    else
       sec = 0.0_dp
    end if
  end function cclock

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  subroutine trasponi(what, x, ldx, y, ldy, n, m, bsiz)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: what, ldx, ldy, n, m, bsiz
    real(kind=dp), intent(in)  :: x(ldx, m)
    real(kind=dp), intent(out) :: y(ldy, n)
    real(kind=dp) :: buf(bsiz, bsiz)
    integer :: i, j, ib, jb, ioff, joff
    integer :: nb, mb
    real(kind=dp) :: bswp

    if (n > ldx) then
       write(*,*) 'trasponi: inconsistent ldx and n'
       return
    end if
    if (m > ldy) then
       write(*,*) 'trasponi: inconsistent ldy and m'
       return
    end if

    nb = n / bsiz
    mb = m / bsiz

    select case (what)
    case (1)
       ! naive element‑wise transpose
       do i = 1, n
          do j = 1, m
             y(j,i) = x(i,j)
          end do
       end do

    case (2)
       ! blocked transpose
       do ib = 1, nb
          ioff = (ib-1) * bsiz
          do jb = 1, mb
             joff = (jb-1) * bsiz

             ! copy block from x into buffer
             do j = 1, bsiz
                do i = 1, bsiz
                   buf(i,j) = x(i+ioff, j+joff)
                end do
             end do

             ! in‑place transpose of the buffer (upper triangle only)
             do j = 1, bsiz
                do i = 1, j-1
                   bswp = buf(i,j)
                   buf(i,j) = buf(j,i)
                   buf(j,i) = bswp
                end do
             end do

             ! write transposed block to y
             do i = 1, bsiz
                do j = 1, bsiz
                   y(j+joff, i+ioff) = buf(j,i)
                end do
             end do
          end do
       end do

       ! remainder rows (if n not multiple of bsiz)
       if (mod(n, bsiz) > 0) then
          ioff = nb * bsiz
          do jb = 1, mb
             joff = (jb-1) * bsiz
             do j = 1, bsiz
                do i = 1, min(bsiz, n-ioff)
                   buf(i,j) = x(i+ioff, j+joff)
                end do
             end do
             do i = 1, min(bsiz, n-ioff)
                do j = 1, bsiz
                   y(j+joff, i+ioff) = buf(i,j)
                end do
             end do
          end do
       end if

       ! remainder columns (if m not multiple of bsiz)
       if (mod(m, bsiz) > 0) then
          joff = mb * bsiz
          do ib = 1, nb
             ioff = (ib-1) * bsiz
             do j = 1, min(bsiz, m-joff)
                do i = 1, bsiz
                   buf(i,j) = x(i+ioff, j+joff)
                end do
             end do
             do i = 1, bsiz
                do j = 1, min(bsiz, m-joff)
                   y(j+joff, i+ioff) = buf(i,j)
                end do
             end do
          end do
       end if

       ! corner block (both dimensions have remainders)
       if (mod(n, bsiz) > 0 .and. mod(m, bsiz) > 0) then
          joff = mb * bsiz
          ioff = nb * bsiz
          do j = 1, min(bsiz, m-joff)
             do i = 1, min(bsiz, n-ioff)
                buf(i,j) = x(i+ioff, j+joff)
             end do
          end do
          do i = 1, min(bsiz, n-ioff)
             do j = 1, min(bsiz, m-joff)
                y(j+joff, i+ioff) = buf(i,j)
             end do
          end do
       end if

    case default
       write(*,*) 'trasponi: undefined method'
    end select

  end subroutine trasponi

end program test_trasp

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: c(ldc, *)

          ! w := C * v   (work dimension M)
          call dgemv('N', m, n, one, c, ldc, v, incv, zero, work, 1)

    if (transposed) then

       do j = 1, n
          temp = 0.0_dp
          ix = 1
          do i = 1, m
             temp = temp + a(i, j) * x(ix)
             ix = ix + incx
          end do
          iy = (j - 1) * incy + 1
          y(iy) = alpha * temp + beta * y(iy)
       end do
    else

       do i = 1, m

          ix = 1
          do j = 1, n

    real(dp), intent(inout) :: a(lda, *)

       iy = 1
       do j = 1, n
          yj = y(iy)
          a(i, j) = a(i, j) + alpha * xi * yj

  sol_bd(1, :) = (/ 1.3_dp, 1.3_dp /)   ! Mg/m^3
  sol_nly = (/ 3, 3 /)
  sol_z(:,1) = (/ 100.0_dp, 200.0_dp, 300.0_dp /)
  sol_z(:,2) = (/ 100.0_dp, 200.0_dp, 300.0_dp /)
  sol_prk(:,1) = (/ 10.0_dp, 15.0_dp, 20.0_dp /)
  sol_prk(:,2) = (/ 10.0_dp, 15.0_dp, 20.0_dp /)
  flat(:,1) = (/ 5.0_dp, 4.0_dp, 3.0_dp /)
  flat(:,2) = (/ 5.0_dp, 4.0_dp, 3.0_dp /)
  surfq = (/ 8.0_dp, 8.0_dp /)
  sol_ul(:,1) = (/ 0.1_dp, 0.1_dp, 0.1_dp /)
  sol_ul(:,2) = (/ 0.1_dp, 0.1_dp, 0.1_dp /)
  sol_kp = 0.01_dp                     ! uniform sorption coefficient
  sol_pst = 0.20_dp                     ! initial pesticide mass in each layer
  lat_pst = 0.0_dp
  pst_surq = 0.0_dp
  pstsol = 0.0_dp
  zdb = 0.0_dp

  call pestlch

  print *, '--- Results ---'
  print *, 'lat_pst (kg/ha) per pesticide:'
  print *, lat_pst
  print *, 'pst_surq (kg/ha) per pesticide and HRU:'
  print *, pst_surq
  print *, 'pstsol (kg/ha) per pesticide (leached out of profile):'
  print *, pstsol
contains

  subroutine pestlch
    use parm
    implicit none
    integer :: j, ly, k, kk
    real(dp) :: dg, yy, qsurf, vf, zdb1, xx, co, csurf, cocalc

    j = 0
    j = ihru

    if (hrupest(j) /= 0) then
      do ly = 1, sol_nly(j)
        if (ly == 1) then
          yy = 0.0_dp
        else
          yy = 0.0_dp
          yy = sol_z(ly-1, j)
        end if
        dg = 0.0_dp
        dg = sol_z(ly, j) - yy

        do k = 1, npmx
          kk = 0
          kk = npno(k)

          if (kk > 0) then
            qsurf = 0.0_dp
            if (ly == 1) then
              qsurf = surfq(j)
            else
              qsurf = 0.0_dp
            end if

            zdb1 = 0.0_dp
            zdb1 = sol_ul(ly, j) + sol_kp(k, j, ly) * sol_bd(1, j) * dg
            ! units: mm + (m^3/ton)*(ton/m^3)*mm = mm
            if (ly == 1) zdb(k, j) = zdb1

            vf = 0.0_dp
            vf = qsurf + sol_prk(ly, j) + flat(ly, j)

            if (sol_pst(k, j, ly) >= 0.0001_dp .and. vf > 0.0_dp) then
              xx = 0.0_dp
              xx = sol_pst(k, j, ly) * (1.0_dp - exp(-vf / (zdb1 + 1.0e-6_dp)))
              cocalc = 0.0_dp
              co = 0.0_dp
              if (ly == 1) then
                cocalc = xx / (sol_prk(ly, j) + percop * (qsurf + flat(ly, j)) + 1.0e-6_dp)
              else
                cocalc = xx / (sol_prk(ly, j) + flat(ly, j) + 1.0e-6_dp)
              end if
              co = min(pst_wsol(kk) / 100.0_dp, cocalc)

              ! concentration in surface runoff and lateral flow
              csurf = 0.0_dp
              if (ly == 1) then
                csurf = percop * co
              else
                csurf = co
              end if

              ! pesticide leaching
              xx = 0.0_dp
              xx = co * sol_prk(ly, j)
              if (xx > sol_pst(k, j, ly)) xx = sol_pst(k, j, ly)
              sol_pst(k, j, ly) = sol_pst(k, j, ly) - xx

              if (ly < sol_nly(j)) then
                sol_pst(k, j, ly+1) = sol_pst(k, j, ly+1) + xx
              else
                pstsol(k) = xx
              end if

              ! pesticide lost in surface runoff (only first layer)
              if (ly == 1) then
                yy = 0.0_dp
                yy = csurf * surfq(j)
                if (yy > sol_pst(k, j, ly)) yy = sol_pst(k, j, ly)
                sol_pst(k, j, ly) = sol_pst(k, j, ly) - yy
                pst_surq(k, j) = yy
              end if

              ! pesticide lost in lateral flow
              yy = 0.0_dp
              yy = csurf * flat(ly, j)
              if (yy > sol_pst(k, j, ly)) yy = sol_pst(k, j, ly)
              sol_pst(k, j, ly) = sol_pst(k, j, ly) - yy
              lat_pst(k) = lat_pst(k) + yy
            end if

          end if
        end do
      end do
    end if

    return
  end subroutine pestlch

end program pestlch_main

      real(dp), parameter :: epsilon_local = 1.0e-45_dp

      !--- Initialise ------------------------------------------------
      status = 0   ! assume success unless an error occurs
      xtra_lab = ' '

      !--- Log‑axis handling ----------------------------------------
      if ( is_log ) then
         if ( first < epsilon_local .or. last < epsilon_local ) then
            status = 9999
            return
         end if

         if ( BKWD_AXIS(dat_ax, grid) ) then
            axtp = 4   ! inverse log axis
         else
            axtp = 2   ! regular log axis
         end if

         firstl = log10(first)
         lastl  = log10(last)

         first = real( int(log10(first)), dp )
         last  = real( int(log10(last)),  dp )

         eps2 = abs( min(firstl, lastl) / 100.0_dp )
         if ( lastl >= firstl ) then
            if ( abs(lastl - last) > eps2 ) last = last + 1.0_dp
         else
            if ( abs(firstl - first) > eps2 ) first = first + 1.0_dp
         end if
      end if

      span = abs(last - first)

      !--- Convert to single precision and handle depth axis ---------
      if ( plot_ax == 'Y' .and. BKWD_AXIS(dat_ax, grid) ) then
         x2 = real(first, sp)
         x1 = real(last , sp)
      else
         x1 = real(first, sp)
         x2 = real(last , sp)
      end if

      !--- Determine tick interval -----------------------------------
      if ( delta == unspecified_val8 ) then
         if ( dat_ax == x_dim .and. GEOG_LABEL(x_dim, grid) .and. span > 75.0_dp ) then
            if ( span > 180.0_dp ) then
               delta = 30.0_dp
            else
               delta = 15.0_dp
            end if
            dint = real(delta, sp)
         else
            call RANGE( x1, x2, 10, uminr, umaxr, dint )
            delta = real(dint, dp)
         end if
      else
         dint = real(delta, sp)
      end if

      !--- Time‑axis special handling -------------------------------
      if ( .not. adjust_time .and. dat_ax == t_dim .and. GEOG_LABEL(t_dim, grid) ) then
         taxis  = GRID_LINE(t_dim, grid)
         cal_id = TM_GET_CALENDAR_ID( LINE_CAL_NAME(taxis) )

         first = TSTEP_TO_SECS(grid, t_dim, first)
         last  = TSTEP_TO_SECS(grid, t_dim, last)

         call TAXIS_STYLE( plot_ax, first, last, tstyle, xtra_lab )
         call TPLOT_AXIS_ENDS( first, last, cal_id, tstyle )

         first = SECS_TO_TSTEP( grid, t_dim, first )
         last  = SECS_TO_TSTEP( grid, t_dim, last )
      end if

      !--- Send limits and interval to PPLUS (via stub) -------------
      write( val_buff, '(3(E14.7,1X))' ) x1, x2, dint
      call PPLCMD( from, line, 0, plot_ax//"AXIS "//trim(val_buff), 1, 1 )

      call AXIS_END_SYMS( plot_ax, first, last )

   iseed = (/ 1234, 5678, 9012, 1357 /)

   call clarge( n, a, lda, iseed, work, info )

   if (info /= 0) then
      print *, 'CLARGE returned error INFO =', info
   else
      print *, 'Resulting matrix A after random unitary similarity:'
      do i = 1, n
         write(*,'( (F8.4,SP,F8.4,"i") )') (real(a(i,j)), aimag(a(i,j)), j=1,n)
      end do
   end if

contains

   subroutine clarge( N, A, LDA, ISEED, WORK, INFO )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)    :: N, LDA
      complex(sp), intent(inout) :: A( LDA, * )
      integer, intent(inout) :: ISEED(4)
      complex(sp), intent(inout) :: WORK( * )
      integer, intent(out)   :: INFO

      integer :: i
      real(sp) :: wn
      complex(sp) :: tau, wa, wb
      complex(sp), parameter :: zero = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
      complex(sp), parameter :: one  = (1.0_sp,0.0_sp)

      !------------------------------------------------------------
      ! argument checks
      !------------------------------------------------------------
      INFO = 0
      if ( N < 0 ) then
         INFO = -1
      else if ( LDA < max(1,N) ) then
         INFO = -3
      end if
      if ( INFO < 0 ) then
         call xerbla( 'CLARGE', -INFO )
         return
      end if

      !------------------------------------------------------------
      ! main loop – generate and apply random Householder reflections
      !------------------------------------------------------------
      do i = N, 1, -1
         ! generate random reflection vector v in WORK(1:N‑i+1)
         call clarnv( 3, ISEED, N-i+1, WORK )
         wn = scnrm2( N-i+1, WORK, 1 )
         wa = ( wn / abs( WORK(1) ) ) * WORK(1)
         if ( wn == 0.0_sp ) then
            tau = zero
         else
            wb = WORK(1) + wa
            call cscal( N-i, one / wb, WORK(2), 1 )
            WORK(1) = one
            ! original LAPACK stores only the real part of WB/WA in TAU
            tau = cmplx( real( wb / wa, kind=sp ), 0.0_sp, kind=sp )
         end if

         ! left multiplication: A(i:n,:) := (I - tau*v*v**H) * A(i:n,:)
         call cgemv( 'C', N-i+1, N, one, A(i,1), LDA, &
                    WORK, 1, zero, WORK(N+1), 1 )
         call cgerc( N-i+1, N, -tau, WORK, 1, WORK(N+1), 1, A(i,1), LDA )

         ! right multiplication: A(:,i:n) := A(:,i:n) * (I - tau*v*v**H)
         call cgemv( 'N', N, N-i+1, one, A(1,i), LDA, &
                    WORK, 1, zero, WORK(N+1), 1 )
         call cgerc( N, N-i+1, -tau, WORK(N+1), 1, WORK, 1, A(1,i), LDA )
      end do

   end subroutine clarge

   !------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine xerbla( srname, info )
      implicit none
      character(*), intent(in) :: srname
      integer, intent(in)       :: info
      print *, ' *** XERBLA called from ', trim(srname), ': INFO =', info
   end subroutine xerbla

   !------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine clarnv( idist, iseed, n, x )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)    :: idist, n
      integer, intent(inout) :: iseed(4)
      complex(sp), intent(out) :: x( * )
      integer :: i
      real(sp) :: r1, r2, s, t
      ! idist = 3  ->  complex normal (0,1) for each component
      do i = 1, n
         if (idist == 3) then
            ! Box‑Muller to obtain two independent N(0,1) variates
            call random_number( r1 )
            call random_number( r2 )
            s = sqrt( -2.0_sp * log( r1 ) )
            t = 2.0_sp * acos(-1.0_sp) * r2
            x(i) = cmplx( s * cos(t), s * sin(t), kind=sp )
         else
            ! fallback: uniform in (0,1)
            call random_number( r1 )
            call random_number( r2 )
            x(i) = cmplx( r1, r2, kind=sp )
         end if
      end do
      ! deterministic but harmless seed update (keeps ISEED(4) odd)
      iseed = modulo( iseed + 1, 4096 )
      if (mod(iseed(4),2) == 0) iseed(4) = iseed(4) + 1
   end subroutine clarnv

   !------------------------------------------------------------
   real(sp) function scnrm2( n, x, incx )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: n, incx
      complex(sp), intent(in) :: x( * )
      integer :: i, ix
      real(sp) :: sum
      sum = 0.0_sp
      ix = 1
      do i = 1, n
         sum = sum + real( x(ix) )**2 + aimag( x(ix) )**2
         ix = ix + incx
      end do
      scnrm2 = sqrt( sum )
   end function scnrm2

   !------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine cscal( n, ca, cx, incx )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: n, incx
      complex(sp), intent(in) :: ca
      complex(sp), intent(inout) :: cx( * )
      integer :: i, ix
      ix = 1
      do i = 1, n
         cx(ix) = ca * cx(ix)
         ix = ix + incx
      end do
   end subroutine cscal

   !------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine cgemv( trans, m, n, alpha, a, lda, x, incx, beta, y, incy )
      implicit none
      character(*), intent(in) :: trans
      integer, intent(in) :: m, n, lda, incx, incy
      complex(sp), intent(in) :: alpha, beta
      complex(sp), intent(in) :: a( lda, * ), x( * )
      complex(sp), intent(inout) :: y( * )
      integer :: i, j, ix, iy
      complex(sp) :: temp
      if ( trans == 'N' .or. trans == 'n' .or. trans == 'No transpose' ) then
         do i = 1, m
            temp = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
            ix = 1
            do j = 1, n
               temp = temp + a(i,j) * x(ix)
               ix = ix + incx
            end do
            iy = 1 + (i-1)*incy
            y(iy) = alpha * temp + beta * y(iy)
         end do
      else if ( trans == 'C' .or. trans == 'c' .or. trans == 'Conjugate transpose' ) then
         do i = 1, n
            temp = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
            ix = 1
            do j = 1, m
               temp = temp + conjg( a(j,i) ) * x(ix)
               ix = ix + incx
            end do
            iy = 1 + (i-1)*incy
            y(iy) = alpha * temp + beta * y(iy)
         end do
      else
         call xerbla( 'CGEMV', -1 )
      end if
   end subroutine cgemv

   !------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine cgerc( m, n, alpha, x, incx, y, incy, a, lda )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: m, n, incx, incy, lda
      complex(sp), intent(in) :: alpha, x( * ), y( * )
      complex(sp), intent(inout) :: a( lda, * )
      integer :: i, j, ix, iy
      ix = 1
      do i = 1, m
         iy = 1
         do j = 1, n
            a(i,j) = a(i,j) - alpha * x(ix) * conjg( y(iy) )
            iy = iy + incy
         end do
         ix = ix + incx
      end do
   end subroutine cgerc

end program test_clarge

      !------------------------------------------------------

      ! banded format G(i,j) = L(i, i+j-M).
      !------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: N, M
      real(dp), intent(in) :: G(:, :)
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: B(:)

    do i = 1, lx

       end if

       m = lx / 2
       do
          if (j <= m) exit
          j = j - m
          m = m / 2
          if (m < 1) exit
       end do
       j = j + m
    end do

    !--- Cooley‑Tukey FFT -------------------------------------------
    l = 1
    do while (l < lx)

          do i = m, lx, istep

       end do

    end do

   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n = 5
   real(dp), dimension(n) :: X, Y
   real(dp) :: C(3)
   real(dp) :: SR, XOR
   integer :: i

   ! Sample input data (hard‑coded)
   X = [1.0_dp, 2.0_dp, 3.0_dp, 4.0_dp, 5.0_dp]
   Y = [2.0_dp, 4.0_dp, 6.0_dp, 8.0_dp, 10.0_dp]
   SR = 0.0_dp        ! Non‑positive (or zero) → use original X values
   XOR = 0.0_dp       ! Not used when SR <= 0

   call spquad(X, Y, C, n, SR, XOR)

   print *, 'Coefficients C:'
   print *, C

contains

   subroutine spquad(X, Y, C, N, SR, XOR)
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)            :: N
      real(dp), intent(in)           :: X(:), Y(:)
      real(dp), intent(in)           :: SR, XOR
      real(dp), intent(out)          :: C(3)
      real(dp)                       :: FN
      real(dp)                       :: SUMX, SUMY, SUMX2, SUMX3, SUMX4, SUMXY, SUMX2Y
      real(dp)                       :: XS, D
      integer                        :: i

      FN = real(N, dp)
      SUMX = 0.0_dp
      SUMY = 0.0_dp
      SUMX2 = 0.0_dp
      SUMX3 = 0.0_dp
      SUMX4 = 0.0_dp
      SUMXY = 0.0_dp
      SUMX2Y = 0.0_dp

      ! Original FORTRAN‑77 logic: IF (SR) 101,101,103
      !   – SR <= 0  → use the supplied X values (label 101)
      !   – SR  > 0  → generate shifted X values (label 103)
      if (SR > 0.0_dp) then
         !--- shifted X case (SR positive) ---------------------------
         XS = XOR - SR
         do i = 1, N
            XS = XS + SR
            SUMX   = SUMX   + XS
            SUMY   = SUMY   + Y(i)
            SUMX2  = SUMX2  + XS**2
            SUMX3  = SUMX3  + XS**3
            SUMX4  = SUMX4  + XS**4
            SUMXY  = SUMXY  + XS * Y(i)
            SUMX2Y = SUMX2Y + XS**2 * Y(i)
         end do
      else
         !--- original X case (SR <= 0) -----------------------------
         do i = 1, N
            SUMX   = SUMX   + X(i)
            SUMY   = SUMY   + Y(i)
            SUMX2  = SUMX2  + X(i)**2
            SUMX3  = SUMX3  + X(i)**3
            SUMX4  = SUMX4  + X(i)**4
            SUMXY  = SUMXY  + X(i) * Y(i)
            SUMX2Y = SUMX2Y + X(i)**2 * Y(i)
         end do
      end if

      D = FN * (SUMX2 * SUMX4 - SUMX3**2) &
          + SUMX * (SUMX3 * SUMX2 - SUMX * SUMX4) &
          + SUMX2 * (SUMX * SUMX3 - SUMX2**2)

      C(1) = (SUMX2 * SUMX4 - SUMX3**2) * SUMY &
             + (SUMX3 * SUMX2 - SUMX * SUMX4) * SUMXY &
             + (SUMX * SUMX3 - SUMX2**2) * SUMX2Y

      C(2) = (SUMX3 * SUMX2 - SUMX * SUMX4) * SUMY &
             + (FN * SUMX4 - SUMX2**2) * SUMXY &
             + (SUMX * SUMX2 - FN * SUMX3) * SUMX2Y

      C(3) = (SUMX * SUMX3 - SUMX2**2) * SUMY &
             + (SUMX * SUMX2 - FN * SUMX3) * SUMXY &
             + (FN * SUMX2 - SUMX**2) * SUMX2Y

      C(1) = C(1) / D
      C(2) = C(2) / D
      C(3) = C(3) / D

   end subroutine spquad

end program spquad_demo

  print *, 'Derived quantity XV =', XV
  print *, 'Normalized weights:'

    real(dp), intent(in)  :: EB(N)

   call print_vector(sx, n, incx)

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Subroutine: DRSCL
   ! Multiplies an n‑element real vector SX by the reciprocal of a real
   ! scalar SA, avoiding overflow/underflow where possible.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine drscl(N, SA, SX, INCX)
      integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX
      real(dp), intent(in) :: SA
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: SX(:)

      logical :: DONE
      real(dp) :: BIGNUM, CDEN, CDEN1, CNUM, CNUM1, MUL, SMLNUM

      if (N <= 0) return

      ! Get machine parameters (only the 'S' (safe minimum) is needed)
      SMLNUM = dlamch('S')
      BIGNUM = ONE / SMLNUM

      CDEN = SA
      CNUM = ONE
      DONE = .false.

      do while .not. DONE)
         CDEN1 = CDEN * SMLNUM
         CNUM1 = CNUM / BIGNUM

         if (abs(CDEN1) > abs(CNUM) .and. CNUM /= ZERO) then
            ! Pre‑multiply SX by SMLNUM because CDEN is large
            MUL = SMLNUM
            DONE = .false.
            CDEN = CDEN1
         else if (abs(CNUM1) > abs(CDEN)) then
            ! Pre‑multiply SX by BIGNUM because CDEN is small
            MUL = BIGNUM
            DONE = .false.
            CNUM = CNUM1
         else
            ! Final scaling
            MUL = CNUM / CDEN
            DONE = .true.
         end if

         call dscal(N, MUL, SX, INCX)
      end do

   end subroutine drscl

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Function: DLAMCH
   ! Returns machine‑dependent constants.  Only the case 'S' (safe
   ! minimum) is implemented because it is the only one required by
   ! DRSCL.  For other characters a stub warning is issued.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   real(dp) function dlamch(cmch)
      character(len=*), intent(in) :: cmch
      select case (cmch)
      case ('S','s')
         dlamch = tiny(ONE)
      case default
         print *, 'WARNING: DLAMCH stub called for unsupported argument:', cmch
         dlamch = ZERO
      end select

   ! Subroutine: DSCAL
   ! Scales a vector X by a constant factor DA.  Implements the same
   ! semantics as the original BLAS routine.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine dscal(N, DA, DX, INCX)
      integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX
      real(dp), intent(in) :: DA
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: DX(:)
      integer :: i, ix

      if (N <= 0) return
      if (DA == ONE) return

      if (INCX == 1) then
         do i = 1, N
            DX(i) = DX(i) * DA
         end do
      else
         ix = 1
         do i = 1, N
            DX(ix) = DX(ix) * DA
            ix = ix + INCX
         end do
      end if

      integer :: i, idx

      idx = 1
      do i = 1, n

         if (i < n) write(*,'(A)', advance='no') ', '
         idx = idx + incx
      end do
      write(*,'(A)') ' ]'
   end subroutine print_vector

   ! scalar SA, avoiding overflow/underflow where possible.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine drscl(N, SA, SX, INCX)
      integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX
      real(dp), intent(in) :: SA
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: SX(:)

      logical :: DONE
      real(dp) :: BIGNUM, CDEN, CDEN1, CNUM, CNUM1, MUL, SMLNUM

      if (N <= 0) return

      ! Get machine parameters (only the 'S' (safe minimum) is needed)
      SMLNUM = dlamch('S')
      BIGNUM = ONE / SMLNUM

      CDEN = SA
      CNUM = ONE
      DONE = .false.

      do while (.not. DONE)
         CDEN1 = CDEN * SMLNUM
         CNUM1 = CNUM / BIGNUM

         if (abs(CDEN1) > abs(CNUM) .and. CNUM /= ZERO) then
            ! Pre‑multiply SX by SMLNUM because CDEN is large
            MUL = SMLNUM
            DONE = .false.
            CDEN = CDEN1
         else if (abs(CNUM1) > abs(CDEN)) then
            ! Pre‑multiply SX by BIGNUM because CDEN is small
            MUL = BIGNUM
            DONE = .false.
            CNUM = CNUM1
         else
            ! Final scaling
            MUL = CNUM / CDEN
            DONE = .true.
         end if

         call dscal(N, MUL, SX, INCX)
      end do

   ! minimum) is implemented because it is the only one required by
   ! DRSCL.  For other characters a stub warning is issued.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------

      character(len=*), intent(in) :: cmch
      select case (cmch)
      case ('S','s')

      case default

      end select

   ! Subroutine: DSCAL
   ! Scales a vector X by a constant factor DA.  Implements the same
   ! semantics as the original BLAS routine.
   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine dscal(N, DA, DX, INCX)
      integer, intent(in) :: N, INCX
      real(dp), intent(in) :: DA
      real(dp), intent(inout) :: DX(:)
      integer :: i, ix

      if (N <= 0) return
      if (DA == ONE) return

      if (INCX == 1) then
         do i = 1, N
            DX(i) = DX(i) * DA
         end do
      else
         ix = 1
         do i = 1, N
            DX(ix) = DX(ix) * DA
            ix = ix + INCX
         end do
      end if
   end subroutine dscal

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------

   !-------------------------------------------------------------------
   subroutine print_vector(v, n, incx)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: v(:)
      integer, intent(in) :: n, incx
      integer :: i, idx
      write(*,'(A)', advance='no') ' [ '
      idx = 1
      do i = 1, n
         write(*,'(F12.6)', advance='no') v(idx)
         if (i < n) write(*,'(A)', advance='no') ', '
         idx = idx + incx
      end do

!====================================================================
! The original DDAMAT subroutine computed C = GG * (A ⊙ B) where ⊙

! column of B was reused for every column of A.
!

! column case was encountered, which broke the scientific intent.

! simplifications requested (hard‑coded data, no I/O, double‑precision

   integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0)

   ! assignments for testing).  The numbers are chosen so the result can
   ! be verified by hand.
   !------------------------------------------------------------------

   integer :: ncola = 2               ! columns of A
   integer :: ncolb = 1               ! columns of B (set to 1 to test reuse)
   real(dp) :: gg = 1.5_dp            ! scaling factor GG

   real(dp), allocatable :: a(:,:), b(:,:), c(:,:)
   real(dp), allocatable :: work(:)   ! work array – holds A‑col then B‑col
   integer :: i, j

   !------------------------------------------------------------------
   ! Allocate and initialise matrices
   !------------------------------------------------------------------
   allocate(a(nrowa, ncola))
   allocate(b(nrowa, ncolb))
   allocate(c(nrowa, ncola))
   allocate(work(2*nrowa))          ! first half = A‑col, second half = B‑col

   ! Simple test values – can be replaced by any other data set
