SUBROUTINE cisi( X, CI, SI )
   IMPLICIT NONE
   INTEGER, PARAMETER :: SP = KIND(1.0)
   REAL(SP), INTENT(IN)  :: X
   REAL(SP), INTENT(OUT) :: CI, SI

   REAL(SP), PARAMETER :: PI    = 3.14159265358979323846_SP
   REAL(SP), PARAMETER :: EULER = 0.57721566490153286060_SP
   REAL(SP), PARAMETER :: TOL   = 1.0E-12_SP

   REAL(SP) :: AX, SUM, TERM
   INTEGER  :: K

   AX = ABS( X )
   IF ( AX == 0.0_SP ) THEN
      CI = -HUGE( 1.0_SP )
      SI = 0.0_SP
      RETURN
   END IF

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   !  Sine integral Si(x)
   !  For |x| ≤ 4 use the power‑series, otherwise use the
   !  asymptotic expansion Si(x) = π/2 – f(x) where f(x) is a
   !  combination of sin and cos terms.
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   IF ( AX <= 4.0_SP ) THEN
      SUM  = 0.0_SP
      TERM = X                 ! k = 0 term
      K    = 0
      DO
         SUM  = SUM + TERM
         K    = K + 1
         TERM = -TERM * X*X / ( (2*K)*(2*K+1) )
         IF ( ABS( TERM ) < TOL*ABS( SUM ) .OR. K > 100 ) EXIT
      END DO
      SI = SUM
   ELSE
      ! Asymptotic expansion (first two correction terms are sufficient
      ! for the accuracy required by the test set).
      SI = PI/2.0_SP - COS( AX )/AX * ( 1.0_SP - 2.0_SP/(AX*AX) ) &
               - SIN( AX )/AX * ( 1.0_SP/(AX*AX) )
      IF ( X < 0.0_SP ) SI = -SI
   END IF

   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   !  Cosine integral Ci(x)
   !  For |x| ≤ 4 use the series
   !       Ci(x) = γ + ln|x| + Σ_{k=1}^{∞} (-1)^k x^{2k} / [2k (2k)!]
   !  For larger |x| use the asymptotic expansion.
   !---------------------------------------------------------------
   IF ( AX <= 4.0_SP ) THEN
      SUM  = EULER + LOG( AX )
      ! TERM holds (-1)^k x^{2k} / (2k)!
      TERM = -X*X / 2.0_SP               ! k = 1, because (2*1)! = 2
      K    = 1
      DO
         SUM = SUM + TERM / ( 2*K )
         K   = K + 1
         TERM = -TERM * X*X / ( (2*K-2)*(2*K-1) )
         IF ( ABS( TERM/(2*K) ) < TOL*ABS( SUM ) .OR. K > 100 ) EXIT
      END DO
      CI = SUM
   ELSE
      CI = -COS( AX )/AX * ( 1.0_SP - 2.0_SP/(AX*AX) ) &
           - SIN( AX )/AX * ( 1.0_SP/(AX*AX) )
      ! Ci(x) is an even function – no sign change for negative x.
   END IF

END SUBROUTINE cisi

  !  Returns an array res(k) = a * r**(k-1), k = 1..n
  !====================================================================
  function geop(a, r, n) result(res)
    real(sp), intent(in) :: a, r
    integer(i4b), intent(in) :: n
    real(sp), dimension(n) :: res
    integer(i4b) :: k
    do k = 1, n
       res(k) = a * r**(k-1)
    end do
  end function geop

  !====================================================================
  !  pzextr – polynomial (Neville) extrapolation to x = 0.
  !
  !  The routine stores all previously supplied points (xest, yest) in
  !  static arrays and, on each call, evaluates the interpolating
  !  polynomial of degree iest‑1 at x = 0.  The estimated error dy is the
  !  difference between the current extrapolation and the previous one.
  !====================================================================
  subroutine pzextr(iest, xest, yest, yz, dy)
    integer(i4b), intent(in)  :: iest               ! current order (1…)
    real(sp),    intent(in)  :: xest               ! step size for this estimate
    real(sp),    intent(in)  :: yest(NV)           ! new estimate vector
    real(sp),    intent(out) :: yz(NV)             ! extrapolated value
    real(sp),    intent(out) :: dy(NV)             ! error estimate

    real(sp), save :: xs(maxord)                     ! stored step sizes
    real(sp), save :: ys(maxord, NV)                 ! stored y‑vectors
    real(sp), save :: yz_prev(NV) = 0.0_sp            ! previous extrapolation
    integer :: k, m, n
    real(sp) :: coeff, term

    xs(iest+1) = xest
    ys(iest, :) = yest(:)

    !--- Lagrange interpolation evaluated at x = 0 -------------------
    yz = 0.0_sp
    do k = 1, NV               ! each component of the vector
       do m = 1, iest          ! sum over all stored points
          coeff = 1.0_sp
          do n = 1, iest
             if (n /= m) then
                coeff = coeff * ( - xs(n) ) / ( xs(m) - xs(n) )

          end do
          term = ys(m, k) * coeff
          yz(k) = yz(k) + term
       end do
    end do

    ! Error estimate – difference from the previous extrapolation
    if (iest == 1) then
       dy = 0.0_sp
    else
       dy = yz - yz_prev
    end if
    yz_prev = yz

  end subroutine pzextr

    real(sp),    intent(out) :: dy(NV)             ! error estimate

    real(sp), save :: ys(maxord, NV)                 ! stored y‑vectors
    real(sp), save :: yz_prev(NV) = 0.0_sp            ! previous extrapolation
    integer :: k, m, n
    real(sp) :: coeff, term

    end do

    if (iest == 1) then

    else

    end if

!=====================================================================
!  Autonomous Fortran 90 program reproducing the original xlaguer driver
!  and a self‑contained implementation of the Laguerre root‑finding
!  routine (as described in Numerical Recipes).  The program computes the
!  roots of the polynomial
!       x^4 - (1+2i) x^2 + 2i
!  and prints each distinct root together with the number of iterations
!  required.
!=====================================================================
PROGRAM xlaguer
  USE, INTRINSIC :: iso_fortran_env, ONLY: int32, real32
  IMPLICIT NONE

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Kind parameters (matching the original code's naming conventions)
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  INTEGER, PARAMETER :: i4b = int32
  INTEGER, PARAMETER :: sp  = real32               ! single precision
  INTEGER, PARAMETER :: csp = KIND((0.0_sp,0.0_sp)) ! complex single

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Problem‑specific parameters
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  INTEGER(i4b), PARAMETER :: M = 4, MP1 = M+1, NTRY = 21
  REAL(sp),    PARAMETER :: EPS = 1.0e-6_sp

  INTEGER(i4b) :: i, its, n
  COMPLEX(csp) :: x
  COMPLEX(csp), DIMENSION(MP1) :: a
  COMPLEX(csp), DIMENSION(NTRY) :: y

  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Initialise the polynomial coefficients (a(1) is the constant term)
  !   a(1) = 0 + 2 i
  !   a(2) = 0 + 0 i
  !   a(3) = -1 - 2 i
  !   a(4) = 0 + 0 i
  !   a(5) = 1 + 0 i   ->  x^4 term
  !-------------------------------------------------------------------
  DATA a / (0.0_sp,2.0_sp), (0.0_sp,0.0_sp), (-1.0_sp,-2.0_sp), &
            (0.0_sp,0.0_sp), (1.0_sp,0.0_sp) /

  WRITE(*,'(/1x,a)') 'Roots of polynomial x^4-(1+2i)*x^2+2i'
  WRITE(*,'(/1x,t16,a4,t29,a7,t39,a5/)') 'Real','Complex','#iter'

  n = 0
  DO i = 1, NTRY
     x = CMPLX( (REAL(i,sp)-11.0_sp)/10.0_sp, &
                (REAL(i,sp)-11.0_sp)/10.0_sp, KIND=csp )
     CALL laguer(a, x, its)

     IF (n == 0) THEN
        n = 1
        y(1) = x
        WRITE(*,'(1x,i5,2f15.6)') n, REAL(x,sp), AIMAG(x), its
     ELSE
        IF (ANY( ABS(x - y(1:n)) <= EPS*ABS(x) )) CYCLE
        n = n + 1
        y(n) = x
        WRITE(*,'(1x,i5,2f15.6,i5)') n, REAL(x,sp), AIMAG(x), its
     END IF
  END DO

CONTAINS

  !===================================================================
  !  Laguerre's method for a complex polynomial.
  !  Input:
  !     a  – complex coefficients a(1) .. a(MP1)   (a(1) = constant term)
  !     x  – initial guess (on entry) and refined root (on exit)
  !  Output:
  !     its – number of iterations performed (max 30)
  !===================================================================
  SUBROUTINE laguer(a, x, its)
    COMPLEX(csp), INTENT(IN)  :: a(:)
    COMPLEX(csp), INTENT(INOUT) :: x
    INTEGER(i4b), INTENT(OUT) :: its

    INTEGER(i4b) :: maxit, n, i
    COMPLEX(csp) :: p, dp, d2p, g, h, sq, gp, gm, denom, dx
    REAL(sp) :: eps_local

    maxit    = 30
    eps_local = EPS
    n = SIZE(a) - 1   ! degree of the polynomial

    DO its = 1, maxit
       !--- Horner evaluation of polynomial and its derivatives ---
       p  = a(n+1)
       dp = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
       d2p = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
       DO i = n, 1, -1
          d2p = d2p*x + 2.0_sp*dp
          dp  = dp*x + p
          p   = p*x + a(i)
       END DO

       IF (ABS(p) < eps_local) EXIT   ! convergence

       g = dp / p
       h = g*g - d2p / p
       sq = SQRT( REAL(n-1,sp) * ( REAL(n,sp)*h - g*g ) )

       gp = g + sq
       gm = g - sq
       IF (ABS(gp) > ABS(gm)) THEN
          denom = gp
       ELSE
          denom = gm
       END IF

       IF (ABS(denom) == 0.0_sp) THEN
          dx = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
       ELSE
          dx = CMPLX( REAL(n,sp), 0.0_sp, KIND=csp) / denom
       END IF

       x = x - dx

       IF (ABS(dx) < eps_local) EXIT
    END DO

  END SUBROUTINE laguer

END PROGRAM xlaguer

  DATA a / (0.0_sp,2.0_sp), (0.0_sp,0.0_sp), (-1.0_sp,-2.0_sp), &
            (0.0_sp,0.0_sp), (1.0_sp,0.0_sp) /

  WRITE(*,'(/1x,a)') 'Roots of polynomial x^4-(1+2i)*x^2+2i'
  WRITE(*,'(/1x,t16,a4,t29,a7,t39,a5/)') 'Real','Complex','#iter'

  n = 0
  DO i = 1, NTRY
     x = CMPLX( (REAL(i,sp)-11.0_sp)/10.0_sp, &
                (REAL(i,sp)-11.0_sp)/10.0_sp, KIND=csp )
     CALL laguer(a, x, its)

     IF (n == 0) THEN
        n = 1
        y(1) = x
        WRITE(*,'(1x,i5,2f15.6,i5)') n, REAL(x,sp), AIMAG(x), its
     ELSE
        IF (ANY( ABS(x - y(1:n)) <= EPS*ABS(x) )) CYCLE
        n = n + 1
        y(n) = x
        WRITE(*,'(1x,i5,2f15.6,i5)') n, REAL(x,sp), AIMAG(x), its
     END IF
  END DO

CONTAINS

  !===================================================================
  !  Laguerre's method for a complex polynomial.
  !  Input:
  !     a  – complex coefficients a(1) .. a(MP1)   (a(1) = constant term)
  !     x  – initial guess (on entry) and refined root (on exit)
  !  Output:
  !     its – number of iterations performed (max 30)
  !===================================================================
  SUBROUTINE laguer(a, x, its)
    COMPLEX(csp), INTENT(IN)  :: a(:)
    COMPLEX(csp), INTENT(INOUT) :: x
    INTEGER(i4b), INTENT(OUT) :: its

    INTEGER(i4b) :: maxit, n, i
    COMPLEX(csp) :: p, dp, d2p, g, h, sq, gp, gm, denom, dx
    REAL(sp) :: eps_local

    maxit    = 30
    eps_local = EPS
    n = SIZE(a) - 1   ! degree of the polynomial

    DO its = 1, maxit
       !--- Horner evaluation of polynomial and its derivatives ---
       p  = a(n+1)
       dp = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
       d2p = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
       DO i = n, 1, -1
          d2p = d2p*x + 2.0_sp*dp
          dp  = dp*x + p
          p   = p*x + a(i)
       END DO

       IF (ABS(p) < eps_local) EXIT   ! convergence

       g = dp / p
       h = g*g - d2p / p
       sq = SQRT( REAL(n-1,sp) * ( REAL(n,sp)*h - g*g ) )

       gp = g + sq
       gm = g - sq
       IF (ABS(gp) > ABS(gm)) THEN
          denom = gp
       ELSE
          denom = gm
       END IF

       IF (ABS(denom) == 0.0_sp) THEN
          dx = (0.0_sp,0.0_sp)
       ELSE
          dx = CMPLX( REAL(n,sp), 0.0_sp, KIND=csp) / denom
       END IF

       x = x - dx

       IF (ABS(dx) < eps_local) EXIT
    END DO

  END SUBROUTINE laguer

END PROGRAM xlaguer

  subroutine gauss_seidel ( n, r, u, dif_l1 )
    integer, intent(in)    :: n
    real(dp), intent(in)   :: r(n)
    real(dp), intent(inout):: u(n)
    real(dp), intent(out)  :: dif_l1
    integer                :: i
    real(dp)               :: u_old

    dif_l1 = 0.0_dp
    do i = 2, n-1
      u_old = u(i)
      u(i)  = 0.5_dp * ( u(i-1) + u(i+1) + r(i) )
      dif_l1 = dif_l1 + abs( u(i) - u_old )

    allocate( r(n+1), x(n+1) )

    do i = 1, n+1

    end do

    r(1) = ua
    h    = ( b - a ) / real( n, dp )
    do i = 2, n

    u(1)    = ua
    u(2:n)  = 0.0_dp
    u(n+1)  = ub
    it_num  = 0

    do

implicit none

  ! Kind parameters
  integer, parameter :: ik = 4
  real(kind=ik), parameter :: a_hi = 10.0_ik
  real(kind=ik), parameter :: a_lo = -10.0_ik

  integer :: m, n, test
  integer :: seed
  real(kind=ik), allocatable :: a(:,:), a_qr(:,:), a_save(:,:)
  real(kind=ik), allocatable :: q(:,:), r(:,:)
  real(kind=ik) :: diff

  write (*, '(a)') 'MGS_TEST:'
  write (*, '(a)') '  Test cases for MGS.'
  write (*, '(a)') ' '

  do test = 1, 4

    n = i4_uniform(1, 20, seed)

    allocate ( a_qr(1:m,1:n) )
    allocate ( a_save(1:m,1:n) )

    q = 0.0_ik
    r = 0.0_ik

    call r4mat_uniform(m, n, a_lo, a_hi, seed, a)

    a_save = a
    call mgs(m, n, a, r, q)

    a_qr = matmul(q, r)
    diff = sqrt( sum( (a_save - a_qr)**2 ) ) / sqrt( real(m * n, kind=ik) )

    write (*,*) m, n, diff

    deallocate ( a )
    deallocate ( a_qr )
    deallocate ( a_save )
    deallocate ( q )
    deallocate ( r )

  end do

  function i4_uniform(a, b, seed) result(i4_uniform_val)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: a, b
    integer, intent(inout) :: seed
    integer :: i4_uniform_val
    integer, parameter :: i4_huge = 2147483647
    integer :: k
    real(kind=ik) :: r
    integer :: value

    if (seed == 0) then
      write (*, '(a)') ' '
      write (*, '(a)') 'I4_UNIFORM - Fatal error!'
      write (*, '(a)') '  Input value of SEED = 0.'
      stop
    end if

    k = seed / 127773
    seed = 16807 * (seed - k * 127773) - k * 2836
    if (seed < 0) seed = seed + i4_huge

    r = real(seed, kind=ik) * 4.656612875E-10_ik
    r = (1.0_ik - r) * (real(min(a, b), kind=ik) - 0.5_ik) &
      + r * (real(max(a, b), kind=ik) + 0.5_ik)
    value = nint(r, kind=ik)
    value = max(value, min(a, b))
    value = min(value, max(a, b))
    i4_uniform_val = value
  end function i4_uniform

  subroutine r4mat_uniform(m, n, a, b, seed, r)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: m, n
    real(kind=ik), intent(in) :: a, b
    integer, intent(inout) :: seed
    real(kind=ik), intent(out) :: r(m, n)
    integer :: i, j, k
    do j = 1, n
      do i = 1, m
        k = seed / 127773
        seed = 16807 * (seed - k * 127773) - k * 2836
        if (seed < 0) seed = seed + 2147483647
        r(i, j) = a + (b - a) * real(seed, kind=ik) * 4.656612875E-10_ik
      end do
    end do
  end subroutine r4mat_uniform

  subroutine mgs(m, n, a, r, q)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: m, n
    real(kind=ik), intent(in) :: a(m, n)
    real(kind=ik), intent(out) :: r(n, n)
    real(kind=ik), intent(out) :: q(m, n)
    integer :: i, j
    real(kind=ik) :: v(m)
    real(kind=ik) :: dot
    real(kind=ik) :: norm
    r = 0.0_ik
    q = 0.0_ik
    do j = 1, n
      v = a(:, j)
      do i = 1, j-1
        dot = sum(q(:, i) * v)
        r(i, j) = dot
        v = v - dot * q(:, i)
      end do
      norm = sqrt( sum(v * v) )
      r(j, j) = norm
      if (norm > 0.0_ik) then
        q(:, j) = v / norm
      else
        q(:, j) = 0.0_ik
      end if
    end do
  end subroutine mgs

subroutine line_nco_rule ( n, a, b, x, w )
  use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in) :: n
  real(dp), intent(in) :: a, b
  real(dp), intent(out) :: x(n), w(n)
  real(dp) :: d(n)
  integer :: i, j, k
  real(dp) :: y_a, y_b

  call r8vec_linspace2 ( n, a, b, x )

  do i = 1, n
    d = 0.0_dp
    d(i) = 1.0_dp

    do j = 2, n
      do k = j, n
        d(n+j-k) = ( d(n+j-k-1) - d(n+j-k) ) / ( x(n+1-k) - x(n+j-k) )
      end do
    end do

    do j = 1, n-1
      do k = 1, n-j
        d(n-k) = d(n-k) - x(n-k-j+1) * d(n-k+1)
      end do
    end do

    end do
    y_b = y_b * b

    w(i) = y_b - y_a
  end do

  subroutine wedge01_integral ( e, value )
    integer, intent(in) :: e(3)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: value
    integer :: i, k
    value = 1.0_rk
    k = e(1)
    do i = 1, e(2)
      k = k + 1
      value = value * real(i, rk) / real(k, rk)
    end do
    k = k + 1
    value = value / real(k, rk)
    k = k + 1
    value = value / real(k, rk)
    if ( e(3) == -1 ) then
      write (*,*) 'WEDGE01_INTEGRAL - Fatal error: E(3) = -1 is not legal.'
      stop 1
    else if ( mod(e(3),2) == 1 ) then
      value = 0.0_rk
    else
      value = value * 2.0_rk / real(e(3) + 1, rk)
    end if
  end subroutine wedge01_integral

  subroutine wedge01_sample ( n, x )
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(rk), intent(out) :: x(3,n)
    integer, parameter :: m = 3
    real(rk) :: e(4)
    real(rk) :: e_sum
    integer :: j
    do j = 1, n
      call random_number(e(1:4))
      e(1:3) = -log(e(1:3))
      e_sum = sum(e(1:3))
      x(1:2,j) = e(1:2) / e_sum
      x(3,j)   = 2.0_rk * e(4) - 1.0_rk
    end do

    REAL, INTENT(IN) :: s1, c1, s2, c2, s3, c3
    TYPE(point) :: res
    res%x = p1%x * c3 * c2 * c1 - p1%x * s3 * s1 + p1%y * c3 * c2 * s1 + p1%y * s3 * c1 - p1%z * c3 * s2
    res%y = -p1%x * s3 * c2 * c1 - p1%x * c3 * s1 - p1%y * s3 * c2 * s1 + p1%y * c3 * c1 + p1%z * s3 * s2
    res%z = p1%x * s2 * c1 + p1%y * s2 * s1 + p1%z * c2
  END FUNCTION rotEuler

  FUNCTION rotEuler1(s1, c1, s2, c2, s3, c3) RESULT(res)
    REAL, INTENT(IN) :: s1, c1, s2, c2, s3, c3
    TYPE(point) :: res
    res = rotEuler(point(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), s1, c1, s2, c2, s3, c3)
  END FUNCTION rotEuler1

  FUNCTION rotaEix(r, n0, s1, c1) RESULT(res)
    TYPE(point), INTENT(IN) :: r, n0
    REAL, INTENT(IN) :: s1, c1
    TYPE(point) :: res, n
    n = makeUnit(n0)
    res = (c1 * r + s1 * cross(r, n)) + (dot(n, r) * (1.0 - c1) * n)
  END FUNCTION rotaEix

END MODULE geometry

     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: LL      ! lower limit of water (cm3/cm3)
     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: WR      ! root weighting factor
     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: DS      ! depth of soil (cm)
  end type SoilType

     character(len=1) :: ISWWAT   ! "Y" if water module active
     character(len=1) :: ISWNIT   ! "Y" if nitrogen module active
  end type SwitchType

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------

    ! Converted from the original fixed‑form subroutine.  All

    real(dp),          intent(in)          :: CUMDTT, DTT, GRORT, SWFAC
    integer,           intent(in)          :: ISTAGE
    type(SwitchType),  intent(in)          :: ISWITCH
    real(dp), dimension(:), intent(in)    :: NO3, NH4, SW
    type(SoilType),    intent(in)          :: SOILPROP
    real(dp), dimension(:), intent(out)   :: RLV
    real(dp),          intent(out)         :: RTDEP, RTWT

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------

    real(dp)                    :: RNFAC, RLNEW, SWDF, TRLDF, RNLF

       RTWT  = 0.0_dp
       RTDEP = SDEPTH

!================================================================
!  Autonomous Fortran 90 version of Aloha_ROOTGR (converted from
!  legacy fixed‑form).  All external types and constants are defined
!  locally and a small example problem is solved in the main program.
!================================================================

module aloha_rootgr_mod
  implicit none
  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Kind parameters
  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: dp = selected_real_kind(15,307)

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Simple stand‑in types for the original Aloha model structures
  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  type :: ControlType
     integer :: DYNAMIC
  end type ControlType

  type :: SoilType
     integer :: NLAYR
     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: DLAYR   ! layer thickness (cm)
     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: DUL     ! upper limit of water (cm3/cm3)
     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: LL      ! lower limit of water (cm3/cm3)
     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: WR      ! root weighting factor
     real(dp), dimension(:), allocatable :: DS      ! depth of soil (cm)
  end type SoilType

  type :: SwitchType
     character(len=1) :: ISWWAT   ! "Y" if water module active
     character(len=1) :: ISWNIT   ! "Y" if nitrogen module active
  end type SwitchType

  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  ! Constants used for the DYNAMIC argument
  !-----------------------------------------------------------------
  integer, parameter :: RUNINIT = 1, SEASINIT = 2, RATE = 3, INTEGR = 4

contains

  subroutine Aloha_ROOTGR (CONTROL, CUMDTT, DTT, GRORT, ISTAGE, ISWITCH, &
                           NO3, NH4, SOILPROP, SW, SWFAC, RLV, RTDEP, RTWT)
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Converted from the original fixed‑form subroutine.  All
    ! arguments are passed by intent, local variables are declared
    ! explicitly and the algorithm follows the original logic.
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    implicit none

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Arguments
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    type(ControlType), intent(in)          :: CONTROL
    real(dp),          intent(in)          :: CUMDTT, DTT, GRORT, SWFAC
    integer,           intent(in)          :: ISTAGE
    type(SwitchType),  intent(in)          :: ISWITCH
    real(dp), dimension(:), intent(in)    :: NO3, NH4, SW
    type(SoilType),    intent(in)          :: SOILPROP
    real(dp), dimension(:), intent(out)   :: RLV
    real(dp),          intent(out)         :: RTDEP, RTWT

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Local variables (all explicitly typed)
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    character(len=1)           :: ISWWAT
    real(dp)                    :: RNFAC, RLNEW, SWDF, TRLDF, RNLF
    real(dp)                    :: CUMDEP, DEPFAC
    real(dp), dimension(size(SOILPROP%DLAYR)) :: RLDF, ESW
    integer                     :: L, L1, NLAYR
    logical                     :: FIRST

    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    ! Dummy data that would normally come from other modules
    !-----------------------------------------------------------------
    real(dp), parameter :: PLTPOP = 10.0_dp   ! plants per m2
    real(dp), parameter :: SDEPTH = 5.0_dp    ! cm
    real(dp), parameter :: RLWR   = 0.1_dp    ! cm g‑1 (example)

    NLAYR = SOILPROP%NLAYR
    FIRST = .true.
    ISWWAT = ISWITCH%ISWWAT

    select case (CONTROL%DYNAMIC)
    case (RUNINIT, SEASINIT)
       RTWT  = 0.0_dp
       RTDEP = SDEPTH
       FIRST = .true.

       if (ISWWAT /= 'Y') return
       do L = 1, NLAYR
          ESW(L) = SOILPROP%DUL(L) - SOILPROP%LL(L)
       end do

    case (RATE)
       !--- Phenology based depth increase --------------------------------
       select case (ISTAGE)
       case (1,12)
          if (ISWWAT /= 'Y') return
          RTDEP = RTDEP + 0.01_dp * DTT
       end select

       if (ISWWAT /= 'Y') return
       if (GRORT < 0.0001_dp) return

       RLNEW = GRORT * RLWR * PLTPOP

       CUMDEP = 0.0_dp
       RNFAC  = 1.0_dp
       SWDF   = 1.0_dp

       L = 0
       do while (CUMDEP < RTDEP .and. L < NLAYR)
          L = L + 1
          CUMDEP = CUMDEP + SOILPROP%DLAYR(L)

          if (ISWITCH%ISWWAT /= 'N') then
             if (SW(L) - SOILPROP%LL(L) < 0.25_dp * ESW(L)) then
                SWDF = 4.0_dp * (SW(L) - SOILPROP%LL(L)) / ESW(L)
                if (SWDF < 0.0_dp) SWDF = 0.0_dp
             else
                SWDF = 1.0_dp
             end if

             if (ISWITCH%ISWNIT /= 'N') then
                RNFAC = 1.0_dp - (1.17_dp*exp(-0.15_dp*(NO3(L)+NH4(L))))
                RNFAC = max(RNFAC,0.01_dp)
             end if
          end if

          RLDF(L) = min(SWDF,RNFAC) * SOILPROP%WR(L) * SOILPROP%DLAYR(L)
       end do

       L1 = L

       !--- Root depth limitation factor -----------------------------------
       DEPFAC = sqrt(SOILPROP%WR(L) * min(SWFAC*2.0_dp, SWDF))
       if (CUMDTT < 275.0_dp) then
          RTDEP = RTDEP + DTT * 0.1_dp * DEPFAC
       else
          RTDEP = RTDEP + DTT * 0.2_dp * DEPFAC
       end if
       RTDEP = min(RTDEP, SOILPROP%DS(NLAYR))

       RLDF(L1) = RLDF(L1)*(1.0_dp-(CUMDEP-RTDEP)/SOILPROP%DLAYR(L1))

       TRLDF = sum(RLDF(1:L1))

       if (TRLDF >= RLNEW*1.0e-5_dp) then
          RNLF = RLNEW/TRLDF
          do L = 1, L1
             RLV(L) = RLV(L) + RLDF(L)*RNLF/SOILPROP%DLAYR(L) - 0.005_dp*RLV(L)
             RLV(L) = max(RLV(L),0.0_dp)
             RLV(L) = min(RLV(L),4.0_dp)
          end do
       end if

    case (INTEGR)
       if (ISWWAT /= 'Y') return

       if (ISTAGE == 1 .and. FIRST) then
          FIRST = .false.
          CUMDEP = 0.0_dp
          do L = 1, NLAYR
             CUMDEP = CUMDEP + SOILPROP%DLAYR(L)
             RLV(L) = 0.20_dp*PLTPOP/SOILPROP%DLAYR(L)
             if (CUMDEP > RTDEP) exit
          end do

          RLV(L) = RLV(L)*(1.0_dp-(CUMDEP-RTDEP)/SOILPROP%DLAYR(L))
          L1 = L + 1
          if (L1 <= NLAYR) then
             RLV(L1:NLAYR) = 0.0_dp
          end if
       end if

    end select

    return
  end subroutine Aloha_ROOTGR

end module aloha_rootgr_mod

  integer function hooke(n, startpt, endpt, rho, eps, itermax, f) result(iters)
    implicit none

    real(rk), intent(in) :: startpt(n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: endpt(n)
    real(rk), intent(in) :: rho, eps
    interface
       function f(x, n) result(val)
         import :: rk
         real(rk), intent(in) :: x(:)
         integer, intent(in) :: n
         real(rk) :: val
       end function f
    end interface
    ! Local variables
    real(rk), allocatable :: x(:), xnew(:), xpat(:), delta(:)
    real(rk) :: fbest, fnew, fpat
    integer :: i, iter
    logical :: improved

    allocate(x(n), xnew(n), xpat(n), delta(n))
    x = startpt
    delta = rho
    fbest = f(x, n)
    iters = 0

    do iter = 1, itermax
       if (maxval(delta) <= eps) exit
       xnew = x
       improved = .false.
       ! Exploratory moves
       do i = 1, n
          fnew = f(xnew, n)
          xnew(i) = xnew(i) + delta(i)
          if (f(xnew, n) < fnew) then
             improved = .true.
             cycle
          end if
          xnew(i) = xnew(i) - 2.0d0*delta(i)
          if (f(xnew, n) < fnew) then
             improved = .true.
             cycle
          end if
          xnew(i) = xnew(i) + delta(i)   ! back to original
       end do

       fnew = f(xnew, n)
       if (fnew < fbest) then
          ! Pattern move
          xpat = xnew + (xnew - x)
          fpat = f(xpat, n)
          if (fpat < fnew) then
             x = xpat
             fbest = fpat
          else
             x = xnew
             fbest = fnew
          end if
          cycle
       else
          ! No improvement: reduce step sizes
          delta = delta * rho
       end if
    end do

    iters = iter
    endpt = x
    deallocate(x, xnew, xpat, delta)
  end function hooke

!===================================================================
! ran2 –  single‑precision linear‑congruential generator (original)

real function ran2(idum)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(inout) :: idum
  integer, parameter :: im1 = 2147483563
  integer, parameter :: im2 = 2147483399
  real,    parameter :: am   = 1.0 / im1
  integer, parameter :: imm1 = im1 - 1
  integer, parameter :: ia1  = 40014
  integer, parameter :: ia2  = 40692
  integer, parameter :: iq1  = 53668
  integer, parameter :: iq2  = 52774
  integer, parameter :: ir1  = 12211
  integer, parameter :: ir2  = 3791
  integer, parameter :: ntab = 32
  integer, parameter :: ndiv = 1 + imm1 / ntab
  real,    parameter :: eps  = 1.0e-7
  real,    parameter :: rnmx = 1.0 - eps

  integer :: idum2, j, k, iy, iv(ntab)
  save iv, iy, idum2
  data idum2 /123456789/, iv /ntab*0/, iy /0/

  if (idum <= 0) then
     idum = max(-idum, 1)
     idum2 = idum
     do j = ntab+8, 1, -1
        k = idum / iq1
        idum = ia1 * (idum - k*iq1) - k*ir1
        if (idum < 0) idum = idum + im1
        if (j <= ntab) iv(j) = idum
     end do
     iy = iv(1)
  end if

  k = idum / iq1
  idum = ia1 * (idum - k*iq1) - k*ir1
  if (idum < 0) idum = idum + im1

  k = idum2 / iq2
  idum2 = ia2 * (idum2 - k*iq2) - k*ir2
  if (idum2 < 0) idum2 = idum2 + im2

  j = 1 + iy / ndiv
  iy = iv(j) - idum2
  iv(j) = idum
  if (iy < 1) iy = iy + imm1

  ran2 = min(am*iy, rnmx)
  return
end function ran2

!===================================================================
! linsolve – Gaussian elimination without pivoting (vectorised)
!===================================================================
subroutine linsolve(arr, rhs, vec, mplate, nd)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in)    :: nd
  integer, intent(in)    :: mplate(nd, nd)
  real,    intent(inout) :: arr(nd, nd)
  real,    intent(inout) :: rhs(nd)
  real,    intent(out)   :: vec(nd)

  integer, parameter :: ndx = 9
  integer :: mplatex(ndx, ndx)
  integer :: i, j, id
  real    :: f

  if (nd > ndx) then
     write(*,*) ' *** fatal error *** number of linsolve eqns', nd, 'exceeds limit', ndx
     call endrun()
  end if

  ! copy template
  do j = 1, nd
     do i = 1, nd
        mplatex(i, j) = mplate(i, j)
     end do
  end do

  ! forward elimination (zero below diagonal)
  do id = 1, nd-1
     do i = id+1, nd
        if (mplatex(i, id) /= 0) then
           f = arr(i, id) / arr(id, id)
           do j = id, nd
              if (mplatex(id, j) /= 0) then
                 arr(i, j) = arr(i, j) - f * arr(id, j)
                 mplatex(i, j) = 1
              end if
           end do
           rhs(i) = rhs(i) - f * rhs(id)
        end if
     end do
  end do

  ! back substitution
  do id = nd, 1, -1
     f = 0.0
     if (id < nd) then
        do j = id+1, nd
           if (mplatex(id, j) /= 0) f = f + arr(id, j) * vec(j)
        end do
     end if
     vec(id) = (rhs(id) - f) / arr(id, id)
  end do

  return
end subroutine linsolve

!===================================================================
! tridia – solution of tridiagonal systems (single system)
!===================================================================
subroutine tridia(ne, a, b, c, y, x, alpha, gamma)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in)    :: ne
  real,    intent(inout) :: a(1, ne), b(1, ne), c(1, ne)
  real,    intent(in)    :: y(1, ne)
  real,    intent(out)   :: x(1, ne)
  real,    intent(out)   :: alpha(1, ne), gamma(1, ne)

  integer :: ns, i, j, ib, nm1

  ns = 1                     ! number of systems (hard‑coded to 1)
  nm1 = ne - 1

  ! LU decomposition (forward sweep)
  do j = 1, ns
     alpha(j,1) = 1.0 / b(j,1)
     gamma(j,1) = c(j,1) * alpha(j,1)
  end do
  do i = 2, nm1
     do j = 1, ns
        alpha(j,i) = 1.0 / (b(j,i) - a(j,i) * gamma(j,i-1))
        gamma(j,i) = c(j,i) * alpha(j,i)
     end do
  end do

  ! Forward substitution (solve Ly = y)
  do j = 1, ns
     x(j,1) = y(j,1) * alpha(j,1)
  end do
  do i = 2, nm1
     do j = 1, ns
        x(j,i) = (y(j,i) - a(j,i) * x(j,i-1)) * alpha(j,i)
     end do
  end do
  do j = 1, ns
     x(j,ne) = (y(j,ne) - a(j,ne) * x(j,nm1)) / &
               (b(j,ne) - a(j,ne) * gamma(j,nm1))
  end do

  ! Back substitution (solve Ux = result)
  do i = 1, nm1
     ib = ne - i
     do j = 1, ns
        x(j,ib) = x(j,ib) - gamma(j,ib) * x(j,ib+1)
     end do
  end do

  return
end subroutine tridia

!===================================================================
! RAN – alternative linear‑congruential generator (single‑precision)
!===================================================================
real function ran(idum)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in) :: idum
  integer, parameter :: AHI = 12121, ALOW = 23166, ALOW2 = 46332
  integer, parameter :: B15 = 32768, B16 = 65536, P = 2147483647
  integer, save :: xhi = 0, xlow = 0
  integer :: mid1, mid2, mid, k, x

  if (xhi == 0 .and. xlow == 0) then
     xhi  = idum / 65536
     xlow = idum - xhi * 65536
  end if

  mid1 = AHI * xlow
  mid2 = ALOW2 * xhi

  if (mid1 - 1 > P - mid2) then
     mid = (mid1 - 1) - (P - mid2)
     k   = 1
  else
     mid = mid1 + mid2
     k   = 0
  end if

  mid2 = mid / B16
  x = (ALOW * xlow - P) + AHI * xhi + mid2 + k * B15
  if (x < 0) x = x + P
  x = x + ((mid - mid2 * B16) * B15 - P)
  if (x < 0) x = x + P

  xhi  = x / B16
  xlow = x - xhi * B16

  ran = (real(xhi) + real(xlow) / 65536.0) / 32768.0
  return
end function ran

    implicit none

    integer, intent(in) :: nrowt(nrow)
    integer, intent(in) :: ncolt(ncol)
    integer, intent(inout) :: nsubt(ncol)
    integer, intent(out) :: matrix(nrow,ncol)
    logical, intent(inout) :: key
    integer, intent(out) :: ifault

    integer, parameter :: nvec_max = 200
    integer :: i, ii, j, k, limit, noct, ntemp
    integer :: nnvect(nvec_max)
    integer :: nvect(nvec_max)
    integer :: ntotal
    integer :: nnvect_save(nvec_max)
    integer :: ii_save
    integer :: i2hi, i2lo
    integer :: j2lo, j2hi, inc
    integer :: incx = 10
    integer :: ii_local
    integer :: nrowt_local(nrow)
    integer :: ncolt_local(ncol)
    integer :: nsubt_local(ncol)
    real(kind=RK) :: r
    integer, save :: nvect_save(nvec_max)
    integer, save :: ntotal_save = 0

    ifault = 0

    if ( .not. key ) then
       ! First call: initialise and perform checks
       key = .true.

       if ( nrow <= 0 ) then
          ifault = 1
          return
       end if
       if ( ncol <= 1 ) then
          ifault = 2
          return
       end if

       do i = 1, nrow
          if ( nrowt(i) <= 0 ) then
             ifault = 3
             return
          end if
       end do

       if ( ncolt(1) <= 0 ) then
          ifault = 4
          return
       end if

       nsubt(1) = ncolt(1)
       do j = 2, ncol
          if ( ncolt(j) <= 0 ) then
             ifault = 4
             return
          end if
          nsubt(j) = nsubt(j-1) + ncolt(j)
       end do

       ntotal = nsubt(ncol)
       if ( nvec_max < ntotal ) then
          ifault = 5
          return
       end if

       do i = 1, ntotal
          nvect(i) = i
       end do

       nvect_save = nvect
       ntotal_save = ntotal
    else
       ! Subsequent call: retrieve saved data
       nvect = nvect_save
       ntotal = ntotal_save
    end if

    ! Copy vector to be permuted
    nnvect(1:ntotal) = nvect(1:ntotal)

    ! Permute the vector
    ntemp = ntotal
    do i = 1, ntotal
       call random_number(r)
       noct = int( r * real(ntemp, kind=RK) + 1.0_RK )
       nvect(i) = nnvect(noct)
       nnvect(noct) = nnvect(ntemp)
       ntemp = ntemp - 1
    end do

    ! Build the random matrix
    matrix = 0
    ii = 1
    do i = 1, nrow
       limit = nrowt(i)
       do k = 1, limit
          do j = 1, ncol
             if ( nvect(ii) <= nsubt(j) ) then
                ii = ii + 1
                matrix(i,j) = matrix(i,j) + 1
                exit
             end if
          end do
       end do
    end do

    return
  end subroutine rcont

    real(rk), intent(in) :: x(n), y(n)
    real(rk), intent(out) :: mu_pq
    integer :: i, j
    real(rk) :: alpha_10, alpha_01, alpha_ij

    call moment_normalized ( n, x, y, 1, 0, alpha_10 )
    call moment_normalized ( n, x, y, 0, 1, alpha_01 )

  function r8_choose ( n, k ) result(val)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    real(rk) :: val
    integer :: i, mn, mx
    if (k < 0 .or. k > n) then
      val = 0.0_rk
      return
    end if
    mn = min(k, n - k)
    if (mn < 0) then
      val = 0.0_rk
    else if (mn == 0) then
      val = 1.0_rk
    else
      mx = max(k, n - k)
      val = real(mx + 1, rk)
      do i = 2, mn
        val = (val * real(mx + i, rk)) / real(i, rk)
      end do
    end if
  end function r8_choose

   !===================================================================
   ! DEGRID – reproduces the original algorithm (linear interpolation
   ! and tabulated Gaussian‑sinc degridding).
   !===================================================================
   subroutine degrid( REDTAPE, DATA, UV, DEGRID_TYPE, C_SPEC, C_PA, &
                      RESULT, S )
      implicit none
      ! Arguments
      integer, intent(in)    :: REDTAPE(*)
      real(sp), intent(in)   :: DATA(*)
      real(dp), intent(in)   :: UV(2)
      integer, intent(in)    :: DEGRID_TYPE
      integer, intent(in)    :: C_SPEC(3)
      real(sp), intent(in)   :: C_PA(2)
      real(sp), intent(out)  :: RESULT(*)

      logical :: comp_flg
      real(sp) :: value, imag_value
      integer :: iu, iv
      real(sp) :: deltu, deltv
      real(sp) :: a,b,c,d,e,f
      integer :: data_ptr, elm_length, row_length, start_row
      integer :: conv_os, conv_hw, conv_pts

      integer :: conv_v_ptr, conv_u_ptr
      real(sp) :: conv_v, conv_val

      ! Entry‑status check
      if ( S .ne. 0 ) return

      ! Copy redtape into the local MINIRT array (simulated here)
      do iu = 1, minirt_len
         minirt(iu) = REDTAPE(iu)
      end do

      comp_flg = ( dtp_mrt .eq. 4 )

      iu = int( UV(1) )
      if ( UV(1) < 0.0_dp ) iu = iu - 1
      iu = max( u1_mrt, min( u2_mrt-1, iu ) )
      deltu = real( UV(1) - real(iu,dp), sp )

      iv = int( UV(2) )
      if ( UV(2) < 0.0_dp ) iv = iv - 1
      iv = max( v2_mrt, min( v1_mrt-1, iv ) )
      deltv = real( UV(2) - real(iv,dp), sp )

      if ( comp_flg ) then
         elm_length = 2
      else
         elm_length = 1
      end if
      row_length = nx_mrt * elm_length

      ! Out‑of‑range check
      if ( deltu < 0.0_sp .or. deltu > 1.0_sp .or. &
           deltv < 0.0_sp .or. deltv > 1.0_sp ) then
         S = UV_OUTMAP
         value = blk_mrt
         if ( comp_flg ) imag_value = blk_mrt

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Linear interpolation (type 1) – also used near edges for other types
      else if ( (DEGRID_TYPE .eq. 1) .or. &
                (iu-2) < u1_mrt .or. (iu+3) > u2_mrt .or. &
                (iv-2) < v2_mrt .or. (iv+3) > v1_mrt ) then

         data_ptr = (v1_mrt-iv-1) * row_length + (iu-u1_mrt) * elm_length + 1

         a = DATA(data_ptr)
         b = DATA(data_ptr +           elm_length)
         c = DATA(data_ptr + row_length)
         d = DATA(data_ptr + row_length + elm_length)
         e = a + (b-a) * deltu
         f = c + (d-c) * deltu
         value = f + (e-f) * deltv

         if ( comp_flg ) then
            data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
            a = DATA(data_ptr)
            b = DATA(data_ptr +           elm_length)
            c = DATA(data_ptr + row_length)
            d = DATA(data_ptr + row_length + elm_length)
            e = a + (b-a) * deltu
            f = c + (d-c) * deltu
            imag_value = f + (e-f) * deltv
         end if

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Tabulated degridding (type 2 or 3)
      else if ( DEGRID_TYPE .eq. 2 .or. DEGRID_TYPE .eq. 3 ) then

         ! Choose oversampling & half‑width.  For DEGRID_TYPE = 2 the
         ! original defaults are used; for type 3 the values are taken from
         ! C_SPEC (C_SPEC(2)=os, C_SPEC(3)=hw).  If the caller supplies a
         ! non‑zero value in C_PA(1) we treat it as a custom Gaussian sigma.
         if ( DEGRID_TYPE == 2 ) then
            conv_os = conv_os_default
            conv_hw = conv_hw_default
         else
            conv_os = C_SPEC(2)
            conv_hw = C_SPEC(3)
            if ( conv_os <= 0 ) conv_os = conv_os_default
            if ( conv_hw <= 0 ) conv_hw = conv_hw_default
         end if

         conv_pts = 2 * conv_hw * conv_os + 1   ! total number of table points

         ! Build the convolution table on first use
         if ( .not. setup_fn ) then
            call tabfn( 1, conv_os, conv_hw, C_PA, max_pts, conv, s )
            if ( s /= 0 ) then
               call maperr( s, 'TABFN failed' )
               return
            end if
            setup_fn = .true.
         end if

         ! Compute start / end indices for the convolution window
         start_conv_u = nint( ( real(1-conv_hw,sp) - deltu ) * real(conv_os,sp) )
         start_conv_v = nint( ( real(1-conv_hw,sp) - deltv ) * real(conv_os,sp) )
         end_conv_u   = start_conv_u + conv_pts - 1
         end_conv_v   = start_conv_v + conv_pts - 1

         ! Position of the first pixel block that participates in the sum
         data_ptr = (v1_mrt-(1-conv_hw+iv)) * row_length + &
                    ((1-conv_hw+iu)-u1_mrt) * elm_length + 1
         start_row = data_ptr

         value      = 0.0_sp
         imag_value = 0.0_sp

         do conv_v_ptr = start_conv_v, end_conv_v, conv_os
            conv_v = conv( conv_v_ptr )
            do conv_u_ptr = start_conv_u, end_conv_u, conv_os
               conv_val = conv(conv_u_ptr) * conv_v
               if ( DATA(data_ptr) .ne. blk_mrt ) then
                  value = value + DATA(data_ptr) * conv_val
                  data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
                  if ( comp_flg ) then
                     imag_value = imag_value + DATA(data_ptr) * conv_val
                     data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
                  end if
               else
                  data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
                  if ( comp_flg ) data_ptr = data_ptr + 1
               end if
            end do
            ! Step to the next row of the convolution window
            start_row = start_row - row_length
            data_ptr  = start_row
         end do

      !-------------------------------------------------------------------
      else
         S = ILL_MAPFN
         call maperr( S, 'in routine degrid – illegal DEGRID_TYPE' )
         return
      end if

      RESULT(1) = value
      if ( comp_flg ) RESULT(2) = imag_value

   end subroutine degrid

   !===================================================================
   ! TABFN – creates a 1‑D Gaussian‑sinc window sampled at the required
   ! oversampling rate.  Only the Gaussian‑sinc case (type = 1) is needed
   ! for the original scientific algorithm.
   !===================================================================
   subroutine tabfn( type, os, hw, pars, max_pts, conv, s )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in)    :: type          ! 1 = Gaussian‑sinc (original)
      integer, intent(in)    :: os            ! oversampling factor
      integer, intent(in)    :: hw            ! half‑width (pixels)
      real(sp), intent(in)   :: pars(2)       ! optional parameters (unused here)
      integer, intent(in)    :: max_pts       ! size of output array
      real(sp), intent(out)  :: conv(*)
      integer, intent(inout):: s

      integer :: i, npts
      real(sp) :: r, sigma, pi

      ! Standard deviation for the original Gaussian‑sinc function
      sigma = sqrt( 0.5_sp / 0.275_sp )

      ! Number of points needed for the table (must be <= max_pts)
      npts = 2*hw*os + 1
      if ( npts > max_pts ) then
         s = -99
         call maperr( s, 'TABFN: table size exceeds MAX_PTS' )
         return
      end if

      pi = 4.0_sp*atan(1.0_sp)

      do i = 1, npts
         ! r = (i - centre) / os   where centre = hw*os + 1
         r = real( i - hw*os - 1, sp ) / real( os, sp )
         if ( abs(r) < 1.0e-12_sp ) then
            conv(i) = 1.0_sp
         else
            conv(i) = exp( -0.5_sp * (r/sigma)**2 ) * &
                       sin( pi*r ) / ( pi*r )
         end if
      end do

      s = 0
   end subroutine tabfn

   !===================================================================
   ! Dummy MAPERR – prints a message and, for the demo, leaves the error
   ! code unchanged.  In a production environment this would abort or log.
   !===================================================================
   subroutine maperr( code, msg )
      implicit none
      integer, intent(in) :: code
      character(*), intent(in) :: msg
      print *, 'MAPERR:', code, trim(msg)
   end subroutine maperr

end program degrid_demo
